motions.title: Holyrood Street Heritage Area Study Support and Implementation
motions.description: Council consideration of Holyrood Street Heritage Area study prepared by Considine and Griffiths Architects. Study includes detailed historic, built form and architectural survey of Holyrood Street, West Leederville and recommends conservation policies and design guidelines for the heritage area.

motions.title: Walls and Fences Design Guidelines Community Consultation
motions.description: Council consideration of whether to review provisions relating to walls and fences facing the street in Residential Design Guidelines. Motion to canvas community opinion on current guideline provisions relating to front walls and fences.

motions.description: Monthly statistics and comparative data on building licences issued in June 2001 including 38 building licences, 5 preliminary building licences, and 2 demolition licences with total construction value of $3,288,256.

motions.title: Review of Delegated Authority to Building Surveyor
motions.description: Review of delegation limits to the appointed Building Surveyor; promotion of Building Surveyor Mark Rubie to Senior Building Surveyor position with expanded authority to approve or refuse all building licence applications.

motions.title: Review of Ward Boundaries and Representation
motions.description: Review of the Town's ward boundaries and representation in accordance with Schedule 2.2 of the Local Government Act 1995. The review must be undertaken once every eight years. The Town has been a local government in its own right for 7 years.

motions.title: Glendalough Boundary Realignment Proposal

The proposal seeks to transfer a small residential area (23 houses, 5 duplexes, 8 villas and townhouses, and 10 units) from Glendalough (City of Stirling) to Wembley (Town of Cambridge), with Jon Sanders Drive proposed as the new boundary.

motions.title: Withdrawal from WESROC Membership
motions.description: Proposal for the Town to withdraw as a participating Member of the Western Suburbs Regional Organisation of Councils (WESROC). The Town joined WESROC in September 2000 with a commitment to review membership after twelve months. After nine months of participation, no real benefits have accrued as a result of WESROC membership.

motions.title: Continuation of Current Committee Meeting System
motions.description: Council reviews the operation, efficiency and effectiveness of its current Committee meeting system (four standing committees meeting monthly with one monthly Council meeting). The administration proposed fortnightly Council meetings without committees, citing efficiency gains used by 16 of 29 metropolitan councils. During committee discussion on 10 July 2001, members did not support this change.

motions.title: Australia/New Zealand Planning Congress Attendance
motions.description: Council considers attendance at the inaugural joint Australia/New Zealand Planning Congress to be held in Wellington, New Zealand from 8 to 12 April 2002. The Congress theme is 'Impacts' covering governance, innovation, natural environment, and built environment. It is proposed that the Town's Executive Manager Development and Environmental Services attend.

motions.title: Boulevard/Grantham Street Roundabout – Street Lighting
motions.description: Review of street lighting design at The Boulevard/Grantham Street roundabout to assess conformity with Council's Street Lighting Policy. Residents raised concerns about excessive lighting levels.

motions.title: Grantham Street – Roadworks Median Island

motions.title: Tender No 05-2001/2002 Weed Pest Disease Control
motions.description: Annual tender for weed, pest and disease control in the Town including control of nominated weeds in kerbs, footpaths, garden beds and remnant bushland areas. Four submissions received. Turfmaster Facility Management recommended as successful tenderer.

motions.title: Tender No 06-2001/2002 Tree Watering Removal Prunings
motions.description: Annual tender for tree watering and removal of prunings from road reserves and parks. Works include watering trees after planting and follow-up watering in non-irrigated areas, plus removal of prunings by truck to holding area where they are converted to mulch. Three submissions received, all conforming.

motions.title: Tender No 07-2001/2002 Supply Erection Signs
motions.description: Annual tender for supply and erection of signs including street name signs, directional signs, parking signs, advisory signs and temporary traffic management signs. Five submissions received, all conforming. De Neefe Signs Pty Ltd identified as preferred contractor based on lowest price for majority of items.

motions.title: Tender No 09-2001/2002 Supply Delivery Sand
motions.description: Annual tender for supply and delivery of sand to the Town including supply to Council depot, supply to work sites, and option for Council to pickup sand from supplier's quarry. Current contract with Rocla Quarry Products. Two submissions received, both conforming.

motions.title: Tender No 10-2001/2002 Supply Laying Extruded Concrete Kerbing
motions.description: Annual tender for supply and laying of extruded concrete kerbing in association with budgeted roadworks and maintenance works. Current contract held by WA Kerbing, expired 30 June 2001. Four submissions received, all conforming.

motions.title: Tender No 12-2001/2002 Supply Laying Bitumen Crack Sealant
motions.description: Annual tender for supply and laying of bitumen crack sealant on roads within the Town. Cracks are sealed before laying new seal to reduce reflective cracking. Current contract held by Hotmix Pty Ltd, expired 30 June 2001. Four submissions received, all conforming.

motions.title: Tender No 13-2001/2002 Plant Fleet Maintenance Services
motions.description: Annual tender for maintenance of Council's truck and bus fleet including routine maintenance and service breakdowns. Current contract held by Major Motors, expired 30 June 2001. One conforming submission received.

motions.title: Tender No 14-2001/2002 Professional Consultancy Services
motions.description: Annual tender for professional consultancy services in engineering surveying, drafting, traffic management/design and landscape architecture design. Works include survey, drafting, design and landscaping associated with roadworks and development projects. Current contracts held jointly by Connell Wagner, BSD Consulting Engineers and Thompson Palmer Pty Ltd. Ten submissions received.

motions.title: Motion to Refer Back Tender 36 Light Vehicle Supply Maintenance
motions.description: Following further report and discussion at committee, Cr O'Connor moved that the tender regarding light vehicle supply and maintenance be referred back to the Technical Services Committee for preparation of revised light vehicle management strategies.

motions.title: Bush Forever report received
motions.description: Report on the State Government's Bush Forever policy released by Ministry for Planning for protection and management of regionally significant vegetation on Swan Coastal Plain portion of Perth Metropolitan Region. Three bush plan sites identified within Town of Cambridge: Area 310 Floreat Bushland, Area 312 Bold Park and adjacent bushland, Area 315 Swanbourne Bushland. Plan protects about 18% of total original vegetation in study area, amounting to 51,200 hectares of regionally significant bushland.

motions.title: Local Government Act Notice for 67 Ruislip Street
motions.description: Notice of departure from approved plans and enforcement action at 67 Ruislip Street, West Leederville. Building licence issued to [private individual — name withheld] as owner/builder on 1 February 2000 for construction of boundary wall and retaining wall. Wall not constructed in accordance with approved plans. Multiple issues identified: walls higher than approved by 600 mm, retaining more fill than approved, constructed with 90mm reconstituted limestone blocks rather than 110mm clay bricks, not suitable for vehicular loads, piers not reinforced.

motions.title: Delegated decisions and notifications received
motions.description: Report on delegated decisions for April 2001 including two grouped dwellings at 5 Barrett Street and 22 Connolly Street Wembley, two lot subdivisions at multiple locations. motions.title: Lot 8 Alderbury Street Floreat - Subdivision opposition
motions.description: Application for subdivision of Lot 8 (No. 16) Alderbury Street, Floreat into two lots in battleaxe configuration. Non-compliant with R15 zoning requirements for average lot size (proposed 499.5 sqm vs 666.6 sqm required) and minimum lot size (proposed 420 sqm vs 550 sqm required). Battleaxe leg width 2.8 metres versus WAPC policy requirement of 4 metres. Property previously undeveloped under R20 coding, now accommodates two existing dwellings.

motions.title: Lots 398 and 399 Cambridge Street - Eight dwellings refusal
motions.description: Application for redevelopment seeking approval for eight single bedroom dwelling units (two storey) and density bonus under Clause 5.2.1 of Residential Planning Codes. Site area 918 square metres zoned R60. Various setback variations proposed. Committee refused application 17 October 2000 citing non-compliance with R60 density coding and adverse impact on surrounding low median density residential area.

motions.title: Lot 257 Chipping Road City Beach - Single dwelling approval
motions.description: Application for building approval for new two storey dwelling with undercroft garage at Lot 257 (No.40) Chipping Road, City Beach. Site area 890 square metres, R12.5 zoning. Variations sought for front setback (4 metres vs 7.5 metres required), side setback (2.1 metres vs 3.5 metres required), privacy (upper bedroom windows), and front fencing/retaining height and permeability.

motions.title: Lot 1575 Lifford Road Floreat - Additions and alterations approval
motions.description: Application for preliminary building approval for additions and alterations to existing two storey dwelling at Lot 1575 (No.16) Lifford Road, Floreat. Site area 903 square metres, R12.5 zoning. Variations sought for front setback (carport 0.3 metres vs 9 metres required), privacy provision for rear terrace, and crossover width. Applicant argues carport design complements architectural style with side facia for integration.

motions.title: Lot 1738 Pangbourne Street Wembley - Additions approval
motions.description: Application for building approval for ground and upper floor additions at rear of existing residence at Lot 1738 (No. 90) Pangbourne Street, Wembley. Site area 731 square metres, R20 zoning. Variations sought for northern side setback (0.9 metres vs 1 metre required), southern side setback (1.2 metres vs 1.5 metres required), upper floor southern setback (1.2 metres vs 2.8 metres required), and upper floor balcony (2.1 metres vs 3 metres required).

motions.title: Lot 27 Windarra Drive City Beach - Additions approval
motions.description: Application for building approval for additions and alterations to existing two storey single dwelling at Lot 27 (No.51) Windarra Drive, City Beach. Site area 925 square metres, R12.5 zoning. Variations sought for front setback of new garage (3 metres vs 7.5 metres required) and hard paving within front setback (57% vs 40% maximum).

motions.title: Third level addition to dwelling at Lot 571 Kalinda Drive, City Beach
motions.description: Application for approval of additions and alterations (third level) to a single dwelling at Lot 571 (No.35) Kalinda Drive, City Beach, seeking variations to wall height (7.8 metres vs 6.5 metres compliance standard), privacy provisions, and roofing material (off white colorbond with 24-40 degree pitch). Neighbouring landowners consulted on privacy discretion and have no objections.

motions.title: Carport and front fence at Lot 1 Tower Street, West Leederville
motions.description: Application for approval of construction of a carport with an open metal sliding gate and front fence at Lot 1 (No. 105) Tower Street, West Leederville, seeking variations to front carport setback (0.56 metres vs 2 metres required) and side setback (0.6 metres vs 1 metre required). Neighbours have no objections.

motions.title: Retaining wall at Lot 1 Olinda Avenue, City Beach
motions.description: Application for approval of construction of a limestone retaining wall within the front boundary at Lot 1 (No.12) Olinda Avenue, City Beach (corner Merley Crescent), seeking variations to retaining wall height (2 metres maximum vs 0.75 metres compliance standard within 3 metres of street alignment). Council assessment found proposal does not meet performance criteria due to visual impact.

motions.title: Discontinuation of immunisation service at City Beach Child Health Centre
motions.description: Proposal to cease immunisation clinics at City Beach Child Health Centre, Boronia Crescent and relocate the service to Wembley Child Health Centre (Joan Watters Centre, Jersey Street, Wembley). City Beach clinic has poor attendance (average 1.5 patients per month in recent years) while Wembley clinic is consistently busy (6-16 patients per month).

motions.title: Town Planning Scheme No.1 Amendment No.3 – Rectification of Zoning
motions.description: Adoption of amendment No. 3 to Town Planning Scheme No. 1 to rectify zoning anomalies by rezoning Lots 1 and 1084 Harborne Street (corner Johnson Street, Wembley) from Residential Zone to Local Centre Zone and Lots 1104, 1105 and 1106 Harborne Street (corner Scadden Street, Wembley) from Local Centre Zone to Residential Zone. Two submissions received during 28-day advertising period: one objection from adjoining resident on safety/lifestyle grounds and one support from business occupying affected premises.

motions.title: Town Planning Scheme No.1 Amendment No.4 – Modifications to Scheme Text
motions.description: Adoption of amendment No. 4 to Town Planning Scheme No. 1 to make administrative changes including deletion of reference to Subiaco Redevelopment Act area, correction of clause references, replacement of 'Use Area' terminology with 'Zone', insertion of Conference Centre definition, and insertion of new Use Classes (Conference Centre and Hospital) in the Zoning Table. One submission received from Subiaco Redevelopment Authority with no objection.

motions.title: Regent Street, West Leederville – Proposed Street Closure and Park Modification
motions.description: Proposal to modify Regent Street road reserve by reducing the carriageway width to 3 metres to maintain access to adjoining property at 108 Tower Street while incorporating balance of land into Tower Park. Initial closure proposal advertised; nine submissions received including objection from Water Corporation regarding water main, objection from original applicant who withdrew support, objections from residents citing parking needs, and support from residents favouring park expansion. Committee recommended deferral for three months to explore further options.

motions.title: Appointment of Authorised Persons under Various Statutes
motions.description: Authorisation of three recently appointed officers under various Acts and Local Laws effective 9 October 2000: Noel Alexander Myers (Planning Officer), Rebecca Jane Biltoft (Customer Services Officer as Dog Act Registration Officer), and Todd Emson Dewar (Projects Co-ordinator). Authorisations enable officers to enforce Town Planning and Development Act, Local Government Act, Litter Act, Dog Act, Bush Fires Act, Environmental Protection Regulations, and various Town Local Laws.

motions.description: Council support for construction of Sandakan War Memorial to commemorate soldiers who died at Sandakan Prisoner of War Camp. Sandakan Association proposed construction at Floreat Rose Garden, estimated cost $15,000. Committee recommended plaque on existing West Leederville War Memorial instead.

motions.title: Community Garden
motions.description: Request from resident for establishment of Community Garden in Wembley Ward. Administration identified four possible sites including Lot 99 rear of Cambridge Gardens as most suitable. Proposal deferred to enable investigation of community support and commitment for three months.

motions.title: Bold Park Aquatic Centre Tender – Plant and Filtration Equipment
motions.description: Tender evaluation for installation of new plant and filtration equipment, shade and wind structures at Bold Park Aquatic Centre. Three tenders received. Walter J Pratt Pty Ltd recommended at $594,620. Additional allocation of $50,000 from Endowment Lands Account required. Three month construction period with approximately two week pool closure approved.

motions.title: Arts and Cultural Advisory Committee Minutes
motions.description: Receipt of minutes from Arts and Cultural Advisory Committee meeting held Thursday 8 June 2000. Art Acquisition Fund allocation recommended for 2000/2001 Budget to replace artwork currently on loan from private gallery. Amount of $5,000 proposed.

motions.title: Quarry Amphitheatre Kiosk Lease Release
motions.description: Request from kiosk lessees Jamie and Carol Vivian-Williams to be released from remaining lease term due to business viability issues and safety concerns related to harm minimisation obligations under liquor licence. Lease commenced October 1998 for three years at $4,680 per annum. Council agreed to release lessees and include kiosk operation in forthcoming Management contract tender.

motions.title: Insurance Renewal 2000/2001 Approved
motions.description: Approval of Council Insurance Portfolio renewal for 2000/2001 financial period, including Workers' Compensation, Public Liability/Professional Indemnity and other commercial insurance classes. Total premium $298,225.

motions.title: Appointment of Authorised Officers Dog Act 1976
motions.description: Appointment of Jacqui Blaydes as authorised officer for dog registration and deletion of Neil Costello.

motions.title: Parking for Disabled Motorists ACROD Permits
motions.description: Amendment of parking policy to allow ACROD permit holders double the permitted parking time in time-restricted street kerbside areas.

motions.title: Lot 231 Gregory Street Wembley rear garage approval
motions.description: Application for single garage (4.7m x 5.7m, 26.79 square metres) accessed off 4.5 metre right of way at Lot 231 (No. 69) Gregory Street, Wembley. Non-compliance with open space (44% vs 50% required), manoeuvring distance from right of way (5.8 metres vs 6 metres required), and side setback (nil vs 1 metre required). Previous application (February 2000) for larger double garage refused. Reduced size garage now acceptable.

motions.title: Lot 1530 Dundalk Road Floreat front fence and gazebo recommendation
motions.description: Application for front fencing, gazebo and swimming pool in front setback area at Lot 1530 (No. 3) Dundalk Road, Floreat. Non-compliance with front fence height (ranges 1.8-2.8 metres vs maximum 1.8 metres) and visual permeability (55% open view vs required 80%). Filling and retaining approximately 1 metre proposed. Gazebo 2.2 metres height, 4 metres diameter. Officer concern about departing from 'Garden Suburb' principles. Motion not to approve in present form but to authorise CEO to approve amended plans with reduced wall height and additional open view panels.

motions.title: Delegated decisions and notifications received
motions.description: Report on delegated decisions and notifications for May 2000. Delegated decisions included: carport door at 37 Woolwich Street West Leederville; grouped dwelling at 484 Cambridge Street West Leederville. No appeals lodged against Council decisions during May 2000. No appeals determined by Minister for Planning.

motions.title: Building licences approved under delegated authority
motions.description: Monthly statistics on building licences issued for May 2000. 52 building licences issued (45 in May 1999). Construction value $2,228,145 (down from $3,687,941 in May 1999). Year-to-date figures show 471 building licences (down from 549), $41,796,671 construction value (down from $47,597,416).

motions.title: City Beach High School International School Application Recommendation for Refusal
motions.description: Application by Woods and Bagot for international school, student accommodation, theatre and office at City Beach High School, Reserve 29923. Committee voted to recommend refusal to Western Australian Planning Commission citing excessive intensity, duplication of facilities, change of use, and lack of public consultation.

motions.title: Home occupation (part time beauty salon) - Alec and Maureen Boddam-Whetham, Lot 237 Harborne Street, Wembley
motions.description: Application for home occupation (part time beauty salon) at Lot 237 (No. 88) Harborne Street, Wembley. Use classified as 'AA' (discretionary) in residential zone. Applicant proposed operating Mondays-Fridays 10am-3pm with 2-3 clients per day. Committee refused the application due to vehicle access safety concerns at intersection and erosion of residential amenity from regular client visits.

motions.title: Two dwellings (two-storey) - A Rechichi, Lot 15 St Leonards Avenue, West Leederville
motions.description: Application for two two-storey dwellings at Lot 15 (No. 110) St Leonards Avenue, West Leederville on a 759 square metre lot. Applicant seeks to vary side setbacks under R Codes and variations to height, upper storey setback, and roof pitch under Residential Design Guidelines. Contemporary design with face brickwork and curved colorbond roof. Initial submission included three-storey housing but was revised following extensive consultation with neighbours to address concerns about visual impact.

motions.title: Two-storey dwelling refusal - West Court, Lot 19 Northwood Street, West Leederville
motions.description: Application for two-storey dwelling at Lot 19 (No.80) Northwood Street, West Leederville. Applicant West Court seeks approval to vary upper storey front setback and ground floor side setback. Original motion to refuse lost. Foreshadowed alternative motion passed authorizing CEO to approve subject to amended plans incorporating modifications: development moved back 1 metre from front boundary and improved aspect to adjoining park.

motions.title: Two-storey dwelling - deferral and alternative approval - West Court, Lot 19 Northwood Street
motions.description: Foreshadowed alternative motion by Cr MacRae following original refusal motion. Applicant indicated willingness to move development back 1 metre from front boundary and improve aspect to adjoining park. Motion authorizes CEO to approve application subject to amended plans incorporating these modifications.

motions.title: Single dwelling (two-storey) - Oswald Homes, Lot 10 Alderbury Street, Floreat
motions.description: Application for single two-storey dwelling at Lot 10 (No. 76A) Alderbury Street, Floreat on 700 square metre lot. Applicant seeks discretion to vary wall height compliance standard from 6 metres to 6.4 metres under Residential Design Guidelines. Contemporary design with brick and render construction. Council recommends maximum wall height of 73 courses or finished floor level lowered by 0.4 metres to ensure compatibility with surrounding development.

motions.title: Two storey residence - Renowned Homes, Lot 86 Olinda Avenue, City Beach
motions.description: Application for two-storey residence at Lot 86 (No.2) Olinda Avenue, corner Gayton Road, City Beach on 850 square metre lot. Applicant seeks variation to front setback requirement from 7.5 metres to 4.35 metres. Residence oriented towards park on Olinda Avenue. Absolute majority decision required due to Town Planning Scheme variation. Proposal meets performance criteria for setback variation.

motions.title: Two storey residence with undercroft - Milankov Designs, Lot 311 Kinkuna Way, City Beach
motions.description: Application for two-storey residence with undercroft at Lot 311 (No. 35) Kinkuna Way, City Beach on 769 square metre lot. Applicant seeks discretion for variations to upper storey setback (west), wall height, roof height, and raised floor levels. Design includes four car garage and multiple habitable spaces. Neighbouring property raised concerns regarding raised floor level impacts on privacy, overlooking, and boundary treatment.

motions.title: Lot 205 Linden Gardens Floreat application withdrawal
motions.description: Application for additions and alterations to existing residence at Lot 205 (No. 30) Linden Gardens, Floreat. Non-compliance with side setback requirements (1.0 metre proposed vs 1.5 metre required). Adjoining neighbour objection received. Applicant requested withdrawal to bring proposal into compliance with Residential Planning Codes for approval under delegated authority.

motions.title: Lot 1015 Kintyre Crescent Floreat additions approval
motions.description: Application for additions to existing three-bedroom single storey residence at Lot 1015 (No. 12) Kintyre Crescent, Floreat. Variations sought to open space provision (48% proposed vs 55% required) and front setback for store (6.9 metres proposed vs 9 metres required). No neighbour objections.

motions.title: Lot 106 Lissadell Street Floreat carport recommendation
motions.description: Application for porch and double carport/garage at Lot 106 (No. 105) Lissadell Street, Floreat. Non-compliance with side setbacks (nil metres proposed vs 1 metre required) and front setback (4.9 metres proposed vs 9 metres required for garage). Officer recommendation against approval; Committee recommended refusal in present form but supported amended plans for open carport with piers on northern boundary. Delegated authority authorised to CEO to approve amended application.

motions.title: Lot 1 Evandale Street Floreat double garage refusal
motions.description: Application for double garage and storeroom within front setback area at Lot 1 (No. 29) Evandale Street, Floreat. Non-compliance with primary street setback (3.0 metres proposed vs 6 metres required) and side setback (nil proposed vs 1 metre required). No neighbour objections. Officer recommendation to refuse due to adverse impact on streetscape and non-compliance with design guidelines.

motions.title: Lot 333 Simon Place City Beach zincalume roof approval
motions.description: Application for new Zincalume roof to replace existing asbestos roof at Lot 333 (No. 3) Simon Place, City Beach. Non-compliance with Local Law 43 (zincalume has greater than 40% solar reflectivity). Roof pitch only 6 degrees, constituting 1 degree variation from threshold. Motion approved by absolute majority. During discussion, Cr Smith requested adjoining neighbours be consulted. Motion to refer back to committee for neighbour consultation was then carried.

motions.title: Lot 692 Dilali Road City Beach outbuilding refusal
motions.description: Application to amend approved building licence for gazebo at Lot 692 (No. 5) Dilali Road, City Beach. Original approval included 9 metre gazebo wall setback 1 metre with 0.96 metre section setback 1.5 metres. Amended plans seeking variation to set entire 9.96 metre wall at 1 metre setback due to changes in residence level. Neighbour strong objection citing visual impact, overlooking concerns, and blocking of light/air circulation to family room and study.

motions.title: Lot 1180 Dumfries Road Floreat colorbond shed approval
motions.description: Application for colorbond shed (green, 23.56 square metres, 2.4 metres height, 9 degree roof pitch) at Lot 1180 (No. 36) Dumfries Road, Floreat. Non-compliance with Local Law 43 (shed exceeds 12 square metre limit for metal outbuildings). Existing 12 square metre shed on site; total area 35.56 square metres. Not visible from street. Absolute majority required for discretion under Local Law 43.

motions.title: Elections – Postal Voting 2001
motions.description: Seek approval to conduct ordinary election on 5 May 2001 using postal voting method. Electoral Commissioner to be declared responsible for conducting the election. Requires Special Majority decision.

motions.title: Perth Metropolitan Transport Strategy
motions.description: Report on the status of development of the Perth Metropolitan Transport Strategy and introduction of a representative from the Department of Transport

motions.title: Black Spot Program 2000/2001 – The Boulevard/Grantham Street Traffic Management
motions.description: Establishment of a construction program for Federal Black Spot Program works on The Boulevard and Grantham Street in Floreat

motions.title: Shenton Park Integrated Transport Study
motions.description: Update on progress of the Shenton Park Integrated Transport Study and briefing by Department of Transport and consultant Ove Arup

motions.title: Nicholson Road/Railway Road Intersection
motions.description: Council position on the proposal for additional right turning phase for traffic signals at Nicholson Road/Railway Road intersection in Subiaco

motions.title: Telecommunications Code of Practice
motions.description: Authorization for Chief Executive Officer to sign an Agreement with Telstra Corporation Ltd for notification prior to works within the Town

motions.title: Railway Parade/Loftus Street signal phasing
motions.description: Support for right turn traffic signal phase for westbound traffic in Railway Parade to turn right into Loftus Street, requested by Department of Transport, Path Transit, and public to improve bus service efficiency.

motions.title: Branksome Gardens carpark negotiation with Botanic Gardens
motions.description: Negotiation with Botanic Gardens and Parks Authority for carpark development on western side of Challenger Parade; allocation of $45,000 from Endowment Lands Account for off-street carparking.

motions.title: Woolwich Street kerbside parking amendment
motions.description: Removal of one 15-minute parking bay on south side of Woolwich Street to permit extended parking in front of residential property.

motions.title: Cambridge Forum carpark directional signs approval
motions.description: Approval of Cambridge Forum directional signs; relocation of sign at Simper Street cul-de-sac to carpark property.

motions.title: Denton Street verge parking restrictions
motions.description: Implementation of 'No Verge Parking' restrictions on western side of Denton Street from Cambridge Street southwards.

motions.title: Cambridge Street kerbside parking restrictions
motions.description: Implementation of parking restrictions on northern side of Cambridge Street during winter Saturday Netball season.

motions.title: Herdsman Parade Road Improvement Grant application
motions.description: Support for City of Stirling Road Improvement Grant application for Herdsman Parade reconstruction from Dodd Street to Marlow Street, with conditions on design and $250,000 commitment over two years.

motions.title: Empire Avenue reconstruction – no contribution
motions.description: Town's position on City of Stirling request for contribution to Empire Avenue road works already completed without prior Council agreement.

motions.title: Tender No 34 – Floreat Beach landscape improvements
motions.description: Acceptance of tender from BLG Australia for Floreat Beach landscaping improvements; allocation of $800,000 from Endowment Lands Account.

motions.title: Road Treatment Services – Tender 01-2000/2001
motions.description: Annual tender for supply and laying of asphalt, bitumen and pavement profiling services for 12 months with option to extend to 2 years. Six tenders received. Hotmix Pty Ltd provides most comprehensive range and competitive pricing.

motions.title: Drainage and Associated Products – Tender 03-2000/2001
motions.description: Annual tender for supply and delivery of drainage products including pipes, manhole liners, gully covers and concrete items for 12 months with option to extend to 2 years. Six tenders received from CSR Humes, Georgiou, Tyson, Ingal Civil Products and others.

motions.title: Concrete Supply and Delivery – Tender 04-2000/2001
motions.description: Annual tender for supply and delivery of concrete for 12 months with option to extend to 2 years. Three tenders received from BGC Concrete, Boral Concrete and CSR Readymix. BGC Concrete offers most competitive pricing for both standard and small loads.

motions.title: Cast-in-situ Concrete Paths and Footpaths – Tender 05-2000/2001
motions.description: Annual tender for construction of cast-in-situ concrete dual use paths and footpaths for 12 months with option to extend to 2 years. Three tenders received. Westside Concrete Contractors is current contractor with proven performance and lowest prices.

motions.title: Plant Hire Services – Tender 06-2000/2001
motions.description: Annual tender for hire of plant including trucks, backhoes, front end loaders, rollers and other equipment for 12 months with option to extend to 2 years. Nine tenders received. Recommendation to accept all tenders with first preference to lowest hourly hire rates due to competitive pricing and equipment availability issues.

motions.title: Sprinklers and UPVC Pressure Pipes – Tender 07-2000/2001
motions.description: Annual tender for supply and delivery of sprinklers, UPVC pressure pipes and ancillary irrigation equipment for 12 months with option to extend to 2 years. Three tenders received: Hugall & Hoile (current contractor), Total Eden, and Elliotts Irrigation.

motions.title: Crushed Limestone Supply and Delivery – Tender 08-2000/2001
motions.description: Annual tender for supply and delivery of crushed limestone for 12 months with option to extend to 2 years. Two tenders received. WA Limestone is current contractor with competitive pricing and satisfactory material specification.

motions.title: Irrigation Design and Contract Administration – Tender 10-2000/2001
motions.description: Annual tender for consultancy services for automatic irrigation design and contract administration for 12 months with option to extend to 2 years. Five tenders received. Hydroscapes Australia is current contractor with lowest prices and excellent track record.

motions.title: Plant and Equipment Fleet Maintenance – Tender 13-2000/2001
motions.description: Annual tender for plant and equipment fleet maintenance services Category B, C and D for 12 months with option to extend to 2 years. Two tenders received from TFM Engineering and McCoy. McCoy demonstrates greater expertise and lower routine service pricing.

motions.title: Extension of Annual Contracts to 30 June 2001
motions.description: Extension of thirteen existing contracts for procurement of services and materials for period 1 July 2000 to 30 June 2001 at same rates subject to up to 10% GST. Contracts relate to park irrigation, pumping units, irrigation bores, tree services, pest control, tree planting, signs, sand supply, kerbing, bus shelter repairs, bitumen sealant, and professional consultancy.

motions.title: Quarry Amphitheatre Operations Report
motions.description: Report on operations of Quarry Amphitheatre for November 1999 to April 2000; investigation of off-peak rates; budget allocation for entry statement and signage; budget allocation for acoustic consultants to address sound problems; further report on capital works, operating budget and facility operations.

motions.title: Support subdivision Lot 156 Salvado Road Floreat
motions.description: Application for survey strata subdivision of Lot 156 (No. 228) Salvado Road, Floreat. Applicant sought extension of preliminary approval which had expired. Site includes existing single storey strata dwellings; proposal includes construction of crossover and battleaxe leg for rear lot access.

motions.title: Plan of Principal Activities - Amendment 1
motions.description: Amendment to include a comment noting that the subdivision plan for Truro Place has not been considered or approved by Council

motions.title: Plan of Principal Activities - Amendment 2

motions.title: 2000/2001 Draft Budget
motions.description: Second draft of the 2000/2001 Budget following consideration at Workshop held on 8 May 2000, with proposed amendment to delete anticipated proceeds from sale of Truro Place land

motions.title: 2000/2001 Draft Budget - Amendment
motions.description: Amendment to delete from the Area Improvement Reserve and Endowment Land Account the anticipated proceeds from the proposed sale of the Truro Place land

motions.description: Minutes of the Ordinary Meeting of Council held on 26 April 2000

motions.description: Confirmation of schedule of accounts and list of payments in accordance with Local Government (Financial Management) Regulations 1996, Regulation 13(2), comprising wage transfers, advance account recoupments, and investment transactions totalling $1,548,640.03.

motions.title: Investment Schedule – 30 April 2000
motions.description: Receipt of Investment Schedule advising on surplus funds invested, their distribution, and financial performance. Portfolio shows General $232,378 (116.2% of budget), Reserves $275,562 (115.3%), Endowment Lands $294,850 (95.1%), totalling $802,790 actual against $749,000 budgeted.

motions.title: Monthly Financial Statements – 30 April 2000
motions.description: Receipt of Financial Statements for the period ended 30 April 2000 prepared and circulated with Notice Paper.

motions.title: Documents Sealed – Common Seal Affixed
motions.description: Notification that the Common Seal of the Town of Cambridge has been affixed to three documents: Restrictive Covenant for 45 Coldstream Street West Leederville (27 April 2000), Cambridge Sporting Association Lease at City Beach Pavilion (1 May 2000), and Municipal Employees Certified Agreement 2000 (1 May 2000).

motions.title: Financial Statements Quarterly Review – 31 March 2000
motions.description: Review of Town's financial performance and assessment of budget variations following completion of third quarter. Net operating result profit of $1,188,844 against budgeted $110,500. Total equity $128.9 million. Multiple budget reallocations and variance explanations provided.

motions.title: Review of Fees and Charges – GST Pricing
motions.description: Comprehensive review of fees and charges for GST implementation on 1 July 2000; includes adjustments to all major council services and facilities; justifications provided for increases beyond GST component including Bold Park Aquatic Centre, respite services, children's services, and administrative fees.

motions.title: Crime Prevention Advisory Committee Initiatives
motions.description: Crime prevention and safety initiatives including Constable Care Project, crime prevention circular, protective behaviours program, safety house, CPTED, signage, graffiti control, neighbourhood watch, and grants; amendments to Crime Prevention Advisory Committee Terms of Reference.

motions.title: Local Government Association AGM 2000
motions.description: Attendance at 2000 Local Government Week incorporating LGA Annual General Meeting; submission of motions and election procedures; identification of council delegates.

motions.title: Home Occupation Approval – Piano Rental Services
motions.description: Retrospective planning approval for home occupation (piano rental services) operating at Lot 1154 (No. 16) Katrine Street, Floreat for 20 years; application for approval subject to compliance with home occupation policy within 12 months.

motions.title: Retrospective Approval for Signage
motions.description: Retrospective approval for existing signage at consulting rooms (Hilary Lane and Associates Natural Health Centre) at Lot 298 (No.1) Newry Street, Floreat; two wall signs on prominent corner and parking entrance; signage exceeds policy maximum of 0.2 square metres; approval subject to replacement of corner sign with 1 square metre maximum.

motions.title: Approve extension to Medical Centre Lot 50 Cambridge Street Wembley
motions.description: Application for planning approval for extensions to Post Office Medical Centre at Lot 50 (No. 339) Cambridge Street, corner Jersey Street, Wembley. Existing building 359 square metres; extension adds 64.6 square metres including additional consulting rooms, podiatrist, treatment room, and enlarged waiting room. Parking proposed at 13 bays (reduced from 15). Site history includes 1991 change of use approval from Post Office to Consulting Rooms.

motions.title: Refuse two storey dwelling Lot 392 Tate Street West Leederville
motions.description: Application for preliminary building approval for contemporary two storey residence at Lot 392 (No. 70) Tate Street, West Leederville on newly created lot of 306 square metres. Proposal includes non-compliances with side setbacks, front setback, privacy provisions, upper floor setback, and front fencing standards. Initial motion to refuse was lost; subsequent motion deferred approval pending amended plans with increased setbacks.

motions.title: Defer two storey dwelling pending amended plans
motions.description: Foreshadowed motion following loss of refusal motion. Council authorized Chief Executive Officer to approve application for two storey dwelling at Lot 392 Tate Street, West Leederville, subject to amended plans incorporating increased setbacks from northern boundary (0.9 to 1.2 metres), reduced feature wall height (2 metres from ground level, set back 3 metres from street), and compliant open view front fencing.

motions.title: Approve off white colorbond roof Lot 319 The Boulevard Floreat
motions.description: Application for preliminary building approval for additions and alterations to single storey residence including double garage, family and meals room at Lot 319 (No. 67) The Boulevard, Floreat. Applicant sought approval for off white colorbond roofing material exceeding 40% solar reflectivity threshold under Local Law 43.

motions.title: Approve colorbond shed Lot 159 Oceanic Drive Floreat
motions.description: Application for building approval for colorbond shed (green) at rear of existing house at Lot 159 (No. 7) Oceanic Drive, Floreat. Shed dimensions 36 square metres, 2.4 metres height with 5 degree roof pitch. Previous application refused; resubmitted with reduced size. Applicant sought approval to vary floor area limitation under Local Law 43.

motions.title: Receive report on Metropolitan Region Scheme Omnibus Amendment
motions.description: Report on Minister's approval for Omnibus Amendment to change Perry Lakes Stadium site and City Beach Bowling Club and former Quarry site from Parks and Recreation Reserve to Urban Zone. Amendment to be advertised for three months closing 4 August 2000. Western Australian Planning Commission and Environmental Protection Authority have assessed the proposal.

motions.title: Initiate Town Planning Scheme Amendment to rezone Jersey Street land
motions.description: Amendment No. 6 to Town Planning Scheme No. 1 to rezone Council owned land at part Swan Location 2124 Jersey Street, corner Salvado Road, Jolimont (former Tennis Courts, Scout Hall and carpark) from Commercial to Residential R30. Land area 8,003 square metres to be subdivided into approximately 20 green title lots of approximately 400 square metres each. Highest and best use determined by Property Consultant to be residential.

motions.title: Receive report on delegated decisions and notifications
motions.description: Report on delegated decisions and notifications for period ending 30 April 2000. One item dealt with under delegated authority: two grouped dwellings at 49 Keane Street, Wembley. No appeals against Council decisions received; no appeals determined by Minister for Planning during April 2000.

motions.description: Establish roadworks to resolve black spot Jersey Street/Grantham Street intersection following community survey in April 2000

motions.description: Update on progress of composting trials of the Town's fortnightly collection of green waste, including results from Murdoch University analysis and trial programs at Gingin.

motions.description: Evaluation of tender submissions for supply and installation of automatic irrigation systems at Ocean Village Park (budget $89,200) and The Boulevard Median (budget $31,500) from three organisations: Elliots Irrigation, Total Eden, and Malua Reticulation.

motions.title: Upper storey addition and ground floor extensions at 38 Hesperia Avenue
motions.description: Application for additions to existing residence at Lot 165 (No.38) Hesperia Avenue, City Beach. Further comments from neighbours at 40 Hesperia Avenue received, objecting to intrusion of south west wall for stairwell but accepting rear extension.

motions.description: Application to rename the section of Johnson Street east of Daglish Street intersection to resolve street numbering issues for corner lot developments.

motions.title: Lot 209 Pandora Drive two-storey dwelling conditions
motions.description: Application for two storey dwelling at Lot 209 (No.42) Pandora Drive, City Beach. Minister upheld appeal; council applies conditions for screening and landscaping.

motions.title: Lots 1,2,3 and 4 Oxford Close West Leederville office and warehouse
motions.description: Application for a new commercial development (office and warehouse) at Lots 1, 2, 3 and 4 (Nos 39-41) Oxford Close, West Leederville. Applicant Zeus Technology Pty Ltd seeks variation to parking standards - 22 bays proposed instead of 24 required (2 bay shortfall). Office/service/production area 183 sqm, warehouse 860 sqm, archive rooms 234 sqm on mezzanine. Building height 6.4-7 metres. An Absolute Majority required due to parking variation.

motions.title: Lot 73 Tilton Terrace City Beach aged and dependent persons dwellings
motions.description: Application for two aged and dependent persons' dwellings (single storey) at Lot 73 (No.1) Tilton Terrace (cnr Norbury Crescent), City Beach. Proposal requires variations to standards including primary street setback (6.5m instead of 7.5m), rear setback, and side setbacks. Previous similar proposal in March 1999 was refused; WAPC refused subdivision in April 1999; Minister for Planning granted subdivision on appeal in 2000. Site is 1204 sqm with 59% open space proposed. Each dwelling approximately 192-189.5 sqm excluding garages. Dwellings designed as aged persons residences with occupancy restrictions.

motions.title: Lot 1154 Katrine Street Floreat home occupation piano rental services
motions.description: Application for retrospective Planning Approval for a home occupation (Piano Rental Services) at Lot 1154 (No. 16) Katrine Street, Floreat. Business has been operating for 20 years. Garage 34.2 sqm and study 8.37 sqm used for business (total 42.4 sqm, exceeding 30 sqm policy limit). Site inspection found 12 pianos stored on site. Business operates hire service involving regular delivery/collection of pianos by trailer. Anonymous complaint received about business activities. No objections from immediate neighbours. Applicant claims Council officer inspected premises years ago and approved. No records found. Proposal violates definition of home occupation which explicitly excludes sale or hire of goods.

motions.title: Lot 502 Tilton Terrace City Beach two storey residence
motions.description: Application for a single two storey residence at Lot 502 (No. 5A) Tilton Terrace, City Beach. Lot area 772 sqm with 66% open space. Proposed residence has 3 bedrooms, kitchen, dining, family, laundry, bathroom and double garage on lower level (FFL 12.6) and 4th bedroom, ensuite and verandah on upper floor (FFL 15.4/15.5). Lot slopes away to rear and front. Applicant seeks variations to primary street setbacks (7.2m vs 7.5m required), side setbacks ground and upper floor, and retaining wall height. Adjoining neighbours signed plans with no objection. Councillor Smith expressed concern about development altering street character and requested recording against the motion.

motions.title: Lot 60 Clune Avenue West Leederville single dwelling
motions.description: Application for preliminary building approval for a single dwelling at Lot 60 (No. 2A) Clune Avenue, corner of Northwood Street, West Leederville. Lot created as part of 3-lot subdivision approved by WAPC in February 1996. Lot area 365 sqm with 45% open space (below 50% required). Dwelling has below-ground garage for 3 vehicles, main floor with 4 bedrooms, dining, lounge/family room, kitchen/breakfast bar, laundry. Distinctive architecture with two towers and turret as features. Subject to 2.7m Western Power easement along Northwood Street. Applicant seeks variations to primary street setback (4.57m vs 6m required), rear setback (2.674m minimum vs 6m average required), side setbacks, and open space (45% vs 50% required). Neighbours consulted; western neighbours no objection after plans modified; rear neighbour no objection. An Absolute Majority required for open space variation.

motions.title: Lot 165 Hesperia Avenue City Beach ground floor and upper storey additions
motions.description: Application for preliminary building approval for additions to existing residence at Lot 165 (No. 38) Hesperia Avenue, City Beach. Lot area 986 sqm with 69% open space. Proposed modifications include ground floor lounge, kitchen, laundry and outdoor deck; upper storey addition with master bedroom, ensuite, balcony and study. Existing two storey wall to be extended and height increased. Building setback 20-23 metres from street. Applicant seeks variations to rear setback (6.9m vs 7.5m average required) and side setback south (1.4m ground floor and 1.0-1.7m upper floor vs 1.5m and 1.7m required) and building height (7.45m vs 6.5m specified). Neighbours consulted: northern neighbour no objection; northern west neighbour no objection; southern neighbour (40 Hesperia Avenue) raised objections to building bulk and overshadowing. Plans modified to reduce height and increase setback from southern boundary in response to concerns. Neighbours at 40 Hesperia Avenue yet to comment on latest modified plans.

motions.title: Additions and alterations to dwelling at 10 Dartmouth Avenue
motions.description: Application for preliminary building approval for additions and alterations to existing two-storey dwelling at Lot 181 (No.10) Dartmouth Avenue, City Beach. Applicant seeks approval to vary wall and roof height standards under Residential Design Guidelines. Wall height proposed 9.2 metres (non-compliant with 6.5 metre requirement) and roof height 10.2 metres (non-compliant with 10 metre requirement). Extension would create third level to residence.

motions.title: Shed/workshop construction at 55 Marlow Street, Wembley
motions.description: Application for building approval for shed/workshop constructed of steel sheeting at rear of existing house at Lot 421 (No.55) Marlow Street, Wembley. Shed is 48 square metres, 3.3 metres high, 3 metres from rear boundary, 1 metre from side boundary (north). Exceeds standard by 12 square metres. Applicant seeks approval to vary maximum floor area for outbuilding.

motions.title: Fill and retaining walls on boundary at Perina Way and Yaltara Road
motions.description: Application for building approval for relocation of existing limestone retaining wall and associated fill at subdivision creating new lot 503 (No.3) Perina Way between lots 81 and 82, City Beach. Proposed retaining walls on western and southern boundaries to achieve level of RL 100.50. Western boundary wall 1.19-1.28 metres high, 8.43 metres long. Southern boundary wall maximum 1.55 metres high. Adjoining property owner at lot 70 objected regarding privacy and additional elevation.

motions.title: Fence and carport door at 2A Dumfries Road, Floreat
motions.description: Application for construction of fence and installation of garage door to existing carport at corner lot. Proposed fence on front and side boundaries. Applicant seeks to vary 80% primary and 40% secondary street visual permeability clauses. Enclosure of carport would create garage requiring 9m setback from primary street boundary.

motions.title: Front fence at 208 Harborne Street, Wembley
motions.description: Application for building approval for front fence at Lot 1073 (No.208) Harborne Street, Wembley on west boundary. Applicant seeks approval to vary 80% primary street visual permeability clause. Proposed fence 85% solid, permitted is 20% solid. Council notes Harborne Street is District Distributor A Road with significant traffic volumes.

motions.title: Pylon signs and flag poles at 350 Cambridge Street, Wembley
motions.description: Application for planning and building approval for four pylon signs at No.350 Cambridge Street, Wembley. Pylons 4.63 metres high and 1.98m wide. Proposed signs display hotel information. Non-compliant: 4 signs proposed (2 permitted), 2.7m headway clearance (2.75m required), 14.65m² area (10m² permitted). Signs previously erected and removed approximately 2.5 years ago.

motions.title: Outcome of legal action against Butcher Tom's
motions.description: Report on legal proceedings initiated against Proprietor of Butcher Tom's, Shop 30, 13 Howtree Place, Floreat Forum, Floreat for contraventions of Health Act 1911. Two charges brought for preparation and sale of 95% Lean Topside Mince containing more fat than prescribed standard. Case heard 21 March 2000. Defendant convicted on both charges.

motions.title: Street closure of Regent Street, West Leederville
motions.description: Proposed closure of Regent Street road reserve and amalgamation with adjacent Tower Park. Council consulted 94 residents in October 1999 by letter regarding closure and park establishment. 12 submissions received: 10 supported park establishment, 2 opposed (applicant and one resident). Main concerns: parking, anti-social behaviour, landscaping design, costs. Estimated landscaping works cost $35,000. Committee endorsed initiation of closure procedures on 18 April 2000.

motions.title: Town Planning Scheme No.1 Proposed Amendments No.3 and No.4

motions.description: Application for rear grouped dwelling (two storey) at Lot 8 (No.117) Northwood Street, West Leederville. Neighbour at 115 Northwood Street objected to upper storey side setback variation.

motions.title: Northwood Street, West Leederville - Two Single Dwellings
motions.description: Application for two single dwellings (two storey) at Lot 16 (Nos. 55A and 55B) Northwood Street, West Leederville. Plans substantially different from preliminary approval in August 1999. Applicant seeks upper floor front setback variation.

motions.title: Arbordale Street, Floreat - Single Dwelling with Loft
motions.description: Application for single dwelling with loft at Lot 499 (No.14) Arbordale Street, Floreat. Applicant seeks side setback variation for carport and garage. Northern neighbour objected to proximity of proposed building to their kitchen window.

motions.description: Foreshadowed amended motion for approval of single dwelling with loft at Lot 499 (No.14) Arbordale Street, Floreat, following refusal of motion for refusal. Approves application subject to carport remaining open.

motions.description: Application for ground floor extension and upper storey addition to existing brick and tile residence at Lot 399 (No.61) Daglish Street, Wembley. motions.title: Kimberley Street, West Leederville - Additions and Alterations
motions.description: Application for additions and alterations to existing character residence at Lot 9 (No.115) Kimberley Street, West Leederville. Applicant seeks variations to side setbacks, open space provision and privacy requirements. Adjacent landowners have viewed and signed plans with no objections.

motions.title: Additions and alterations to single dwelling, Floreat
motions.description: Application for second storey addition to single dwelling at Lot 567 (No.33) Oakdale Street, Floreat, with variations to building height (6.5m average vs 6.0m permitted) and privacy provisions. motions.title: Double garage application, West Leederville

Applicant cited security, landscape improvement, and convenience.

motions.title: Shed/workshop application refused, Floreat
motions.description: Application for shed/workshop of monoclad steel sheeting at Lot 159 (No.7) Oceanic Drive, Floreat. motions.description: Application for colorbond (green) shed at Lot 319 (No.67) The Boulevard, Floreat. Council considers it unobtrusive and not visible from street.

motions.title: Retrospective approval for front and secondary street fence, Floreat
motions.description: Retrospective approval sought for retention of brick fence with picket infill panels in arc, 1.8 metres maximum height, situated along Dumfries Road (19 metres) and Moray Avenue truncated corner (11.8 metres). motions.title: Proposed retaining wall refused, City Beach
motions.description: Application for construction of limestone retaining wall (3.8 metres height) along northern boundary (Empire Avenue) and western boundary (Chipping Road) at corner lot in City Beach. Motion to repeal by absolute majority and amend Town Planning Scheme to prohibit silver (zincalume) roofs was moved but referred back to committee for further consideration.

Financial statements show club is financially well off with $171,674 invested. Expected operating cost increases of $7,371 due to increased fees and GST. Recommendation made not to accede to request given club's strong financial position.

motions.title: Parking Facilities Local Law amendments
motions.description: Amendments to Town of Cambridge Parking Facilities Local Law to incorporate additional offences and accompanying penalties. Three new clauses proposed: (i) Overlength Vehicle Parking - vehicles over 8 metres length not to park on carriageway/verge for more than 1 hour in 24 hours, penalty $40; (ii) Parking on Reserves - prohibition on parking vehicles in public reserves without permission, penalty $60; (iii) Prohibited Parking of Vehicles - covering vehicles exposed for sale, unlicensed vehicles, unattached trailers/caravans, and vehicles undergoing repairs on roads, penalty $40. Amendments to be advertised for public comment.

motions.title: Underground Power North Wembley/West Leederville project
motions.description: North Wembley/West Leederville Underground Power project selected for State Government Round 2 Underground Power Program. Project will be completed over two years commencing July 2000, with physical work expected to commence early 2002. Project includes 1,430 lots with estimated total cost of $5.72 million (50% State Government, 50% local). Proposal includes Herdsman Parade, Cambridge Street from Southport to Jersey Street. Daglish properties (approximately 30 lots south of Hay Street) may be included in City of Subiaco's Underground Power Project. Funding model based on principles including fixed connection charge ($500) and network charge based on Gross Rental Value. CEO to negotiate and enter into agreement with State Government. Residents in expanded areas to be consulted prior to agreement execution.

motions.title: Lake Monger Skate Facility Location and Tenders
motions.description: Proposal to locate a skate facility near the Dodd Street/Gregory Street corner of Lake Monger Reserve, call tenders for construction, facilitate safety training, and authorize additional funding for emergency telephone and pictographic information boards.

motions.title: Motion Not to Consider Skate Facility at Lake Monger

motions.description: Motion to refer the matter of the location of a skate park in the Wembley Ward back to Committee for further consideration.

motions.title: Lot 102 Tower Street West Leederville retrospective solid door carport approval - REFUSED
motions.description: Application by DS and M Kestel for retrospective approval of solid door installed on carport at Lot 102 (No 132) Tower Street, West Leederville. Preliminary building licence granted 26 November 1997 required carport remain open on all sides. Carport enclosure reclassifies structure as garage requiring 6 metre front setback; structure set back only 0.3 metres. Applicant argued security concerns due to car break-ins and pedestrian thoroughfare to freeway footbridge/train station. Council found proposal contravenes Residential Design Guidelines and R Codes, presents loss of visual permeability and blank facade adverse to streetscape amenity and continuity. Applicant advised solid door must be removed but Council would consider see-through iron doors/gates as alternative.

motions.title: Two-storey single residence, Penryn Avenue, City Beach
motions.description: Application for building approval for a two storey dwelling at Lot 213 (No.14) Penryn Avenue, City Beach. The site is zoned Residential R12.5. The application includes variations to side setbacks (lower floor and upper floor) and privacy standards for balconies and windows. Objections were received from adjoining neighbours regarding privacy and overshadowing.

motions.title: Two storey residence with basement garage, Windarra Drive, City Beach
motions.description: Application for preliminary building approval for a two storey residence with basement garage at Lot 40 (No.41) Windarra Drive, corner of Yaringa Way, City Beach. The site is zoned Residential R12.5 (Windarra Height Precinct). The application includes variations to secondary street setback and front/secondary street fencing, seeking approval for solid brick boundary walls.

motions.title: Single dwelling with undercroft, Tumut Road, City Beach
motions.description: Application for building/planning approval for a single dwelling (two storey with undercroft) at Lot 339 (No.6) Tumut Road, corner Windarra Drive, City Beach. The site is zoned Residential R12.5. The application includes variations to rear setback, front setback (stairs), privacy setback for living room, and retains an existing 1.8 metre high solid brick wall on front and secondary street boundaries.

motions.title: Second storey addition, Halesworth Road, Jolimont
motions.description: Application for planning/building approval for additions and alterations to a single dwelling (second storey) at Lot 69 (No.34) Halesworth Road, Jolimont. The site is zoned Residential R20. The application includes variations to side setback (upper floor north), building height, and privacy provision for balcony. Objections were received from both adjoining neighbours regarding privacy, overlooking, and overshadowing.

motions.title: Lot 116 Clune Avenue West Leederville - dwelling additions
motions.description: Application for additions and alterations to a dwelling (two storey) at Lot 116 (No.35) Clune Avenue, West Leederville, submitted by Archiplan. The development was originally approved on 28 November 1995, and this application seeks approval for further additions including a new laundry and front verandah/balcony.

motions.title: Lot 247 Baramba Road City Beach - dwelling additions
motions.description: Application for a second storey addition to a single dwelling at Lot 247 (No.3) Baramba Road, City Beach, submitted by I and S Kidd. The proposal includes an off-white colorbond roof and a variation to the permitted height (7.2 metres vs. 6.5 metres permitted).

motions.title: Lot 20 Coldstream Street West Leederville - dwelling additions
motions.description: Application for a second storey addition to the existing residence at Lot 20 (No.24) Coldstream Street (cnr Antrim Street), West Leederville. The residence is to be re-orientated toward Coldstream Street with a new second storey addition and portico.

motions.description: Application for construction of a double carport at Lot 1092 (No.29) Kinross Crescent, Floreat, with changes to the facade of the residence including a rendered finish and replacement of windows. A setback variation from 9 metres to 2.7 metres is sought.

motions.title: Lot 1092 Kinross Crescent Floreat - double carport (foreshadowed motion)
motions.description: Foreshadowed motion to approve the double carport application as submitted, after the original motion with conditions was lost.

motions.description: Application for construction of an ensuite, store and double carport at Lot 1650 (No.4) Bantry Road, Floreat, submitted by Modern Home Improvers. The carport is to be located on the side boundary within the front setback area, 0.7 metres from the primary street boundary.

motions.description: Foreshadowed motion to approve the application as submitted.

motions.title: Lot 231 Gregory Street Wembley - double garage
motions.description: Application for construction of a double garage at Lot 231 (No.69) Gregory Street, Wembley, located off a 4.5 metre right of way. The garage is to be located on the side boundary (south) with 67 Gregory Street.

motions.title: Wembley Hotel three flag poles approval
motions.description: Planning approval sought for three flag poles at Wembley Hotel, Lot 7 (No 344) Cambridge Street, Wembley. Poles proposed at 7 metres height attached to hotel front wall fence piers; flags 2.4 metres long by 0.8 metres wide (1.92 square metres each). Non-compliant with Policy Manual standards (max 6 metres height, max 2 poles per 20 metres frontage, max 1.5 square metres per flag). Council found proposal adds character to streetscape, consistent with Wembley Town Centre Study recommendations for high profile locations, complements hotel as focal point. Approval granted by absolute majority subject to flag size condition limiting to 1.5 square metres maximum.

motions.title: Lot 681 Holland Street Wembley - carport roof extension
motions.description: Application for additional roofing to an existing carport at Lot 681 (No.100) Holland Street, Wembley. The carport currently has piers on the boundary and the roof is set back 0.78 metres from the side boundary which the owner proposes to cover.

motions.title: Lot 5 Hovea Crescent City Beach - colorbond shed
motions.description: Application for a colorbond shed at Lot 5 (No.5) Hovea Crescent, City Beach. The applicant proposes a 45 square metre colorbond shed (merino/beige colour), with a 50 pitched gable roof and 2.4 metres in height, located at the rear of the lot.

motions.title: Floreat Beach Upgrade
motions.description: Report on the progress of the Floreat Beach Redevelopment project. Seeks Council endorsement of the picnic shelter design and other design elements prior to proceeding to tender. Includes detailed design proposals for lighting, playground equipment, shade shelters, paving, pathways, trees, podium, lookout, rubbish bins, benches, water fonts, barbeques, anti-graffiti coating, logo design, entry statements, and colour scheme.

motions.title: Town Planning Scheme Amendment No.2 - Final Adoption
motions.description: Final adoption of Scheme Amendment No.2 for the planning approval for single dwellings and ancillary outbuildings. The amendment was advertised for 42 days from 6 November to 17 December 1999. Two submissions were received from the Housing Industry Association (HIA) and Ministry for Housing, both objecting to the proposed amendment. The report reviews submissions and recommends final adoption.

motions.title: Lot 139 St Vincents Avenue home occupation approval
motions.description: Retrospective planning approval sought for home occupation (Computer Consultant and Personal Growth Facilitator) at Lot 139 (No 16) St Vincents Avenue, West Leederville. Applicant P Graham operates registered business as computer consultant conducting work mostly internet/e-commerce context, contracted to TEDIS Pty Ltd working part-time from home office, and part-time personal growth facilitator work. Floor area of business 16.5 square metres. Average 3-4 clients per week, mostly one-on-one sessions 1.5 to 2 hours duration, before 10pm. Ample parking available. No neighbour complaints received. Council found operation small scale and compatible with surrounding residential uses given 3-year operating history without complaints, consistent with Home Occupation Policy aims.

motions.title: City Beach High School international school development - APPROVED with conditions
motions.description: Application for planning approval on MRS Reserve for international school, student accommodation, theatre, teaching block and sports pavilion at City Beach High School, Reserve 29923 Kalinda Drive, City Beach (10.6 hectares). International day and boarding school offering curriculum grades 6-10, projected 240 students (half boarders) for 2001. Proposed residential units (two storey, blocks of 3-6) accommodating 8 students and 1 tutor per unit. Students not permitted to own cars; tutors allocated one space, two visitor bays per three units. Total 105 additional parking bays. Three phases: Phase 1 - 21 residential units; Phase 2 - 21 residential units/performing arts centre; Phase 3 - 21 residential units/teaching block/sports pavilion. Development would provide underutilised school continued use. Council expressed concern regarding potential impact on local school viability; requested WAPC investigate this matter. Condition requires landscaping plan prior to building licence issue.

motions.title: Lot 339 Pangbourne Street aged persons housing - REFUSED
motions.description: Application for planning approval for three single storey aged persons dwellings (over 55 residences) at Lot 339 (No 16) Pangbourne Street, Wembley (951 square metres). R20 zoning permits two grouped dwellings. Applicant seeks approval for three units exercising 50% density bonus available under R Codes for aged persons dwellings. Units range 152-177 square metres with two bedrooms plus all-purpose room potential. Non-compliances include: primary street setback 5.89 metres (required 6), carport setback 1.515 metres (required 2), open space 49% (required 50%), private open space 81 square metres per dwelling (required 150), paving 77% of front setback (guideline 40%). Council found units not designed as special purpose for aged persons, lacking wheelchair access features, and development out of character with low density R20 residential area. Recommendation refused due to built form inconsistent with locality and failure to meet aged persons policy design criteria.

motions.title: Lots 5 and 6 Cambridge Street five residences preliminary building approval
motions.description: Preliminary building approval sought for five two-storey single residences on corner Cambridge Street and Marlow Street, Wembley (Lots 5 and 6, No 366 A-E). Landowner Roman Catholic Archbishop of Perth. Lots created following amalgamation and subdivision of lot adjoining Our Lady of Victories Roman Catholic Church. Five lots total: 4 lots of 220 square metres, 1 lot of 221 square metres. Each residence comprises living room, dining area, kitchen, laundry and double garage ground floor; three bedrooms, bathroom and ensuite upper floor. Garages built to side boundary with nil setback; rear accessway access. Church (Municipal Inventory listed, to be retained); presbytery to be demolished.

motions.title: Additional grouped dwellings, Keane Street, Wembley
motions.description: Application for an additional grouped dwelling (two storey) at Lot 2 (No. 30) Keane Street, corner of Ruislip Street, Wembley. The site is zoned Residential R20. The proposal involves constructing one additional two storey dwelling and retaining the existing single storey residence, in accordance with Council's corner lot policy for R20 coded areas.

motions.title: Grouped dwelling, Herdsman Parade, Wembley
motions.description: Application for a grouped dwelling (two storey) at Lot 1781 (No.86) Herdsman Parade, corner of Jersey Street, Wembley. The site is zoned Residential R20. The proposal involves constructing one grouped dwelling with the existing single storey residence retained, in accordance with Council's corner lot policy. The application includes variations to side setbacks and front setback requirements.

motions.title: Single residence with variations, Sellenger Court, City Beach
motions.description: Application for preliminary building approval for a single residence (two-storey) at Lot 124 (No. 2) Sellenger Court, City Beach. The site is zoned Residential R12.5. The dwelling is designed in three levels to accommodate the steep slope of the site. The application includes significant variations to primary street setback, open space, carport location, retaining walls and paving.

motions.title: Adopt Local Government Statutory Compliance Assessment Return 1999
motions.description: Council considered the Local Government Statutory Compliance Assessment Return for the period 1 January to 31 December 1999, as required by the Department of Local Government. The 1999 Return was noted as the last voluntary return; from January 2000 there is a legal requirement to annually complete such returns. The completed return was attached to the notice paper.

motions.title: Confirm Delegated Authority Decisions - Christmas Recess 1999/2000
motions.description: Council considered a report noting action taken over the Christmas recess 1999/2000 in accordance with delegated powers given to the Chief Executive Officer on 21 December 1999. Two items were dealt with: a proposed single dwelling application at Lot 35 (No. 120A) Kimberley Street, West Leederville, which was approved; and approval for the Western Australian Tourism Commission to hold a launch event at Lake Monger with matched grant funding for environmental works.

motions.title: Endorse Prospectus for Single Association of Local Government in WA
motions.description: Council considered advice from the Western Australian Municipal Association (WAMA) regarding a proposal to form a single Association of Local Government in Western Australia. A discussion paper developed from an options paper previously circulated was finalised and endorsed for distribution to member Local Governments. WAMA requested feedback by 3 March 2000, with a final report anticipated for the August 2000 AGM of relevant associations.

motions.title: Perry Lakes Stadium Redevelopment - Deferred for Internal Workshop
motions.description: Council considered a comprehensive report on the future use of Perry Lakes Stadium and associated sporting facilities. A Joint Working Group comprising council and state government representatives had met three times and progressed investigations. The report detailed proposals for relocation of athletics, rugby, and basketball facilities, rezoning of the stadium site, bridging finance arrangements, and delegated authority for a development committee. During discussion, council members agreed to defer consideration pending an internal workshop on the matter.

motions.title: Approve Town of Cambridge Enterprise Bargaining Agreements 2000
motions.description: Council considered and approved Enterprise Bargaining Agreements (EBA) for the Town's Salaried Officers and Outside Workers, following negotiations over six to ten months. A secret ballot conducted 3 February 2000 resulted in 78 votes in favour and 6 against for the Salaried Officers Agreement, and 13 in favour and 19 against for the Outside Workers Agreement. The agreements provided wage increases, workplace flexibility, sick leave incentives, effectiveness indicators, and multi-skilling provisions over a two-year period with total financial implications of $494,000.

motions.title: Nominate Councillor to Attend ENVIRO 2000 Conference
motions.description: Council considered nominations for attendance at ENVIRO 2000, the first integrated environment event combining five Australian Waste Convention, Odour Conference, Watertech Conference, and Australian Greenhouse Conference, to be held at Sydney Convention and Exhibition Centre from 9 to 13 April 2000 at an approximate cost of $2,555. Cr MacRae was nominated during discussion.

motions.title: Nominate Mayor, CEO and Executive Manager to IMM National Congress
motions.description: Council considered attendance at the Institute of Municipal Management (IMM) National Congress 'InterActive 2000' to be held at Melbourne Convention Centre commencing 28 May 2000. The Congress provides 30 sessions covering management, governance, and interactive streams, recognised as a quality congress internationally. The Chief Executive Officer is a past State and Federal President of IMM. The recommendation was amended during committee discussion to include the Mayor and an Executive Manager selected by the CEO.

motions.title: Town of Cambridge Playground Management Plan
motions.description: Receipt and adoption of Playground Management Plan with recommendations for playground equipment replacement and management

motions.title: Perth Main Sewer Replacement – Section 3
motions.description: Receipt of report on Perth Main Sewer Stage 3 replacement works to be undertaken by Transfield Pty Ltd on behalf of Water Corporation

motions.title: The Boulevard/Grantham Street – Designs
motions.description: Approval of detailed designs for upgrading The Boulevard and Grantham Street/Kirkdale Avenue intersection, including traffic signal and roundabout designs

motions.title: The Boulevard and Grantham Street – Street Enhancements
motions.description: Approval of development plans for The Boulevard from Durston Road to Empire Avenue and Grantham Street from The Boulevard to Selby Street, including median island and intersection treatments.
