motions.description: Reception and advertisement of plans for upgrading of Howtree Place, a District Distributor Road providing access to Floreat Forum and Floreat Primary School, with median island and tree planting.

motions.title: Seymour Avenue – Traffic Management Strategy
motions.description: Reception of Connell Wagner traffic management strategy report for precinct bounded by Grantham Street/Selby Street and The Boulevard, with staged implementation of recommendations.

motions.title: Oceanic Drive/Howtree Place/Brookdale Street Intersection – Traffic Review
motions.description: Assessment of options and program to improve safety at intersection listed on Federal Black Spot Program, with recommendation to engage consultants for funding submission.

motions.title: Selby Street/Grantham Street, Herdsman Parade – Traffic Management
motions.description: Assessment of options to improve safety at intersections listed on Federal Black Spot Program, with recommendations for signs, lines, and directional signage.

motions.title: Powis Street – Lake Monger Carpark Access
motions.description: Conditional approval for design of carpark access at Powis Street/Lake Monger with traffic management for approximately 128 cars and four buses.

motions.title: Grantham Street/Jersey Street – Black Spot Intersection Treatment Trial
motions.description: Deferral of community traffic survey for traffic management options in residential precincts bounded by Herdsman Parade, Harborne Street, Cambridge Street and Selby Street, to enable workshop with Wembley Ward Councillors.

motions.title: Nash Street/Nicholson Road/Railway Road intersection re-phasing
motions.description: Advice on proposed road works at the intersection of Nicholson Road and Railway Road in the City of Subiaco and development of a position regarding the upgrading when the Shenton Park Traffic Transport Study is complete.

motions.title: Alexander Street kerbside parking restriction
motions.description: Establishment of a one hour kerbside parking restriction on the western side of Alexander Street in Wembley to address patron parking from adjacent shopping and hotel businesses.

motions.title: Mitchell Freeway on/off ramps road closure
motions.description: Completion of formalities associated with road closures for old freeway access ramps between Lake Monger Drive and the Mitchell Freeway, to be designated for Parks and Recreation.

motions.title: Waste management video not supported
motions.description: Proposal to develop a waste recycling video for distribution to residents in conjunction with other councils, seeking Council support for commitment of up to $10,000. The Committee did not support the recommendation.

motions.title: Container Deposit Legislation support
motions.description: Establishment of a Town of Cambridge position supporting the introduction of Container Deposit Legislation in Western Australia to encourage recycling.

motions.title: Environmental Management Plans for Bold Park areas
motions.description: Approval to engage consultants to prepare Environmental Management Plans for lands adjacent to Bold Park (Quarry Amphitheatre, Bold Park Pool, and The Boulevard Quarry Park) and acceptance of proponent responsibilities.

motions.title: Garden Competition Awards operation review
motions.description: Review of the Town of Cambridge Garden Competition Awards operation to encourage greater resident participation, with changes to automatic entry system and funding allocation.

motions.title: Lake Monger Reserve tree planting strategies
motions.description: Identification and prioritisation of twelve future tree planting strategies within Lake Monger Reserve to be included in the Lake Monger Reserve Improvement Program.

motions.title: Road Funding Model for Five-Year Capital Works Program
motions.description: Council considered a report providing background data for the development of the 2000/2001 Budget for Works and Engineering under Asset Management and Capital Projects. The report reviewed Asset Management Programs for laneways, road resurfacing, and footpaths, with expenditure levels previously increased. It proposed a five-year road program framework with specific funding allocations across projects including Boulevard/Grantham Street works, Black Spot programs, District Distributor Road upgrading, Traffic Management, Road Intersection Issues, and School Parking and traffic calming.

motions.title: Parks and Landscape Budget 2000/2001 with Service Improvements
motions.description: Council considered a report providing background information for the development of the Parks and Landscape Budget for 2000/2001 under Operating and Capital Works headings. The report detailed existing funding levels for maintenance of ocean beaches, sportsgrounds, parks, road reserves, street trees, and Wembley Golf Complex. It recommended continuing current service levels while providing improved funding for Street Trees Management, Playground Management, Park Trees Management, Remnant Bushland Management, and Road Reserves Maintenance, requiring an additional Technical Officer position.

motions.title: Wembley Underground Power Pilot Project surplus funds allocation
motions.description: Finalisation report on Wembley Underground Power Pilot Project completed March 1999. Project achieved cost savings of $1,076,000 with total project costs of $3,049,000 against $4 million budget. Council received $358,666 one-third refund plus $64,522 surplus held, totalling $423,188 project surplus. After deducting $96,277 additional costs not included in joint costs, unallocated surplus is $326,911. Report discusses options: refund property owners, undertake streetscape improvements, remove stay wires on transmission lines, or combination. Initial deferral requested investigation of stay wire removal costs. Further report notes Minister advised work beyond project scope and State unable to provide funding; Western Power estimate $13,400 investigation cost plus approximately $60,000 per location for freestanding poles. Committee motion to use surplus for works lapsed for want of seconder.

motions.description: Authorisation for Chief Executive Officer and elected member to attend the IMM Seventeenth National Congress in Canberra, 16-20 May 1998, with amendment to specify Mayor attendance.

motions.description: Response to Local Area Education Plan for Western Suburbs Senior High Schools, recommending retention of City Beach SHS based on enrolment growth, local student numbers, retention rates, and specialized programs.

motions.description: Application for building licence for additional grouped dwelling with variations to setbacks and private open space requirements.

motions.title: Refuse application - Preliminary Building Licence (46 St Leonards Avenue)
motions.description: Application for additions and renovations to existing residential dwelling at Lot 332, No. 46 St Leonards Avenue, West Leederville. Non-compliance with Council Policy No. 13 – Plot Ratio and Residential Planning Codes in relation to side setback and open space provisions.

motions.title: Election of Presiding Member
motions.description: Election of Presiding Member of the Policy and Administration Committee for May to October 1998.

motions.title: Refusal of Consulting Rooms Application - Niola Hospital
motions.description: Motion to refuse an application by Greg Rowe and Associates Pty Ltd on behalf of owners E J Bevan and C S Coyne for consulting rooms at Lots 5 and 4 (Nos. 10 and 12) Abbotsford Street, West Leederville. The application is opposed because the uses proposed are prohibited under Town Planning Scheme No. 1. The motion includes serving notices requiring cessation of office, consulting room and hospital uses, and removal of a temporary transportable used for patient accommodation at Nos. 61-69 Cambridge Street. The application represents an ad hoc expansion of commercial activities beyond appropriately zoned areas.

motions.title: Western Suburbs Highway Fighting Fund Contribution
motions.description: Motion to include $10,000 in the 1998/99 budget as the Town's contribution to a Western Suburbs Highway fighting fund. The fund is being developed by the Mayors' Steering Committee to provide a cohesive approach by local governments along the 40km highway length (from Innaloo to Rockingham) to work with the State Government on highway construction. An amendment to reduce the amount to $5,000 was moved but lost.

motions.title: Transform WA Initiative - Transport Policy Response
motions.description: Motion noting the Western Australian government's Transform WA initiative and expressing Council's views on transport policy. The Council reaffirms its support for a modern, efficient and environmentally friendly network of transport options, expresses disappointment at the lack of public consultation, criticises the overwhelming emphasis on buses and lack of emphasis on other commuter options, and advocates for greater emphasis on rail transport solutions.

motions.title: Appointment to WAMA - National Parks and Nature Conservation Authority
motions.description: Nomination of Cr McConnell as a WAMA Member to the National Parks and Nature Conservation Authority. The position is for a one-year term, meeting monthly at CALM, Hackett Drive, Crawley. Nominations close with WAMA on Monday 18 May 1998.

motions.title: Underground Power Program - Staging Approval
motions.description: Urgent business item regarding the staging of underground power installation throughout the Town of Cambridge. A submission must be prepared by 30 April 1998 for the State Government's Underground Power Steering Committee. The revised staging proposes five stages covering approximately 5,600 lots total. Amendment 1 swapped the priority of Floreat North West and Wembley West stages. Amendment 2 added a clause requiring contact with adjoining councils regarding coverage of Mt Claremont, Jolimont and Daglish portions.

motions.title: 1998/99 Budget and Special Meetings
motions.description: Confidential item regarding the 1998/99 budget. Administration requested to incorporate Council amendments for further consideration in May 1998. Two special meetings scheduled: one for Council on 5 May 1998 at 5:30pm to consider the budget, and one for Development and Environmental Services Committee on 7 May 1998 at 5:30pm to consider the Coastal Planning Study.

motions.title: Graffiti Removal Program

Committee recommended reduced budget allocation of $6,000 instead of initial $12,000 proposal, and deferred clauses regarding regional approach and policy review until audit completed.

motions.title: Property Services - Minor Purchases and Works
motions.description: Approval for additional minor capital works projects at Wembley Golf Complex and 26 Yannigan Crescent using surplus funds of $13,216 from completed 1997/98 projects. Works include replacement of gutters and downpipes at golf course curator's house, exterior painting to main building, and purchase of seatainer for storage of recycled building materials.

motions.title: Sir Thomas Meagher Pavilion Lease to Kings Park Board
motions.description: Lease of Suite D (275 square metres) in Sir Thomas Meagher Pavilion at Perry Lakes Stadium to Kings Park Board for management of Bold Park. Lease term of one year with one year option at $11,000 per annum plus outgoings, payable monthly at $916.66.

motions.title: Lot 302 Lake Monger Drive West Leederville Subdivision Refusal
motions.description: Proposed subdivision of Lot 302 into two lots at rear Clune Avenue, West Leederville. Applicant Brown McAllister Pty Ltd seeking approval to vary minimum lot size requirement under Residential Planning Codes. Proposal does not comply with R20 zone minimum lot size (450 sq m) or rear setback requirements.

motions.title: Niola Private Hospital - Administrative and Therapeutic Uses on Abbotsford Street
motions.description: Application by Greg Rowe and Associates on behalf of owners E J Bevan and C S Coyne for planning approval to use Lots 5 (No. 10) and Lot 4 (No. 12) Abbotsford Street, West Leederville for various administrative, consulting and therapeutic activities associated with Niola Private Hospital. Sites zoned Residential R60. Administration initially recommended refusal. Committee deferred motion for further report to determine how Council might permit continued use with specific conditions.

motions.title: Lot 16 Kimberley Street West Leederville Subdivision Refusal
motions.description: Proposed subdivision of Lot 16 (No. 129) Kimberley Street, West Leederville from 607 square metres into three lots of 202 square metres each. Applicants R J and J P Wilson. Zoning Residential R40 requiring average lot size of 220 square metres, but proposal only 202 square metres. Council policy adopted February 1998 excluded 10% variation for densities above R20.

motions.title: Lot 189 Alexander Street Wembley Grouped Dwellings Approval
motions.description: Application by Golden Era Homes for two single storey grouped dwellings at Lot 189 (No. 37) Alexander Street, Wembley. Plot ratio 0.41:1, open space 50%, private open space 176 square metres average per dwelling. Non-compliances with rear and side setbacks and setback between buildings. Adjoining neighbours consulted and do not object. Approval by absolute majority required due to variations sought.

motions.description: Application for proposed additions and alterations to single residential dwelling (two storey) at Lot 34 (No.13) Elimatta Way, City Beach. motions.description: Application for proposed additions and alterations (two level) to existing dwelling at Lot 475, No.41 McKenzie Street, Wembley. Includes family/dining room, carport, two bedrooms and bathroom. Applicant seeks approval for side setback variations and side wall highlight window.

motions.title: Approve Restaurant - Lot 3 The Boulevard, City Beach
motions.description: Application for Planning Approval to use one of the tenancies at new shopping centre at 316 The Boulevard, City Beach as a Restaurant and Take Away Food outlet. Tenancy 4 is the largest tenancy directly abutting main entry plaza, offering 40 customer seats. Minor variation to car parking standards required (11 bays proposed vs. 13 required).

motions.title: Refuse office extension - Lots 1 and 580 Grantham Street, Wembley
motions.description: Application for extension to existing vacant shop premises (granted conditional Planning Approval for office use) by 79 square metres at corner of Grantham and Keane Streets, Wembley. motions.title: Approve patio - Lot 3 Kimberley Street, West Leederville

motions.title: Adopt Interim Delegation Policy - Town Planning Scheme No 1
motions.description: Motion to adopt interim delegation policy following gazettal of Town of Cambridge Town Planning Scheme No 1 on 31 March 1998. Policy sets out matters that may be determined by Chief Executive Officer (or nominated representative) versus those presented to Council. Delegation policy cannot be finalised until Scheme Policy Manual review is completed.

motions.title: Write to Minister opposing planning appeal amendments
motions.description: Motion to write to Minister for Planning, State Members of Parliament, and Opposition Spokesperson regarding opposition to amendments to Town Planning and Development Act 1928 to introduce right of appeal against decision of Local Authority not to initiate amendment to Town Planning Scheme. WA Municipal Association opposes proposal.

This matter was previously considered in August 1996 and deferred for reconsideration within 12 months. The proposal has been discussed by the Committee.

motions.title: Closure of Private Street - Dodd Street and Walker Street, Wembley
motions.description: Application to initiate closure procedures for a private street (right of way) between Dodd Street and Walker Street, Wembley, comprising approximately 470 square metres. The closure is sought to enhance security of adjoining owners and alleviate disputes about maintenance. The laneway is unsealed but well maintained. Eight properties abut the laneway.

motions.title: Subiaco Redevelopment - Harborne Street Extension Response
motions.description: Response to Subiaco Redevelopment Authority regarding a subdivision application and the extension of Harborne Street from Roydhouse Street to Hood Street, creating seven new lots. The Town had previously opposed the Harborne Street extension through to Roberts Road. The proposal is consistent with the redevelopment plan but the Town has ongoing concerns about traffic impacts.

motions.title: Outcome of Legal Action - Illegal Building at 50 Simper Street
motions.description: Report on the outcome of legal proceedings against [private individual — name withheld] of 50 Simper Street, Wembley for contravention of the Local Government (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act 1960. The case was heard on 30 March 1998 before Magistrate Malley. [private individual — name withheld] entered a plea of guilty. The magistrate found her guilty and imposed a fine of $400, ordered costs of $649, and ordered removal of the illegal structure within 56 days.

One appeal determined by the Minister for Planning (upheld).

motions.description: Proposal by Town of Cambridge to extend northern boundary into City of Stirling following Local Government Advisory Board assessment by consultant [private individual — name withheld].

motions.description: Report on proposed four-day work placement program for Philippines local government officials attending Curtin University workshop on revenue raising and financial management.

motions.description: Review of verge parking restriction in Abbotsford Street, West Leederville, following business owner concerns. Original restriction imposed in October 1997.

motions.description: Modification of existing parking restrictions at intersection of Blencowe Street and Railway Parade to improve safety and address visibility and congestion issues

motions.title: Bournville Street/Alexander Street pedestrian refuge islands
motions.description: Provision of pedestrian refuge islands in Bournville Street to assist pedestrians crossing and control turning movements at intersection with Alexander Street, as part of Wembley Primary School safe routes project

motions.description: Implementation of safe routes measures for pedestrians and cyclists accessing Wembley Primary School, including dual use path, plateau, carpark footpath, and consultation with education facilities

motions.description: Request to reinstate verge at redundant parking embayment site. Matter deferred to obtain further information regarding responsibility for reinstatement agreed at time of original subdivision.

motions.description: Council contribution for construction of dual use path on Rochdale Road between McClemans Road and Teslin Road as part of Perth Bicycle Network Program 1998/99

motions.description: Upgrade of street lighting in Cambridge Street vicinity of Wembley Hotel and JB O'Reilly's Tavern, following October 1997 council request for investigation of poor lighting

motions.description: Status update on Lake Monger Sewer Upgrade rehabilitation works and proposals for vesting of old freeway on-ramp area to Council

motions.title: Accept tender for passenger shelter management
motions.description: The Town of Cambridge manages 100 passenger shelters with ongoing maintenance costs of approximately $20,000 per annum. Four tenders were received. Rainbow Neon Signs is the preferred tenderer as a local company using local products at advantageous price. The five-year contract runs from 1 August 1997 to 31 July 2002 with an option to extend for another five years. The proposal includes supply and installation of 25 illuminated shelters and 25 seats, maintenance of all shelters, and a net income of $241,900 to the Town over five years.

motions.title: Serve notice to cease vehicle storage use

The property is informally leased to an adjoining service station (Gull Service Station) for vehicle storage. The use has caused complaints regarding visual impact and noise disturbance. The Water Corporation has been advised to seek approval but was unable to secure commitment from the lessee.

motions.title: Approve private street closure with land apportionment

The Body Corporate of Units 1-4 at No.3 Dodd Street requested closure for maintenance responsibility and security reasons. Three residential properties are affected. Land apportionment: majority to applicant for vehicular access to parking, with 1 metre to No.1 Dodd Street for pedestrian access, and a small portion to No.4 Herdsman Parade.

motions.title: Refuse rezoning request for Grantham Street
motions.description: The Grantham Action Group petitioned Council on 23 September 1997 to rezone properties fronting Grantham Street, Floreat (between The Boulevard and Selby Street) from Residential R12.5 to either Residential R40 or Commercial, ostensibly as compensation if Grantham Street remains an Important Regional Road. Approximately 90 properties would be affected. The rezoning proposal lacks planning merit and would conflict with the single residential character of Floreat as intended in the draft Town Planning Scheme.

motions.title: Receive coastal planning study progress report
motions.description: The Coastal Planning Study, conducted by CoastWise consultants appointed in June 1997, is progressing towards completion of a draft report. Community participation has been extensive, including two public meetings with over 100 attendees each and formation of a Community Liaison Group. The draft report is due at the end of October 1997 for November consideration. A meeting with the consultant is proposed for 6 November 1997 at 5.30pm. Public advertising is scheduled for December-January, with final report consideration in February 1998.

motions.title: Adopt draft Residential Design Guidelines
motions.description: The draft Residential Design Guidelines have been refined following comments from a Councillor workshop held 30 September 1997. Eighteen specific refinements have been made to clauses relating to setbacks, carports, garages, fencing, balconies, and other design matters across various residential precincts. The Guidelines are to be advertised for 28 days with public consultation including display material, resident brochures, and newspaper notices.

motions.title: Delegated Authority – Unrecoverable Debt Written Off

motions.title: Joan Watters Occasional Care Service Discontinuation
motions.description: Consideration of options for the future operation of the Wembley Occasional Care Centre due to ongoing operational losses and low attendance levels.

motions.title: Joan Watters Occasional Care Amendment

motions.title: Ice Cream Vendor Licence Lake Monger Reserve Referral
motions.description: Referral of the ice cream and drink vendor licence item for further consideration regarding performance criteria and tender acceptance conditions.

motions.title: Library Strategic Planning Exercise Endorsement
motions.description: Endorsement of methodology for strategic planning exercise for Library and Information Services and budget allocation for consultant appointment.

motions.title: Sports Grounds and Reserves Fees and Charges
motions.description: Adoption of proposed fees and charges for sports grounds and reserves for the 1997/98 financial year, effective from 1 July 1997.

motions.title: Halls and Community Centres Fees and Charges
motions.description: Adoption of proposed fees and charges for halls and community centres for the 1997/98 financial year, effective from 1 July 1997.

motions.title: Miscellaneous Fees and Charges
motions.description: Adoption of proposed miscellaneous fees and charges for 1997/98 financial year, including increased dog seizure and shopping trolley impounding fees, and electoral information fees, effective from 1 July 1997.

motions.title: Respite and Children's Services Fees and Charges
motions.description: Adoption of proposed fees and charges for respite and children's services for 1997/98, effective from 31 July 1997, including unchanged day centre and in-home respite fees, and revised vacation care and getaways fees.

motions.title: Cambridge Sporting Association Formation and Lease Fee Waiver
motions.description: Endorsement of the formation of the Cambridge Sporting Association at City Beach Pavilion, waiver of initial annual lease fee in first year, and approval of lease agreement oversight with specified performance criteria.

motions.title: Plan of Principal Activities 1997-2002 Adoption
motions.description: Council considered the Plan of Principal Activities for 1997-2002 following 42-day public submission period. Four submissions received from ratepayer associations. Amendment proposed regarding Underground Power Program expenditure reduction from $6 million to $1.5 million.

motions.title: Undergrounding of Power Report Reception and Assessment
motions.description: Underground power project accepted by government with reduced scope. Preliminary costing prepared but remains confidential pending accurate details. Discussion document covers project program, customer liaison, financial issues, funding options, street lighting, and immediate priorities. Council to assess funding options and provide recommendation for June 1997 meeting.

motions.title: Light Vehicle Fleet Tender Award - Houghton Ford
motions.description: Tender assessment for supply, delivery and maintenance of light vehicle fleet. Two submissions received. Houghton Ford offers five-year contract with initial changeover cost and cash back on subsequent changeovers at 9000km/5 months intervals for sales taxable vehicles.

motions.title: Unit 3 100 Salvado Road Wembley - Home occupation office
motions.description: Application for Home Occupation to use a room as an office for an engineering consultancy business.

motions.title: 5 Nicholson Street Leederville - Home occupation office
motions.description: Application for Home Occupation to use a room as an office for a management consultancy business.

motions.title: 13 Tor Place City Beach - Home occupation computer repairs
motions.description: Application for Home Occupation to operate a computer repairs and upgrades business from a room of parent's residence.

motions.title: Lots 19 and 20 79 Woolwich Street West Leederville - Church conversion and residences
motions.description: Proposed demolition of church hall, construction of two single dwellings, and use of existing church as residence and office.

motions.title: Lot 427 67 Marlow Street Wembley - Front boundary wall
motions.description: Application for approval of rendered solid front wall of 1.8 metre height along front strata boundary.

motions.title: 21 Bendigo Way City Beach - Two storey residence
motions.description: Application for preliminary approval for a two storey residence with front setback variations.

motions.title: 103 Lake Monger Drive Wembley - Additions to existing residence
motions.description: Application for additions and renovations to existing residence including upper storey addition.

motions.title: Lot 1372 95 Essex Street Wembley - Side setback variation for garage
motions.description: Application for approval to construct a double garage at the rear of existing residence with nil side setback variation.

motions.title: 19 Jubilee Crescent alterations and additions approval
motions.description: Application for preliminary building licence for alterations and additions to an existing two storey residence at 19 Jubilee Crescent, City Beach. Previous similar application was refused in March 1997. Current proposal includes modifications to address neighbour objections regarding eastern side setback, privacy, overshadowing, and glare.

motions.title: Allowance for Cr Anderton to participate despite declared interest
motions.description: Motion to allow Councillor Anderton to participate in discussions and decision making on the 19 Jubilee Crescent application despite her ownership of the property to the rear

motions.title: 138 Railway Parade advertising billboard/roof sign refusal
motions.description: Application for planning consent for an advertising billboard/roof sign to be attached to the front wall of a two storey commercial building at 138 Railway Parade, West Leederville. Proposed sign dimensions 3250mm height by 12660mm length, projecting 1800mm above roofline. Does not comply with Council Policy No. 1 - Roof Signs.

motions.title: After Hours Noise Service Policy amendment
motions.description: Report on the after hours noise control service following committee request to investigate registration of offending properties. Proposed addition of clause for registration of specific large events likely to cause noise nuisance and establishment of register of offenders and re-offenders.

motions.title: Dangerous building notice confirmation at 130 Tower Street
motions.description: Confirmation of action taken by Chief Executive Officer under delegated authority in issuing a Notice under Section 403 of the Local Government (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act 1960 for dangerous building at 130 Tower Street, Leederville. Building damaged by fire with structural instability requiring owner to repair, secure or demolish.

motions.title: Mosquito and Non-Biting Midge Control Research Project partnership
motions.description: Partnership with Water Corporation for mosquito and non-biting midge control research project using physical methods of aeration and irrigation to disrupt insect breeding. Council contribution of $10,000 requested. Project duration 15-18 months involving artificial pond-scale experiment, pilot-scale experiment at Mary Carroll Park lake, and whole-lake experiment in 1998. Lake Monger and Perry lakes proposed for final phase.

motions.title: Delegated decisions and notifications report
motions.description: Report on delegated decisions and notifications for period ending 30 April 1997. Subdivision approved under delegated authority. Appeals received and determined including decision on Lots 44-46 Cambridge Street (offices, shops and fast food outlet) and Lot 1407 Nanson Street (carport and front fence). Amendment No. 2 to Town Planning Scheme granted Ministerial approval.

motions.title: Building licences approved under delegated authority
motions.description: Report on building licences approved during April 1997. Total of 30 building licences with combined value of $1,949,688 approved. Also approved one sign licence, three preliminary building licences and nine demolition licences. Comparative figures provided for April 1996 and year-to-date.

motions.title: Wembley Town Centre Planning Study brief adoption
motions.description: Adoption of preliminary brief for Wembley Town Centre Planning Study. Study focuses on enhancement of Wembley shopping strip through streetscape and traffic management improvements. Key issues include urban design, movement/traffic management, and pedestrian circulation. Budget $20-30,000. Study brief was deferred at April 1997 meeting; reconsidered following developments affecting critical site (Lots 44-46 Cambridge Street).

motions.title: WA Planning Commission Metropolitan Centres Policy submission
motions.description: Council submission on draft revised WA Planning Commission policy on Metropolitan Centres. Policy aims to ensure orderly development of retail and commercial activities in metropolitan area. Key issues discussed include Floreat Forum (District Centre), West Leederville commercial areas, and competition between centres. Public submissions period closes 20 June 1997.

motions.title: Amendment to Metropolitan Centres Policy submission motion
motions.description: Proposed amendment to Council submission regarding WA Planning Commission Metropolitan Centres Policy to include requirement for preparation of forward plan and allocation of funds

motions.title: Adoption of Use Areas Table for Town Planning Scheme
motions.description: Adoption of Use Areas Table for re-advertising required by Minister for Planning decision on draft Town of Cambridge Town Planning Scheme. Table converts previous use lists into conventional format with standardised classifications (Permitted, Discretionary, Discretionary requiring advertising, Prohibited). Key proposal is prohibition of Consulting Rooms as use within Residential areas. Scheme format modified from graphic precinct plans to conventional coloured map with written planning policy manual.

motions.title: Coastal Planning Study – Appointment of Consultant
motions.description: Appointment of consultant to undertake coastal planning study and prepare management plan for future development and maintenance of the coast

motions.title: Perth Sign Company – Directional Signs Proposal
motions.description: Submission from Perth Sign Company for illuminated directional signs at intersection of West Coast Highway and The Boulevard

motions.title: 12 Ferndale Street Floreat - Front Setback Variation Approval
motions.description: Building approval for single storey residence with front setback variation. Proposed verandah setback 7.0 metres vs required 9.0 metres under Endowment Lands By-Law No. 43. Applicant Webb and Brown-Neaves. Absolute majority decision required.

motions.title: 86 St Leonards Avenue West Leederville - Preliminary Building Approval Refusal
motions.description: Application for preliminary building approval for two 2-storey single houses. Proposal non-compliant with Council Policy No. 13 (Plot Ratio) with ratio of 0.65-0.70 against required 0.4. Applicant initially withdrew, then resubmitted revised plans with setback compliance but excessive bulk and scale retained. Recommendation for refusal sustained.

motions.title: Wembley Hotel 346 Cambridge Street - Temporary marquee approval
motions.description: Application for installation of temporary white marquee over the front beer garden area of the Wembley Hotel, approximately 88 square metres, to be installed over winter months.

motions.title: No.148 Northwood Street West Leederville - Two storey residence
motions.description: Application for Preliminary Building Licence to construct a two storey residence, submitted by [private individual — name withheld] on behalf of Mr and [private individual — name withheld].

motions.title: Mayor and Councillors' Protocols and Procedures Manual
motions.description: Review of Mayor and Councillors' Protocols and Procedures Manual to ensure relevance and compliance with Local Government Act 1995.

motions.title: Presiding Member Election Policy Administration Committee
motions.description: First meeting of Policy and Administration Committee following 1997 elections. Election of Presiding Member for Committee term.

motions.title: Town of Cambridge Local Law No. 1 – Standing Orders
motions.description: Review of Standing Orders (Meeting Procedure) Local Law to ensure compliance with Local Government Act 1995 and reflect past experience and practices.

motions.title: Code of Conduct
motions.description: Adoption of Code of Conduct for Elected Members and staff in accordance with Local Government Act 1995 Division 9, Section 5.103, based on WAMA model code.

motions.title: Disclosure of Financial Interests in Returns
motions.description: Notification of requirement for Members to lodge primary financial interest returns within three months of 3 May 1997 start date in accordance with Local Government Act 1995.

motions.title: National Competition Policy
motions.description: Council acceptance of obligations to implement National Competition Policy principles including competitive neutrality, structural reform, and legislation review.

motions.title: Local Government Association of Western Australia Annual General Meeting
motions.description: Registration of Mayor, Council delegates and interested Councillors for 1997 Local Government Week; submission of motions to WAMA AGM.

motions.title: 1996/97 Local Government Statutory Compliance Assessment Return
motions.description: Completion and submission of statutory compliance assessment return to Department of Local Government covering period 1 July 1996 to 31 March 1997.

motions.title: WAMA National General Assembly – Aboriginal Communities Motions
motions.description: Response to questionnaire relating to National General Assembly Motions on Aboriginal reconciliation, with amendment regarding statutory obligations.

motions.title: WAMA Aboriginal Reconciliation – Amendment to Motion 11.4.C
motions.description: Amendment to add statutory obligations clause to Motion 11.4.C response.

motions.title: Feedback on Proposed Urban Landfill Levy Campaign
motions.description: Council support for WAMA and Chamber of Commerce and Industry joint advertising campaign to oppose proposed State government landfill levy if Minister does not commit to round table discussions.

motions.title: Policies Review – Technical Services
motions.description: Review of Technical Services policies to ensure compliance with current arrangements and Local Government Act 1995, with retention, amendment or deletion of individual policies.

motions.title: Lake Monger – Community Group
motions.description: Endorsement of formation of community group for Lake Monger issues and approval to increase Lake Monger Working Group membership for community group representative.

motions.title: Lake Monger Working Group – Community Member Appointment
motions.description: Amendment to increase Lake Monger Working Group membership by one position to enable appointment of community group member with full voting rights.

motions.title: Proposed Policy for the Allocation of Street Numbers
motions.description: Adoption of Street Numbering Policy developed in consultation with Department of Land Administration and WAMA to provide uniform guidelines for allocation of street numbers.

motions.title: Local Area Traffic Management - West Leederville referral
motions.description: Item relating to Local Area Traffic Management in the West Leederville area referred back to the Technical Services Committee for further consideration

motions.title: Petition - St Vincent's Avenue
motions.description: Consideration of inclusion of St Vincent's Avenue as part of subsequent projects associated with investigation of Local Area Traffic Management in the West Leederville/Wembley area

motions.title: Verge Paving - 218 Harborne Street, Wembley
motions.description: Approval for brick paving of the verge in front of 218 Harborne Street, Wembley at the property owner's expense

motions.title: Council Carpark West Leederville - Pay to Park System Trial
motions.description: Approval for continuation of pay to park arrangements at the carpark located in Cambridge Street, West Leederville with specified conditions and unbudgeted expenditure authorisation

motions.title: Parking Restrictions - Kimberley, Holyrood, Abbotsford, Northwood Streets
motions.description: Two Hour parking restrictions imposed on Kimberley, Holyrood, Abbotsford and Northwood Streets, West Leederville

motions.title: Kimberley Street Two Hour Parking Restriction
motions.description: Two Hour parking restriction imposed on the eastern side of Kimberley Street, West Leederville

motions.title: McCourt Street Quarter Hour Parking Restriction
motions.description: Quarter Hour parking restriction imposed on the western side of McCourt Street, West Leederville adjacent to Wine Finery Liquor Store

motions.title: Tower, Nicholson and Kerr Streets Parking Restrictions
motions.description: Confirmation of parking restrictions on Tower, Nicholson and Kerr Streets, West Leederville with Two Hour parking imposed on eastern side of Nicholson Street

motions.title: Tate Street Two Hour Parking Restrictions
motions.description: Two Hour parking restrictions imposed on Tate Street, West Leederville from 8.00am to 6.00pm Monday to Friday

motions.title: West Coast Highway and Hale Road Junction Parking
motions.description: Council had approved parking restrictions at this junction in November 1996. Monitoring over summer months showed restrictions were effective in deterring parking, with little demand for additional facilities.

motions.title: Perth Bicycle Network Proposed Works
motions.description: Perth Bicycle Network plan involving $25 million investment over four years. Four local bicycle routes identified within Town of Cambridge for 1997/98 funding. Funding arrangement on 3:1 ratio ($3 from Bikewest for every $1 from Council). Total indicative cost $35,035 with Town contribution $8,758 for local routes. Regional route proposal deferred due to existing $80,000 contribution to City to Sea Greenway.

motions.title: Plant and Equipment Maintenance Service Tender 3-97
motions.description: Council plant and equipment divided into four groups: light vehicles (to continue supplier maintenance), trucks/utilities/buses (Category A), tractors/backhoes/mowers (Category B), and minor plant/equipment (Category C). Nine tenders received in March 1997. Tender designed to allow providers to tender for any one or more categories.

motions.title: Lake Monger Rehabilitation
motions.description: Progress on Lake Monger Rehabilitation Project approved February 1997. Steering Group established with Executive Manager Technical Services, Parks Manager, Technical Officer (Parks), and project consultant David Kabay. Department of Environmental Protection clearance sought. Implementation plan for Zones 5 and 6 includes removal of above ground biomass, earthworks for fauna refuges, and planting. Indicative cost $109,000 excluding project management. Timeframe end May 1997 to mid September 1997.

motions.title: Hale Road Community Planting
motions.description: Town of Cambridge received offer from 'Men of the Trees' organisation for donation of approximately 2,000 trees as contribution for approval given in 1996 to remove surplus items from former City of Perth nursery site. Preferred location for planting is Hale Road south side from West Coast Highway junction proceeding eastwards. Plantings would be conducted in winter season with volunteer labour from community groups. Town to coordinate volunteers and arrange insurance.

motions.title: Financial Statement Period Ending 31 March 1997
motions.description: Regular financial report to Committees introduced during 1996/1997. Report addresses financial situation within Technical Services as at end March 1997. Parks and Landscaping Operating Expenses exceeded budget by $163,000 year to date, but improved from $220,000 excess as at end February. Works and Engineering programs expected to achieve on or below budget outcome.

motions.title: Budget 1997/1998 Technical Services Non-Operating Proposals
motions.description: Listings of non-operating proposals for consideration in budget 1997/98. Technical Services Committee considered initial listing at April 1997 meeting. Listing amended to include additional proposals from Elected Members and workable proposals from community Cambridge Action exercise. Business rules applied: major projects funded from appropriate Reserves; Parks/Landscapes funding guidance $211,000; Works/Engineering funding guidance $510,000. Works sub-program allocation emphasizes bitumen seal maintenance.

motions.title: Technical Services Project Update
motions.description: Updated information on range of projects within Technical Services business. Includes coastal issues, Subiaco redevelopment, asset management, Lake Monger management, West Leederville sewer upgrade, and Garden Week 1997 held 12-20 April.

exceptions.verdict: 2 conflict(s) of interest were declared this meeting, by 2 councillor(s); see the full record for who declared and how each was managed.

exceptions.verdict: 15 application(s) decided this meeting, 11 approved.

exceptions.verdict: 15 application(s) decided this meeting: 4 refused, 1 drew at least one community objection.

exceptions.verdict: 2 of 59 items were taken confidential this meeting, vs a 3.8% rate across 460 comparable meetings.

Option of five years for lease to Bedlington Enterprises from 1 July 1997 to 3; National Competition Policy - Public Benefit Test. Bold Park Aquatic Centre retained as inhouse activity pending review

exceptions.verdict: A public deputation was heard this meeting; 0 of 87 carried motions were contested.

motions.title: Leave of absence for Mayor
motions.description: Request for approval to grant leave of absence to His Worship the Mayor from 7 to 13 May 1997 in accordance with Clause 2.9 of the Standing Orders.

motions.title: Appointment of Standing Committee Members
motions.description: Appointment of members to four Standing Committees: Technical Services Committee, Policy and Administration Committee, Corporate and Customer Services Committee, and Development and Environmental Services Committee.

motions.title: Special Meeting - Election of Deputy Mayor deferral
motions.description: Cr Johnston requested deferral of Deputy Mayor election due to anticipated absence from Special Meeting on 6 May 1997. Motion sought concurrence of Minister for Local Government to defer appointment.

motions.title: Special Meeting - Functions and Appointments
motions.description: Special Council Meeting scheduled for 6 May 1997 to perform swearing in of councillors, election of Deputy Mayor, appointment of committees and council delegates and representatives to various bodies.

motions.title: Pathways to Sustainability Conference Attendance
motions.description: Motion on whether to nominate Elected Members to attend the Pathways to Sustainability: Local Initiatives for Cities and Towns Conference to be held in Newcastle from 1 to 5 June 1997. Provision for conference attendance had been made in the 1996/97 Budget.

motions.title: Wembley Town Centre Planning Study
motions.description: Adoption of preliminary brief for Wembley Town Centre Planning Study, seeking consultant submissions, and budgeting for the project.

motions.title: WAMA Metropolitan Member – HOV Strategy Committee
motions.description: Request for nomination of a WAMA Metropolitan Member to the High Occupancy Vehicle (HOV) Strategy Committee. Term of two years, elected members or serving officers with suitable technical background.

motions.title: WAMA Member – WA Bicycle Committee
motions.description: Request for nomination of a WAMA Member to the WA Bicycle Committee. Elected members or serving officers with interest and/or experience in cycling and safety issues. Bi-monthly meetings, open term.

motions.title: Street Parking – West Leederville/Wembley
motions.description: Further parking restrictions in West Leederville/Wembley areas during football games at Subiaco Oval. Improvements identified for Woolwich Street, Cambridge Street and Railway Parade following resident requests.

motions.title: City to Sea Greenway – Tender Recommendation
motions.description: Tender recommendation for construction of the City to Sea Greenway. Morrone Nominees selected as preferred tenderer. Motion includes conditions on contract amount, Better Cities Program funding confirmation, and Western Power power pole relocation work.

motions.title: Western Australian Municipal Association – Nominations – Association Honours
motions.description: Request to submit nominations for the 1997 Western Australian Municipal Association Honours.

motions.title: Fairway Tavern – Renewal of Lease Option
motions.description: Lease renewal conditions for the Fairway Tavern at the Wembley Golf Complex operated by Bedlington Enterprises. Three breaches must be remedied before 30 June 1997 for renewal.

motions.title: Commercial Evaluation of Beachfront Facilities
motions.description: Consideration of process to be followed for development of commercial beachfront facilities for City and Floreat Beaches. Option 3 (Commercial Development as part of Complete Coastal Management Plan) was selected as preferred process.

motions.title: Commercial Beachfront Facilities – Option 3 Preferred Process
motions.description: Selection of Option 3 as preferred process for development of commercial beachfront facilities. Option 3 involves commercial development to form part of the Complete Coastal Management Plan.

motions.title: Beach Kiosks – Leases
motions.description: Revocation of previous lease arrangement for Kiosks 1 and 3 at Challenger Parade, City Beach and Floreat. New temporary twelve month leases from 1 April 1997 with month-by-month continuation thereafter.

motions.title: Members on Leave of Absence - Cr K Smith
motions.description: Request for leave of absence for specified periods in April and May 1997.

motions.title: Confirmation of Special Meeting Minutes - 4 March 1997
motions.description: Confirmation of revised minutes from the Special Meeting held on 4 March 1997.

motions.title: Confirmation of Ordinary Meeting Minutes - 25 March 1997
motions.description: Confirmation of minutes from the Ordinary Meeting held on 25 March 1997, with recorded amendment regarding Item DES97.52.

motions.title: Confirmation of Special Meeting Minutes - 15 April 1997
motions.description: Confirmation of minutes from the Special Meeting held on 15 April 1997.

motions.title: Financial Statements - Receipt and Library Strategic Planning
motions.description: Receipt of Committee and Management Financial Statements for period ended 31 March 1997 and authorisation to prepare report on establishment of strategic planning exercise for Library and Information Services.

motions.title: Accounts for Payment - Confirmation
motions.description: Confirmation of schedule of accounts for payment in accordance with Local Government (Financial Management) Regulations 1996.

motions.title: Investment Schedule - Receipt
motions.description: Receipt of Investment Schedule as at 31 March 1997 detailing surplus funds invested, distribution, and financial performance of each investment.

motions.title: Documents Sealed - Notation
motions.description: Noting that Common Seal of the Town of Cambridge has been affixed to specified documents including Deed of Novation for Mitec Computer Systems and approval for Town Planning Scheme Amendment No. 2.

motions.title: Sport and Recreation Future Directions Discussion Paper - Receipt
motions.description: Receipt of WA Sport and Recreation Council discussion paper on Strategic Directions for Western Australia Sport and Recreation for next three years.

motions.title: Wembley Occasional Care Centre - Deferral of Consideration
motions.description: Deferral of consideration of options available for future service provision for Wembley Occasional Care Centre pending further information on program impacts, viability, and advertising strategies.

motions.title: Beach Inspection Service - Contract Extension
motions.description: Extension of contract for Beach Inspector/Lifeguard service provided by Surf Life Saving WA from 1 June to 31 August 1997 for winter months coverage, with review prior to 31 August 1997.

motions.title: After Hours Service - Rangers Continuation
motions.description: Continuation of after hours Rangers service in existing format with improved response to non-urgent calls on next working day and investigations into infringement notice procedures and parking law provisions.

motions.title: Street Parking - Parking Ombudsman Deferral
motions.description: Deferral of appointment of Councillor as Parking Ombudsman for issues relating to parking infringements in Subiaco Oval vicinity to 16 June 1997 meeting when football parking impacts will be more evident.

motions.title: Workers Compensation Insurance - Renewal
motions.description: Renewal of Workers Compensation Insurance with Municipal Workcare Scheme for 1997/98 financial period under same terms as previous two periods.

motions.title: City to Sea Greenway - Expenditure Authorisation
motions.description: Authorisation of Council contribution of $80,000 for City to Sea Greenway Project from Area Improvement Reserve to be funded through Commonwealth Better Cities Program and Bikewest, with expenditure contingent on receipt of proportionate contributions.

motions.title: Erosion Control and Stormwater Conference - No Attendance
motions.description: Decision that no Elected Members be nominated to attend the Fifth Annual International Erosion Control Association and Stormwater Industry Association Conference in Brisbane, 9-12 September 1997.

motions.title: 3 Dundalk Road, Floreat - Second Storey Additions Approval
motions.description: Application for additions and alterations to 3 Dundalk Road, Floreat, including a portico, lobby, and second storey with two bedrooms, living area, walk-in robe and ensuite. A timber balcony and verandah to the front were proposed. Initially deferred, then modified plans submitted reducing verandah width from 2.1 metres to 1.5 metres and increasing proposed setback from 7.5 metres to 8.1 metres, with re-survey indicating setback of 8.22 to 9.02 metres.

motions.title: Lots 43-45 Cambridge Street, Wembley - Shops and Fast Food Outlet
motions.description: Application for two storey retail and office development with drive through fast food outlet on the site of a disused Caltex Service Station and operational car wash. Previous application in December 1996 was refused. Redesigned proposal addresses parking and loading requirements. Site inspection conducted 10 April 1997. Minister for Planning appeal upheld regarding previous application.

motions.title: Lot 2 Alderbury Street, Floreat - Three Grouped Dwellings Deferred
motions.description: Application for three grouped brick, render and tile dwellings to be constructed one behind the other, accessed via common driveway. Single storey, moderate sized dwellings with three bedrooms, two bathrooms and double garages. Similar application refused in December 1996. Resubmitted with minor modifications. WA Planning Commission granted preliminary approval for subdivision into two green title lots in February 1997. Application deferred pending finalisation of subdivision.

motions.title: 39 Kingsland Avenue, City Beach - Carport Side Wall Enclosure
motions.description: Application to enclose the southern wall of a recently constructed carport approved in June of the previous year. Carport was approved 2.5 metres from front boundary. Letter of objection received from neighbouring property owners at No. 41 Kingsland Avenue. Council approval required under Clause 2b of By-law No. 43 which allows variation of By-law provisions.

motions.title: 50 Kimberley Street, West Leederville - Home Occupation Approval
motions.description: Application to use one room of residence as office for security and enquiry agency. Previously approved in March 1995 but approval lapsed. Applicants unaware approval was temporary for twelve months. Room is 14 square metres. Equipment comprises telephone, facsimile, computer, photocopier and paper shredder. No client visits to residence; all contact at clients' premises. Only occasional staff or contractor visits.

motions.title: 86 St Leonards Avenue, West Leederville - Two Storey Houses Application Withdrawn
motions.description: Application for two 2 storey single houses. Proposed residences have plot ratio of 0.70:1.0 and 0.60:1.0 for houses A and B respectively, exceeding limit. Side and balcony setbacks do not comply with Residential Planning Codes. Preliminary subdivision approval granted by WA Planning Commission for two lots of 323 and 324 square metres. Existing cottage on site would be demolished. Application was withdrawn by applicant at Council Meeting 2 April 1997.

motions.title: 9 Kildare Road, Floreat - Front Setback Variation Single Storey
motions.description: Application for building approval for single storey residence with three bedrooms, two bathrooms and study. Front patio encroaches into setback area with proposed setback of 8.2 metres against required 9.0 metres under Endowment Lands By-Law No. 43. Garage proposed with parapet wall on side boundary. Adjoining landowners sighted plans and raised no objections.

motions.title: 189 Gregory Street, Wembley - Two Storey Residence Application Lost
motions.description: Application for two storey residence. Plot ratio of 0.53:1.0 exceeds limit of 0.4:1.0 by 86 square metres. Double garage set back 6 metres from primary street with nil setback on southern boundary. Adjoining neighbour indicated no objection to side setback variation. Committee Meeting 15 April 1997 - Cr MacRae requested to be recorded as voting against the motion. Motion was put and lost.

motions.title: 46 St Leonard's Avenue, West Leederville - Garage and Renovation Refusal
motions.description: Application for renovation and refurbishment of existing residence including bullnosed veranda, timber fretwork, new colorbond roof, double garage 1.8 metres from primary street alignment, and open view fence with limestone piers and wrought iron infill panels. Applicant cited precedent for similar developments. Adjoining property owners at No. 44 raised no objections. Council identified sight line concerns for vehicle and pedestrian safety.

motions.title: 70 Moray Avenue, Floreat - Two Lot Subdivision Non-Support
motions.description: Western Australian Planning Commission referred to Council for comment a proposed two lot green title subdivision. Existing single storey brick and tile house would be demolished. Lot of 1434 square metres proposed to be subdivided into two lots of 717 square metres each. Proposed corner lot has awkward configuration with rear boundary dimension of 8 metres. Subdivision 166 square metres short of required 1600 square metres to comply with average lot area requirement.

motions.title: 5 Callington Avenue, City Beach - Home Occupation Administration Office

motions.title: Lot 97 Oban Road City Beach - Consulting Rooms Extension

motions.title: No. 79 Woolwich Street West Leederville - Church Demolition and Residential Development
motions.description: Applications for demolition of church hall, development of two single storey residences and three lot subdivision at heritage listed property. Property is in Municipal Heritage Inventory with recommendation for State Heritage Register nomination.

motions.title: Lot 165 Cambridge Street Wembley - Consulting Room Extension
motions.description: Application for extension of existing consulting rooms at Lot 165, No. 210 Cambridge Street, Wembley. No submissions received.

motions.title: Lot 302 Clune Avenue Wembley - Grouped Dwelling
motions.description: Application for rear two storey grouped dwelling at Lot 302 Clune Avenue (behind residence at 47 Lake Monger Drive), Wembley. Comprises four bedrooms, three bathrooms and a study. Proposed to be strata titled or retained as one lot.

motions.title: No. 16 Windarra Drive City Beach - Pool Shed Outbuilding
motions.description: Application for outbuilding (pool shed) constructed of rendered brick walls and tiled roof located at Tumut Road frontage of residence under construction. Structure would be visible above the boundary wall and would breach front setback provisions. Structure already under construction at time of refusal consideration.

motions.title: After Hours Service - Noise
motions.description: Report on Council's after hours noise complaint service policy. Comparative analysis with other local authorities. Survey shows Town of Cambridge provides superior service compared to most councils. Current policy includes response to registered complaints, amplified music at licensed premises, and specific noise issues.

motions.title: Building Licences Approved Under Delegated Authority

motions.title: Options for Acquisition of Public Open Space in Wembley Ward
motions.description: Council decision regarding approach to acquiring additional public open space in Wembley Ward, including rejection of resumption powers and consideration of community needs survey.

motions.title: Heritage Properties and Town Planning Scheme Inclusion
motions.description: Council decision to retain Municipal Heritage Inventory as non-statutory reference document pending further investigation, with review in 12 months and allocation of funds for conservation advice service.

motions.title: Expressions of Interest to Host Regional Coastal Facilitators
motions.description: Council decision to submit expression of interest to Ministry for Planning to host a Coastal Facilitator and to contact other local authorities for participation in regional initiative.

motions.title: Decision of the Minister for Planning on Draft Town Planning Scheme

motions.title: Home Occupations Workshop

motions.title: Delegated Decisions and Notifications

motions.title: Development and Environmental Services Policies - Deletion and Amendment
motions.description: Review and amendment of Development and Environmental Services policies relating to planning, building and environmental health in compliance with Local Government Act 1995. Policies reviewed and amended as appropriate with remaining policies to be renumbered.

motions.description: Amendment to Protocols and Procedures Manual regarding retention of equipment by outgoing elected members, including facsimile/telephone answering machine and filing cabinet. Manual to be amended to reflect changes.

motions.title: Council Carpark Pay to Park System Trial - Referral
motions.description: Trial of pay-to-park system at Cambridge Street, West Leederville carpark. Matter referred back to Committee for further consideration.

motions.title: Abbotsford Street West Leederville - No Verge Parking Restriction
motions.description: No verge parking restriction imposed on eastern side of Abbotsford Street to protect verge from vehicular damage. Property owner requested protection due to vehicles parking all day and causing damage to reticulation system.

motions.title: Fix Australia Fix the Roads Campaign - Donation
motions.description: Campaign supported by WAMA seeking increased fuel excise allocation to roads. Council previously approved $500 in 1996. Further contribution approved with funds charged to Members of Council Subscriptions.

motions.title: Beecroft Park - Facilities Community Project
motions.description: City Beach Lions Club community service project to install barbecue tables and bench seats at Beecroft Park. Council approval for materials cost up to $800 with quality control and community notification conditions.

motions.title: City to Sea Greenway - Progress Report

motions.title: Lake Monger Rehabilitation - Progress Report

motions.description: Application by Floreat Park Parish for financial assistance towards printing of 'Adventure in Faith' book on local church history. Recommendation to decline under policy due to retrospective nature but approve ex gratia donation.

motions.title: Sixth Annual National Hazardous Materials Conference
motions.description: Consideration of attendance by elected members at Sixth Annual National Hazardous Materials Conference to be held in Sydney from 24 to 26 February 1997, addressing new Hazardous Substances and Dangerous Goods Regulations.

motions.title: 1997 Annual Recreation Conference Attendance
motions.description: Approval for attendance by interested elected members at 1997 Annual Recreation Conference in Fremantle from 23 to 26 March 1997 at cost of $350 per attendee.

motions.title: Floreat Pre-Primary Centre Ground Lease Extension
motions.description: Enlargement of ground lease area at Floreat Pre-Primary Centre in Birkdale Street to accommodate full-time pre-primary education for five-year-old children from 1998. Site meeting proposed to consult with Education Department, school representatives, parents and community.

motions.title: Wembley Golf Complex Fees Review
motions.description: Review and adoption of green fees and additional fees (driving range, club hire, buggies) at Wembley Golf Complex effective from 1 January 1997, adopting Option 2 pricing strategy with upper-end fees comparable to other metropolitan courses. Absolute majority required.

motions.title: Development and Environmental Services Financial Statements
motions.description: Financial statements for Development and Environmental Services for period ending 31 October 1996, noting over-expenditure on swimming pool inspections due to non-complying pools and legal action initiated.

motions.title: Three Grouped Dwellings at Alderbury Street Floreat
motions.description: Application for planning approval for three grouped brick, render and tile dwellings on Lot 2, No. 76 Alderbury Street, Floreat. Application refused due to non-compliance with Clause 52 of Town Planning Scheme limiting grouped dwellings to maximum of two per lot in residential areas, and conflict with recent decision to reduce density coding of South Floreat.

motions.title: Home Occupation (Travel Agent) at 41 Newry Street
motions.description: Assessment of home occupation approval for travel agent business at 41 Newry Street with one-year approval granted in March 1996. Concerns raised that business may be operating at greater scale and intensity than originally stated, operating as part of travel agent association. No evidence of breach found. Matter to be reconsidered at March 1997 renewal.

motions.title: Public Open Space Provision in Wembley Ward Study
motions.description: Comprehensive study identifying areas of Wembley Ward deficient in public open space using 400-metre catchment radius principle. Northern Wembley identified as key priority area with approximately 900 lots affected. Study recommends proceeding with land acquisition investigation, estimated cost $450,000 for pocket park in target area, with additional development and maintenance costs to follow.

motions.title: Subiaco Redevelopment Project - Report received
motions.description: Report on modifications made to Subiaco Redevelopment Town Planning Scheme following Minister for Planning approval and gazetting. Modifications address Council's earlier submission regarding residential density, Harborne Street extension, retail floorspace, car parking, and public open space.

motions.title: Subiaco Redevelopment - Residential subdivision and greenway
motions.description: Proposed residential subdivision creating 189 lots (184 single dwelling, 5 group housing) and 2.583 ha public open space. Total dwelling yield approximately 206. Based on traditional street grid pattern with rear laneway access. Concerns raised regarding traffic impacts and requirement for SRA to contribute to traffic management costs.

motions.title: Delegated decisions and notifications
motions.description: Report on delegated decisions processed for month ending 30 November 1996. Nine items dealt with under delegated authority including dwelling additions, strata subdivisions, and other proposals deemed to comply with Town Planning Scheme and Council Policy. No appeals received or determined during November.

motions.title: Town Planning Scheme Amendment No 2
motions.description: Amendment to Town of Cambridge Town Planning Scheme to introduce provisions enabling Council to formally adopt planning policies under the scheme. Necessary to give statutory authority to Residential Design Guidelines anticipated for completion May-June 1997. Amends clause 34(2AA) and adds new clause 164 (Planning Policies) based on Model Town Planning Scheme text.

motions.title: Consulting Room at 284 Cambridge Street, Wembley
motions.description: Application for planning approval to use existing vacant shop premises as consulting room (chiropractic centre). Use classified as 'IP' (incidental) in Shopping S1 zone. No alterations other than internal partitioning proposed. Advertised for public comment with no submissions received. Vehicle parking requirement of 1 bay per 50 sq m (1 bay required for 66 sq m). Eight bays available at rear, shared with adjoining uses.

motions.title: Mechanical repairs workshop at Railway Parade
motions.description: Application for change of use from warehouse to mechanical repairs workshop at Tenancy Unit 7, 166 Railway Parade, West Leederville. 980 square metre tenancy within mixed commercial complex. Proposal rejected on grounds of incompatibility with adjoining residential zoned properties. Land abuts two residential unit developments zoned R60.

motions.title: Serviced apartments and document storage development
motions.description: Application for serviced residential apartments (36 units) and document storage facility at corner of Loftus and Cambridge Streets, West Leederville. Modified proposal following October 1996 deferral. Plot ratio reduced from 2.23:1 to 1.58:1. Height 4 levels above Loftus Street with basement. Building setbacks increased to 4.5m on Cambridge Street, 2.25m on Loftus Street. Vehicle parking 61 bays (5 bays short of requirement for 66 required). Application deferred for advertising and further consideration.

motions.title: Medical Suite at St Leonards Avenue
motions.description: Application for planning approval to use existing local shop premises as medical suite (laboratory, surgery, reception area) at corner of Cambridge Street and St Leonards Avenue, West Leederville. Use classified as 'SA' (requiring approval and advertising) in Residential R20 zone. Building previously approved for local shop use only. Advertising completed with four submissions received (2 objections, 1 support conditional, 1 objection from nearby doctor). Application refused on grounds of incompatibility with residential uses and traffic/parking concerns.

motions.title: Illuminated street name signs - submission held
motions.description: Submission by SJB Town Planners on behalf of Claude Neon for installation of 22 illuminated street name signs at key intersections (Railway Parade, Cambridge Street, Grantham Street, The Boulevard, Hale Road, Flynn Street). Signs to incorporate advertising to fund installation and operation. Council proposed to defer consideration pending resolution of other priorities. Claude Neon has installed similar signs in 73 councils nationally including 10 in Western Australia.

motions.title: Wembley Piazza Shopping Centre modification
motions.description: Application for modifications to 1995 planning approval (CP210/95) for refurbishment of Wembley Piazza Shopping Centre at 346-350 Cambridge Street, Wembley. Modified proposal reduces plot ratio from 2.23:1 to 1.58:1 through reduction of serviced apartments from 40 to 36 and reduction in document storage area. Parking provision 309 bays (128 basement, 181 ground level). Council expressed caution regarding future Wembley Hotel extensions.

motions.description: Application for 2 two storey residences at Lot 27, 6 Carlton Street, West Leederville. Committee recommended refusal due to bulk and scale, non-compliance with front setback provisions and Plot Ratio Policy. Motion for refusal was put and lost.

motions.title: 2 Two storey residences - Carlton Street - Approval motion

motions.title: Delegated authority for Carlton Street residences matter

motions.title: Two storey residence - Meelah Road - Approval

motions.title: Additions to two storey residence - Tate Street - Approval

Several minor variations to planning codes are sought regarding front setback, side setbacks, parapet walls, and open space provision.

The committee oversees application of water, sewerage and drainage policies and standards, administrative procedures and charges associated with development, and the Corporation's performance in discharging related responsibilities.

motions.title: WAMA Member - Metropolitan Member - Taxi Ranks Committee
motions.description: Request for nomination of a WAMA Metropolitan Member to the Taxi Ranks Committee. The Committee has been set up by the Taxi Industry Board to investigate all issues relating to taxi ranks in the metropolitan area. The position is newly established with a two-year term, requiring an elected member or suitably qualified officer with experience in parking and/or transport issues.

motions.title: Lake Monger Rehabilitation Plan - Work Execution Approval
motions.description: Approval for execution of work in Zones 5 and 6 of the Lake Monger Rehabilitation Plan, subject to endorsement of work's compatibility with general water quality improvements through a proposed workshop on 12 December 1996. The proposal includes specialist support from Centre for Water Research and CSIRO, engagement with Main Roads WA regarding freeway run-off contribution, and tender process for contractor engagement. Budget allocation of $70,000 has been apportioned for Sections 5 and 6 in the 1996/97 budget.

Officer recommendation was refusal; committee recommended approval but with concerns about precedent.

motions.title: 262-264 Cambridge Street, Wembley - Five Grouped Dwellings

motions.title: 50 Hale Road, City Beach - Conversion of Restaurant to Four Residential Units
motions.description: Application to convert vacant upper level restaurant to four residential units (two and three bedroom) in Commercial C1 zone. Similar application approved by City of Perth in 1993. Proposal includes modifications to exhaust system and parking conditions.

motions.title: Western Suburbs District Planning Committee - Report
motions.description: Report on last meeting of WSDPC held 1 August 1996 at Town of Claremont. Items discussed: Coastal Policy (submissions close 29 October 1996), New Western Suburbs Rail Crossing Study, and New Planning and Environmental Legislation. Next meeting scheduled 19 September 1996 at Shire of Peppermint Grove.

motions.title: Western Suburbs Rail Crossing Study
motions.description: Joint study involving City of Nedlands, City of Subiaco, Town of Claremont, Ministry for Planning and Main Roads WA. Five crossing options identified. Traffic consultant required at estimated cost $10,000; each party (6 total) to contribute up to $2,000. Study will assess future rail crossing proposals and traffic impacts.

motions.title: Lot 3 The Boulevard, City Beach - Single Storey Shopping Centre (In Principle Approval)
motions.description: In principle approval for single storey shopping centre with 850 square metres net retail floor area and 56 car parking bays at former Shell service station site. Applicant Strickland Group Pty Ltd. Proposal involves use of adjoining Parks and Recreation Reserve and road reserve for parking. Options presented for parking layout; Option 1 preferred involving re-alignment of service road.

motions.title: Delegated Decisions and Notifications

motions.title: Refuse two storey residence, 6 Carlton Street, West Leederville

The proposal did not comply with side setback and minimum open space provisions of the Residential Planning Codes, and non-compliance with Council Policy No. 13 - Plot Ratio in Residential Areas.

motions.title: Refer two storey residence to Committee for further consideration
motions.description: During discussion, the Executive Manager Development and Environmental Services advised Members that the applicant wished to have this matter referred back to Committee as it was his intention to provide amended plans to reduce the size of the residence.

motions.title: Refuse additions to residence, 10 Carlton Street, West Leederville

The extension of the side boundary parapet walls does not comply with the Residential Planning Codes (required setback 1.5 metres), and both neighbouring landowners have refused to endorse the proposal.

motions.title: Refuse additions to cottage and grouped dwelling, 118 Cambridge Street, West Leederville
motions.description: Application for Preliminary Building Approval for the construction of additions to the existing brick and iron cottage plus a rear two storey grouped dwelling at 118 Cambridge Street (corner Lesser Street), West Leederville. The proposal does not comply with Council requirements in respect to side setbacks, car parking provisions, and minimum open space.

motions.title: Refuse proposed two storey residence, 10 Glengariff Drive, Floreat

The proposal complies in all aspects with the Residential Planning Codes and Council policy, however, does not comply with the front setback requirements of 9.0 metres as defined by By-Law 43.

motions.title: Refuse proposed garage and loft, 159 The Boulevard, Floreat
motions.description: Application for approval of the extension of an existing garage and construction of upstairs loft at Lot 1289 (No. 159) The Boulevard, Floreat. The proposal complies in all respects with the requirements of Council Policy and the Residential Planning Codes. However, the garage and upper storey loft are to extend into the 9.0 metre front setback area.

motions.title: Receive Schedule of building licences approved under delegated authority
motions.description: A total of 46 building licences with a combined value of $2,541,301 were approved during the month of August 1996. Six preliminary building licences and seven demolition licences were also approved.

motions.title: Adopt interim policy on finished ground levels as Local Law
motions.description: Adoption of an interim policy on finished ground levels at construction sites as a Local Law under the provisions of the Local Government Act 1995. The policy aims to provide for the orderly development and amenity of residential, commercial and industrial land within the Town by establishing the maximum and minimum ground and ground floor levels on any site.

motions.title: WAWA Reserve, Kalinda Drive, City Beach - Vodafone Telecommunications Facility
motions.description: Revised proposal for Vodafone telecommunications facility involving a 30 metre high monopole tower plus small equipment shelter on WAWA Reserve.
