motions.title: Dodd Street, Wembley - Request for Closure of Private Street
motions.description: Request from Corporate Body of Strata Development at Lot 1, No 3 Dodd Street, Wembley, for approval to close the private street between Lots 1 and 1629 Dodd Street. The private street is approximately 23 metres in length and 5 metres wide, forming a remnant portion of a larger private street mostly closed in 1994.

motions.title: Draft WAPC Policy on Battleaxe Subdivisions and Pedestrian Access Ways
motions.description: Council's response to WA Planning Commission's revised draft policy on battleaxe subdivisions and pedestrian access ways. Council considered impacts of proposed changes on the Town of Cambridge, particularly regarding the 400 square metres minimum lot size for battleaxe lots and encouragement of rights of way and private streets for access.

motions.title: Perry Lakes Rugby Union Park, Floreat - Floodlights Approval
motions.description: Application by Western Australian Rugby Union for installation of four floodlights at Perry Lakes Rugby Union warm up track. Council deferred decision on 23 January 1996 for consultation with adjoining residents. Application proposes 30m high monopole with conditions on frequency of fixtures (maximum 10 per season), operating hours (until 10pm), and parking management.

motions.title: 123 Daglish Street, Wembley - Home Occupation Approval
motions.description: Application by [private individual — name withheld] for approval to use a bedroom of her residence as office for speech pathology administration and research. Approximately 12 square metres; part-time operation with infrequent client visits; primary work is administration and research at approximately 5 hours per week.

motions.title: 66 Tate Street, Leederville - Two Storey Attached Houses
motions.description: Application for preliminary building approval for 2 two storey attached residences. Proposal exceeds plot ratio policy (0.54:1 vs required 0.4:1). Revised proposal represents improved design addressing earlier concerns regarding streetscape presentation.

motions.title: 169 Harborne Street, Wembley - Garage and Rear Extensions
motions.description: Application for building licence for proposed garage extension and rear 'granny flat' extensions to existing residence. Front garage setback does not comply with Residential Planning Codes (3.2m proposed vs 6.0m average required). Side setback of rear addition accords with existing setback.

motions.title: 106 Nanson Street, Wembley - Carport and Residence Additions
motions.description: Application for building licence for internal alterations, rear addition (kitchen, dining, family room, bathrooms) and double carport in primary street setback. Original proposal submitted 14 December 1995 raised concerns from neighbour at 104 Nanson Street. Amended plans submitted showing wall setback and redesigned front fence.

motions.title: Fix Australia Fix the Roads Campaign - Donation
motions.description: WAMA seeking financial support for 18-month joint campaign between State Government and Local Governments to raise profile of roads in WA. Campaign has successfully raised public awareness through media. Request for further contribution to maximise television coverage.

motions.title: Hale Road/West Coast Highway Intersection - Parking Improvements
motions.description: Area on southern side of Hale Road at intersection with West Coast Highway has been used as parking area by recreational users (surfers, fishers). Creates traffic hazards and damage to verge. Technical Services recommends installation of pine bollards, prohibition of verge parking, and replanting/refurbishment at estimated cost of $5,000. Funding identified from Budget Item 'Drainage - Yule/Weldon' (completed with $15,000 saving).

motions.title: Empire Avenue - Boundary Road Work
motions.description: City of Stirling seeking 50% contribution ($380,400) from Town of Cambridge for upgrade of Empire Avenue (Weaponess to Cromarty) at total cost of $760,800. Section 317 of Local Government Act requires municipalities to contribute to shared facilities. Town investigated and determined project unlikely to benefit Town and outside boundary responsibility. Officer report recommends no contribution.

motions.title: Petition - Local Area Traffic Management - Daglish Street
motions.description: Petition dated 6 February 1996 from residents regarding Local Area Traffic Management issues in Daglish Street, Wembley. Signatories state section between Grantham and Dodd Streets is too busy with excessive through traffic including commercial trucks and tourist coaches. Support urgent action including steering committee and budget allocation.

motions.title: Railway Parade, West Leederville - Clearway Restriction
motions.description: Clearway restriction proposed on southern side of Railway Parade to facilitate better traffic flow in westerly direction and improve access to Southport Street. Restriction addresses parking preventing right turn manoeuvres and restricting westbound traffic movement.

motions.title: Sunset Coast Tourist Drive Signage - Relocation
motions.description: Council approved Sunset Coast Tourist Drive signage on 24 October 1995. Signs have been erected at Challenger Parade/West Coast Highway, City Beach. Several South City Beach residents have requested removal, citing concerns about additional through traffic and noting Cottesloe excluded this section. Amendment proposed to relocate signage to West Coast Highway at Oceanic Drive rather than conduct survey.

motions.title: Wembley Golf Complex Redevelopment - Progress Report
motions.description: Progress report on redevelopment of 'new' course at Wembley Golf Complex (approved at $920,000 budget in 1995/96). GHD appointed as design consultant and project manager. Project plan completed; earthworks and irrigation tenders scheduled for closure 1 March 1996; bore work completed by Coastal Drilling at $17,000; grassing documentation in draft; Western Power to underground power section.

motions.title: City to Sea Greenway - Tender Recommendation
motions.description: Tender evaluation for design and contract administration of City to Sea Greenway project. Council approved concept in principle 12 December 1995. Three bids received: Mike Maher & Associates ($11,000), Land Planning Consultants ($14,750), BSD Consultants ($3,810). Assessment panel: Poynton (Technical Services), Bignell (Planning), Cunningham (Better Cities). Mike Maher & Associates recommended based on organisational profile, team credentials, timeline, and value.

motions.title: Matthews Netball Centre - Redevelopment Approval
motions.description: Perth Netball Association seeking approval for staged redevelopment of Matthews Netball Centre. First stage estimated at $350,000 includes hard stand courts, resurfacing, and court surround improvements. Funding options provided (CSRFF grant $165,000 or loan, Town $80,000, Association $105,000). Fraser Worley Pty Limited to be engaged as project manager (cost borne by Association). CEO or representative to participate in steering group.

motions.title: Emergency Management - State Emergency Service Meeting
motions.description: State Emergency Service proposing to review structure of emergency management committees in light of creation of new Towns. Town invited to send two representatives (elected member and designated officer) to meeting 7 March 1996. Executive Manager Technical Services proposed as designated officer due to responsibility for emergency management.

motions.title: Delegated Authority - Exemption from Rates
motions.description: Report on delegated authority exercised by CEO/Town Clerk to approve exemption of properties from Council Rates in accordance with Section 532 of Local Government Act 1960. One exemption approved: Perth Inner City Youth Service, Unit 3 145-147 Cambridge Street, Leederville for charitable purposes, $315.00.

motions.title: Bold Park Aquatic Centre - Safe Replacement
motions.description: Break-in occurred 8 February 1996 at Bold Park Aquatic Centre. Offenders forced entry to administration area and safe, stealing day's takings and cash floats. Replacement safe required urgently. Original safe replacement value $1,600; new safe from Guardall Security cost $3,250 (higher security rating). Over expenditure of approximately $1,400 requires Council approval.

motions.title: Accounts for Payment
motions.description: Schedule of accounts for payment in accordance with Local Government Accounting Directions 1994. Five municipal transactions totalling $1,425,778.48.

motions.title: Financial Statements for Period Ended 31 January 1996
motions.description: Financial statements for period ended 31 January 1996 have been produced (circulated with notice paper). Annual Financial Statements not yet received from City of Perth; Minister for Local Government authorised extension of time for account preparation.

motions.title: Wembley Golf Complex - Fees Review
motions.description: Review of green fees charged at Wembley Golf Complex. Previous review 27 June 1995 increased fees 15% effective 17 July 1995 based on benchmarking ten other metropolitan public golf courses. Fees are now below average as other courses have increased theirs. Proposal to increase fees effective 1 April 1996 to align with market rates. Next review proposed 1 January 1997.

motions.title: Ministerial Requests - Priority Listing
motions.description: Notice of motion by Cr McConnell proposing to shortlist areas of need for presentation to Minister for Local Government. Minister Paul Omodei has given verbal commitment to consider requests for additional funding for regional facilities and improving existing services. During discussion, Members agreed to send letter to Minister acknowledging commitments and advising priority listing to follow.

motions.title: WAMA Nomination - Restaurant and Caterers Accreditation Board
motions.description: WAMA seeking nomination for vacant position on Restaurant and Caterers Association of WA - Caterers Gold Licence Accreditation Board. Newly established committee, meets four times per year. Role to consider applications from caterers for gold licence accreditation.

motions.title: WAMA Nomination - Coastal Zone Council
motions.description: WAMA seeking nominations for one metropolitan and one non-metropolitan representative for newly established Coastal Zone Council. Quarterly meetings at Ministry of Planning, Albert Facey House. Meeting fee $73 per half-day. Term to be determined, commencing April 1996.

motions.title: WAMA Nomination - Heritage Council of WA
motions.description: WAMA seeking nominations for position on Heritage Council of WA (panel of three names). One to three year term at Minister's discretion. Monthly meetings at Perth Mint. Sitting fees and travelling expenses paid; annual stipend $3,750 plus additional meeting fees.

motions.title: Anti-social behaviour prevention measures

Measures developed in conjunction with Wembley Police Station.

motions.description: Request for the nomination of a deputy member to the Geographic Names Committee, with nominations closing 5 January 1996.

motions.title: 98 Nanson Street, Wembley - Home Occupation (Beautician's Salon)
motions.description: Application by [private individual — name withheld] to use a bedroom for beautician's business. Proposal does not comply with Town Planning Scheme provisions regarding scale and nature of home occupations. Applicant proposes three operating days weekly with up to eight clients per day. Planning officer recommends refusal due to adverse impact on residential amenity.

motions.title: Town Planning Scheme Review - Update on Progress
motions.description: Progress report on preparation of new Town Planning Scheme. Total of 777 submissions received during three-month advertising period. Council to consider submissions and issues report in February or March next year. Recommendations for further public consultation outlined.

motions.title: 4 Niribi Road, City Beach - Home Occupation (Physiotherapy Practice)
motions.description: Application by [private individual — name withheld] to use room for physiotherapy practice. Proposal does not comply with Town Planning Scheme provisions regarding scale and nature of home occupations. Applicant proposes five days weekly operation with maximum six clients per day. Four residents contacted Council; three objected. Planning officer recommends refusal due to adverse impact on residential amenity.

motions.title: Expressions of Interest - Municipal Inventory of Heritage Places
motions.description: Tender evaluation for preparation of Municipal Inventory of Heritage Places. Three qualified consultants submitted expressions of interest: O'Brien Planning Consultants ($29,500), Heritage and Conservation Professionals ($30,000), and Considine and Griffiths Architects with Erickson and Taylor ($30,000). Evaluation team recommends Heritage and Conservation Professionals based on knowledge of local history and ability to dedicate more resources to survey work.

motions.title: 16-18 Cambridge Street, West Leederville - Unauthorised Commercial Sign
motions.description: Illegal painted freestanding sign (approximately 0.8m x 1m) located at corner of Southport and Cambridge Streets in residential area, contravening Town Planning Scheme clauses 149 and 160. Sign advertises architectural firm. Property owner has not responded to two written notices. Council authorised to remove sign if not removed within 30 days of notice.

motions.title: 18 Oxford Close, Leederville - Local Government Act Notice - Illegal Alterations to Building
motions.description: Building non-compliant with fire separation and fire safety requirements. WA Fire Brigade inspection identified major deficiencies. Council issues notice under Section 401(1)(b) of Local Government Act 1960 requiring owners to carry out alterations, construction and upgrading works to comply with WA Uniform Building By-laws within 35 days of service.

motions.title: 66 Tate Street, Leederville - 2 Two Storey Attached Houses
motions.description: Application to construct 2 two storey attached townhouse-type residences. Proposal does not comply with Council Policy No. 13 (plot ratio 0.52:1.0 versus required 0.4:1.0) and does not comply with Council Policy No. 19. Concerns raised regarding scale inconsistent with surrounding character, steeply pitched zincalume roof creating excessive height (10.4 metres from street), and adverse visual impact on streetscape. Neighbouring properties did not object.

motions.title: 87 Gregory Street, Wembley - (Rear) Two Storey Residence
motions.description: Application for amended preliminary building licence to construct rear two storey residence with increased floor area. Proposal does not comply with Council Policy No. 13 (plot ratio 0.49:1.0 versus required 0.4:1.0), exceeding policy by 90 square metres (40 square metres additional over previous approval). Adjoining owners raised no objections. Motion to defer for further consultation with applicant regarding plot ratio reduction.

motions.title: 93 Woolwich Street, West Leederville - Proposed Single Dwelling and Double Garage
motions.description: Application for single storey dwelling and double garage with multiple non-compliance areas with R-Codes. Primary concern is front garage setback (proposed 1.5m versus required 4.5m). Applicant argues security concerns for high-performance vehicle and vehicle cannot negotiate speed humps in rear right-of-way. Adjoining neighbour objected. Deferral motion approved to enable further investigation of rear garage option.

motions.title: Building Licences Approved Under Delegated Authority
motions.description: Schedule of building licences approved under delegated authority for November 1995. Total 49 building licences with combined value of $2,542,842. Also includes 1 sign licence, 3 preliminary building licences, and 5 demolition licences. Cumulative totals July-November 1995: 182 building licences valued at $11,837,879.

motions.title: 47 Dampier Avenue, City Beach - Additions
motions.description: Application for renovations and additions including garage on boundary with nil side setback (required 1.0 metre). Adjoining neighbour opposed due to perceived loss of amenity. Council considers impact minimal due to wide driveway separation, swimming pool screen wall, lower site level, and garage setback 1.2 metres behind building line. Approval recommended subject to roof design amendment to minimize height.

motions.title: Lot 101 Glen Street Leederville - Proposed Double Storey Residence
motions.description: Application by Buildwise on behalf of Mr and [private individual — name withheld] to construct a two storey residence on a recently created lot with an area of 248 square metres. The application does not comply with Residential Planning Codes provisions pertaining to side, rear and front setbacks, and Council Policy No. 13 on Plot Ratio. Previous similar application was refused on 14 November 1995. This revised application includes modified plans with reduced side and rear setbacks, and upper bedroom windows reduced to minor openings.

motions.title: Immunisation - Australian Childhood Immunisation Register
motions.description: Council is invited to participate in a two year trial programme of the Australian Childhood Immunisation Register administered by the Health Insurance Commission. The register records immunisations for children 0-6 years old. Council would become a registered provider and receive payment of $6 per child for providing immunisation information in either paper or electronic format. Cr Smith expressed concern about collection and release of medical information.

motions.title: Traffic Management - Systems to Prioritise Projects and Public Consultation
motions.description: Report on traffic management proposals including process for allocating priorities and community consultation. Report addresses road hazards, signs, parking, traffic management treatments and community consultation procedures. Proposes that traffic management projects be prioritised based on road hierarchy, traffic volume, speed, accidents and social issues. Recommends community consultation approach including letter box drop surveys and community consultation committees.

motions.title: Waste Management - Concept and Objectives
motions.description: Report on waste management strategies and objectives. Council agreed on objectives for waste minimisation, collection and disposal. Project team identified five implementation options. Further work recommends two bin system (general waste and recycling) with re-tender exercise. Also considers bulk collection tender evaluation.

motions.title: Waste Management - Bulk Collection Tender Acceptance
motions.description: Four tenders received for bulk waste collection services. Project team evaluated against organisational profile and experience, and value for money. Alvito Pty Ltd identified as preferred tenderer with proven experience and lowest price of $81,000 per collection.

motions.title: Waste Management - Interim Agreement Extensions
motions.description: Current waste management contractors are Cleanaway (general, verge, commercial and public litter) and WA Recycling Co (recycled waste via crates and bulk collection points). Proposal to extend interim agreements until end of March 1996 at current agreed rates while re-tender exercise is undertaken.

motions.title: Waste Management - Re-tendering Exercise Deferred
motions.description: Motion to approve re-tendering exercise for waste management services on basis of two bins (general waste and recycling) with ownership alternatives for five year period was lost. Subsequent motion carried to further develop Council's position and prepare report for March 1996 with options on waste collection process.

motions.title: Waste Management - Monitoring Split Bin Systems
motions.description: Approval sought to monitor developments with split bin systems including regional trials in Perth WA and the enviro system.

motions.title: Waste Management - Budget Expenditure
motions.description: Approval sought to charge expenditure for bulk waste collection services and interim agreement extensions to Budget Item Community Amenities - Sanitation.

motions.title: Waste Management - BSD Consultants Engagement
motions.description: Approval sought to use BSD Consultants on an as required basis for waste management project to a maximum cost of $5,000, with expenditure charged to Infrastructure Funding - Consultancies.

motions.title: Waste Management - BSD Consultants Expenditure
motions.description: Approval sought to charge expenditure to engage BSD Consultants to a maximum cost of $5,000 to Infrastructure Funding - Consultancies.

motions.title: Waste Management - Conference Paper Distribution
motions.description: Request to provide all elected members with copy of Conference Paper issued by Australian Institute of Environmental Health at recently held National Environmental Health Conference.

motions.title: Tender - One Eight Tonne Tip Truck and One Seven/Eight Tonne Tip Truck with Crane
motions.description: Tenders called for purchase of two eight tonne tip trucks with side lifter (one with crane) for Council's road works team. Asset infrastructure funds allocated total of $182,000. Recommended supplier is Major Motors for Isuzu FVR 900 tip truck at $84,220 and Isuzu FVR 900 tip crane truck at $97,025 for total cost of $181,245 plus licensing. Selected supplier also supplies Council's bitumen truck.

motions.title: Metropolitan Local Road Fund Programme 1996/97
motions.description: Council resolved in August 1995 to prepare submissions for Main Roads WA under Metropolitan Local Road Fund Programme for 1996/97. Approved projects include improvement projects on The Boulevard, Empire Avenue roundabout, Howtree Place roundabout and Grantham Street T junction (total funds $670,000) and rehabilitation projects on Selby Street, Grantham Street and Cambridge Street (total funds $130,910). Regional meeting approved with Main Roads WA contributing $442,000 to improvement project and $87,274 to rehabilitation projects, with Council contributing one third ($228,000 improvement and $43,636 rehabilitation).

motions.title: Woolwich and McCourt Streets, West Leederville - No Verge Parking Restrictions
motions.description: Local residents reported indiscriminate parking on verges adjacent to park at corner of Woolwich and McCourt Streets, West Leederville, particularly during football season. Proposal to impose no verge parking restrictions on northern verge of Woolwich Street (40 metres westwards from McCourt Street) and western verge of McCourt Street (36 metres northwards from Woolwich Street), operative at all times.

motions.title: Station Street Wembley - Two Hour Parking Restriction
motions.description: Proprietor in area expressed concern that customers have difficulty finding parking. Investigation found private parking at rear of premises 100% utilised, Station Street parking 95% utilised with long term parking, and high demand for long term parking overall. Most local business proprietors receptive to two hour restriction. Proposal to impose two hour parking restriction on eastern side of Station Street commencing six metres north of Cambridge Street and extending 38.4 metres northwards, operative Monday to Sunday from 8.00am to 5.00pm.

motions.title: Stephenson Avenue, Rochdale Road Intersection - Road Upgrading
motions.description: Metropolitan Region Scheme Amendment 967/33 addresses proposed amendment to extend road reserve into M47. Report examines alternative road modifications to present intersection to direct traffic to West Coast Highway and regional road network while protecting vegetation and ethnographic sites. Council officers held discussions with City of Nedlands and Departments of Planning and Environmental Protection to identify constraints. Conclusion that only one alternative alignment exists with 300 metre radius that would remove some trees.

motions.title: Better Cities Programme - City to Sea Greenway
motions.description: Town of Cambridge approached by Better Cities Programme regarding construction of greenway for cyclists and pedestrians through parts of the Town. Programme includes plan to establish greenway from city to sea with some progress in areas east of Perth and plans for continuation through Subiaco Redevelopment area. Funding on two for one basis with initial expectation of $60,000 from Town. Funds available in financial year 1995/96 with requirement for expenditure in that year. Intent is for green route with no vehicle access.

motions.title: Tender - Supply of trucks
motions.description: Assessment and acceptance of tender for supply and delivery of two trucks for Town Parks operations. The Hino Dyna 200 was recommended as most suitable despite being 14% higher in price than the lowest bid, based on performance capability, organisation reputation, and value for money.

motions.title: Garden Week Site - Preparation of Master Plan
motions.description: Council endorsed recommendation to obtain bids for preparation of master plan to improve Garden Week site at Perry Lakes. Set as joint project with Nursery Industries Association with Council contribution of $3,000 to projected cost of $6,000. Initial bids from landscape architects resulted in tendered price of $10,800 (above budget). Project team then identified competent landscape designers. Peter Coyne and Associates assessed as preferred tenderer with demonstrated experience in diverse public usage facilities and industry awards.

motions.title: Tender - Two Dual Cab 1.5 Tonne Trucks with Side Lifter and Steel Tray Body
motions.description: Tender 55-95 advertised for supply and delivery of two dual cab 1.5 tonne trucks with side lifter and steel tray body. Tender closed 5 December 1995 with three bids from three companies. Specification called for diesel engine, dual cab, seating capacity of six, manual transmission, air conditioning, power steering, window tinting, tow bar, mud flaps, sunvisor, fire extinguisher, hour meter and side lifter. Asset infrastructure funding of $70,000 available. Vehicles proposed for use by Parks staff for maintenance tasks.

motions.title: Perry Lakes Stadium lease to Western Reds
motions.description: Council amendment to lease offer for Western Reds Rugby League Club for office accommodation and gymnasium at Perry Lakes Stadium. Lease term modified from three to two years with five-year renewal option, and security requirement changed from $100,000 bank guarantee to bond equal to annual lease payment.

motions.title: Wembley Pre Primary Centre lease to Education Department
motions.description: Transfer of lease from Wembley Kindergarten Inc to Education Department for five years from 1 January 1996 with five-year renewal option at $1,500 per annum plus CPI adjustments, allowing implementation of Good Start Program.

motions.description: Request by B Mosson to establish portable bicycle hire service at Lake Monger Reserve refused by Council due to existing conflict problems between cyclists and pedestrians on the dual-use path and need for pathway upgrades before allowing increased cycle use.

motions.description: Progress report on Private Swimming Pool Inspection Programme. Establishment of reliable pools database using multiple information systems. Physical inspection of private pools to commence in second week of November, starting with City Beach.

motions.title: Lot 101 Glen Street, Leederville - Proposed Double Storey Residence
motions.description: Application for preliminary approval to construct a two storey residence on Lot 101 Glen Street, Leederville. The proposal does not comply with Residential Planning Codes or Council Policy No. 13 regarding plot ratio, setbacks, and open space provisions. Issues include non-compliance with setback requirements and concerns about privacy and visual impact on the streetscape.

motions.title: Immunisation Clinics - Report Received
motions.description: Report on two late afternoon immunisation clinics conducted on 24 October 1995 at Wembley Infant Health Clinic and 26 October 1995 at City Beach Infant Health Clinic. Clinics immunised 103 people across three target groups (Grade 1 students, Grade 7 students, and adults). A comparison with previous school immunisation programme results shows reduced attendance of school-aged children but successful adult immunisation.

motions.title: 3 Kintyre Crescent, Floreat Park - Health Act Notice
motions.description: Health Act Notice relating to 3 Kintyre Crescent, Floreat Park (Lot 1023, Volume 1192, Folio 791, Plan 6558). Property found to be substandard, insanitary, and unfit for human habitation. Owner/occupier (Estate of late Lina Didus) to be required to clean and disinfect within seven days. Property currently occupied by [private individual — name withheld] d'Unieville (alias [private individual — name withheld]).

motions.title: Tender - One Bitumen Road Patching Truck Tender No. 18VP-95
motions.description: Tender for purchase of one bitumen road patching truck with Flocon body and equipment. Budget allocation: $100,000. Recommended tender: Major Motors Isuzu FSR500 chassis with Flocon body. Total cost: $97,048.

motions.title: Tenders for Supply of Truck Hire, Plant Hire, Bitumen Supply and Related Services
motions.description: Multiple tenders for supply of truck hire, plant hire, bitumen supply and lay, brick paving, bitumen pavement profiling, sand, premixed concrete, and crushed limestone. Period contracts for 12 months with preferred suppliers based on lowest price.

motions.title: Tender - One Four Tonne Truck - Tender No. 35-95
motions.description: Tender for purchase of one four tonne truck to carry water for road construction work. Budget allocation: $100,000. Truck specified with 3,000 litre water tank, pump, spray bar, hydraulic side lifter, and tipping body. Recommended tender: Major Motors Isuzu NPR400 equipped with water tank and fittings at total cost of $53,298.

motions.title: Tender for Supply and Delivery of Two 3 Tonne Dual Cab Trucks with Side Lifter
motions.description: Tender for supply and delivery of two 3 tonne dual cab trucks with side lifter. Vehicles proposed for use by Works staff in road repairs and drainage. Recommended tender: Midway Ford for two Ford Trader 0509 trucks at cost of $36,755 each with $795 engine upgrade. Second truck to be reconfigured to single cab with tipper hoist, resulting in $3,048 saving.

motions.title: Huddleston Road, Mount Claremont - Closure
motions.description: Request from Wollaston College Management Committee to close Huddleston Road, a partially made, disused, and isolated road running along the southern boundary of the College grounds. Road is approximately 170 metres long, mostly overgrown, with deteriorating surface. Issues include unauthorised dumping and anti-social behaviour. Closure to be implemented via Section 331B of Local Government Act.

motions.title: Challenger Parade, City Beach No Standing and No Parking Restrictions
motions.description: Implementation of no standing and no parking restrictions on Challenger Parade between Jubilee Crescent/Oceanic Drive and West Coast Highway to improve safety for motorists exiting car parks and for pedestrians and cyclists. Amendment made during discussion to change terminology from 'bus stops' to 'bus/coach stops'.

motions.title: Challenger Parade Restrictions - Amendment to Motion
motions.description: Amendment to change terminology in original motion from 'bus stops' to 'bus/coach stops' to allow for coaches in addition to buses.

motions.title: Grantham Street, Floreat - No Standing Restriction
motions.description: Implementation of no standing anytime restriction on northern side of Grantham Street, Floreat to improve sight distance for motorists exiting Kenmore Crescent. Restriction to commence 6 metres west of Kenmore Crescent and extend 14 metres westwards.

motions.title: Realignment - West Coast Highway
motions.description: Project to realign section of West Coast Highway at City Beach scheduled for early 1996. Progress report from Main Roads WA addressing key issues raised at public meeting on 27 September 1995 including safety, intersection improvements, underpass, noise, traffic volumes, and related matters. Town of Cambridge to continue liaison with Main Roads WA.

motions.title: Tender for Supply and Delivery of One Seven Gang Tractor Mower - Tender 44-95
motions.description: Tender for supply and delivery of one seven gang tractor mower with specifications including 38 KW diesel engine, fully enclosed cab, roll-over protection, maximum 85 dB noise level. Tender advertised 30 September 1995, closed 16 October 1995, attracted three bids from two companies. Assessment panel: Co-ordinator Parks and Landscaping, Section Crew Leader, Mowing Crew Leader. Recommended: Wattleup Tractors Option A (Massey Ferguson 362 with Ransomes mower) at $91,609.

motions.title: Tender for Supply and Delivery of One Six Cylinder Diesel Four Wheel Drive Utility - Tender No 45-95
motions.description: Tender for supply and delivery of one six cylinder diesel four wheel drive utility for use in Parks area for fire fighting role. Specifications include manual transmission, air-conditioning, power steering, alloy dropside tray, towbar, mud flaps, mirrors, off-road tyres, heavy-duty suspension, alloy roobar, front winch. Tender advertised 30 September 1995, closed 16 October 1995, attracted four bids from three companies. Recommended: Melville Toyota for Toyota Landcruiser HZJ75 at $36,597.

motions.title: Policy - Management of Street Trees
motions.description: Review and recast of existing policies on street trees (Policy No 36, No 150, No 151). New single comprehensive policy addresses planting, pruning and removal of street trees. Original motion for adoption followed by deferral motion after discussion and proposed amendments.

motions.title: Floreat Library - Submission to LISWA for Additional Library Stock
motions.description: Submission to Library and Information Service of Western Australia (LISWA) for additional library stock for Floreat Library for 1996/97 and four outyears to 2001. Current stock allocation (27,370 items) falls short of recommended standards (46,062 items). Stock shortfall: 18,692 items. Library is 30 years old and requires major refurbishment. Budget provision: $10,000 for architectural assessment. Motion initially proposed adoption of three clauses, but amendments made during discussion to clarify language regarding facility improvements and strategic review.

motions.title: Floreat Library Motion - Amendment
motions.description: Amendment to clarify and revise Clauses (ii) and (iii) of the Floreat Library motion to address confusion about facility improvements versus strategic review.

motions.title: Assignment of Lease - City Beach Kiosk No 2, Challenger Parade, City Beach
motions.description: Assignment of existing kiosk lease from current operator Andrea Simonelli (20 years operation) to William Jim Taylor and Valma Taylor, both of City Beach. Lease assignment effective 16 November 1995. Assignees to be granted three-year option of renewal from 1 April 1997 to 31 March 2000. Business purchase price: $45,000. Current annual rent: $3,250. Taylors have extensive retail and small business experience including operation of souvenir shops, wildflower business, and community involvement in City Beach for 34 years.

motions.title: Soccer Administration WA Sub-lease to Coaching Foundation
motions.description: Approval for Soccer Administration of WA to sub-lease a portion of their leased premises at Sir Thomas Meagher Pavilion, Perry Lakes Stadium to Western Australian Coaching Foundation. Sub-lease area approximately 86 square metres at $2,660 per annum. Subject to approval of Hon Minister for Local Government and Section 267 of Local Government Act 1960.

motions.title: Perry Lakes Stadium Lease and Licence to Western Reds Rugby League Club
motions.description: Offer of lease and licence to Western Reds Rugby League Club for accommodation within Sir Thomas Meagher Pavilion (864 square metres at $30,000 per annum) and use of inner athletics track for training (licence at $36,000 per annum). Five-year terms with five-year options. Includes break clause for special events, insurance requirements, and condition that night lighting approval is not granted.

motions.title: WA Indoor Rock Climbing Gym Sub-lease Approval
motions.description: Approval for 1st Wembley Scout Association to sub-lease portion of their premises to WA Indoor Rock Climbing Gym for construction of outdoor climbing wall. Area approximately 20m x 15m. Sub-lease on monthly tenancy basis. Requires indemnity from gym and implementation of security/safety measures.

motions.title: Investment Schedule as at 31 October 1995
motions.description: Receipt and review of investment schedule showing surplus funds invested and their distribution. Total interest earned at 31 October 1995 was $99,598, representing 41.5% of investment budget. Council investments comply with policy limiting 25% of available funds to any one institution.

motions.title: Financial Statements for Period Ended 31 October 1995
motions.description: Receipt of financial statements for the period ended 31 October 1995. Cr Moore requested commentary on items significantly over or under budget and suggested surplus over budgeted interest be set aside for community projects and special donations.

motions.title: Accounts for Payment
motions.description: Confirmation of schedule of accounts for payment in accordance with Clause 8(3)(e) of Local Government Accounting Directions 1994. Four recoup advance accounts totalling $419,788.80.

motions.title: Audit Services Tender 1995-1998 Triennium
motions.description: Joint tender for audit services by Towns of Cambridge, Victoria Park and Vincent for three-year period 1 July 1995 to 30 June 1998. Nine tenders received; two late tenders excluded. Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu selected as most suitable for group price of $16,000 (three years). Grant Thornton selected as alternative if other towns do not accept group arrangement.

motions.title: Nomination for Curtin University Heritage Studies Committee
motions.description: Receipt of request for nomination of council member to Curtin University's Centre for Cultural Heritage Studies Advisory Committee. Three-year term. Committee meets yearly at Curtin University for two hours. Member should have knowledge of local government heritage issues.

motions.title: Appointment to Graffiti Programme Steering Committee
motions.description: Nomination and appointment of Cr MacRae as member of WAMA Graffiti Programme Steering Committee for three-year term. Committee meets every six weeks and includes representatives from government and non-government agencies coordinating graffiti programme action.

motions.title: Vary Order of Business - Urgent Business
motions.description: Variation of order of business to bring forward urgent business item relating to West Leederville/Wembley Football Parking Assessment for discussion prior to related matter on night lighting of Subiaco Oval.

motions.title: West Leederville/Wembley Football Parking Assessment
motions.description: Acceptance of Football Parking Assessment prepared by BSD Consultants Pty Ltd and formation of working group to investigate implementation of recommendations. Additional expenditure of $3,000 approved for study area extension.

motions.description: Approval for leave of absence for Cr M Anderton for the Council meeting to be held on 28 November 1995

motions.title: Home Occupation Language Service at 240 Oceanic Drive
motions.description: Application for home occupation (office for language services) at 240 Oceanic Drive, City Beach. Applicant proposes to use one bedroom as office for interpreting and translation services. Two formal submissions received expressing concern over parking and property devaluation.

motions.title: Home Occupation Renewal Tennis Coaching at 10 Orrel Avenue
motions.description: Application for renewal of home occupation for tennis coaching lessons at 10 Orrel Avenue, Floreat. Original approval granted November 1994 with conditions limiting hours and visitor numbers. Objection received from neighbour citing noise, traffic, and lighting issues, with restraining orders granted against applicant.

motions.title: Two 2-Storey Attached Houses at 28 Barrett Street Wembley
motions.description: Application for preliminary building approval for construction of two 2-storey attached houses at 28 Barrett Street, Wembley. Proposal exceeds Council's plot ratio policy of 0.4:1.0 by 38 square metres (0.45:1.0 proposed). Motion for approval moved, but during discussion councillors disagreed on whether excess is significant.

motions.title: Aged Persons Dwelling at 495 Cambridge Street Floreat
motions.description: Application to construct aged persons dwelling at rear of existing two-unit development. Applicants seeking to exercise Council discretion for density bonus of up to 50 percent for aged persons accommodation. Proposal exceeds residential density code for area.

motions.title: Minor Addition to Real Estate Agency at 31 Gayton Road
motions.description: Application for minor 10 square metre addition to real estate agency at shopping centre. Proposal exceeds plot ratio requirements and parking provisions. Extension designed to accommodate on-site management function.

motions.title: Metropolitan Region Scheme Amendment 967/33 Bold Park
motions.description: Report on proposed major amendment to MRS for Bold Park and environs. Amendment endorsed by Governor and will be tabled in Parliament. Modified form addresses some Council submissions but retains Stephenson Highway proposal through natural bushland which Council opposes.

motions.title: Garage in Front Setback at 415 Vincent Street West
motions.description: Application for double garage with reduced primary street setback. Proposal does not comply with R Codes or Council Policy No. 7. Adjoining neighbour unwilling to support despite applicants' interest in future pool. Mayor exercised casting vote.

motions.title: Retaining Wall at 11 Gibney Vista Leederville
motions.description: Application for retaining wall on vacant lot with two street frontages. Proposed wall up to 2.5 metres high would significantly impact streetscape and adjoining property. Site levels substantially from boundary to street.

motions.title: Double Garage at 29 Ulster Road Corner Roscommon Road Floreat
motions.description: Application for double garage with reduced setback at 29 Ulster Road, Floreat. Does not comply with By-law No. 43 setback requirements. Garage partially below existing house floor level. Adjoining neighbour provided favourable reply.

motions.title: Building Licences Approval 438 and 440 Vincent Street West
motions.description: Council approval for building licences exceeding $175,000. Two projects: Shean Pty Ltd office building at 440 Vincent Street West ($250,000) and addition to office at 438 Vincent Street West ($200,000).

motions.title: Two 2-Storey Attached Houses at 6 Carlton Street West Leederville
motions.description: Application for preliminary building approval for two 2-storey attached houses. Exceeds plot ratio policy and R Code setback provisions. Neighbour concerns about overshadowing and drainage. Motion previously lost at 10 October meeting; resubmitted under Standing Orders provision.

motions.title: Purchase of Depot Facilities Site at Lemnos Street Shenton Park
motions.description: Approval for purchase of Swan Location 12496 (Lemnos Street, Shenton Park) at cost of $665,000 plus fees for works depot. Council previously approved in principle on 27 June 1995. CEOs authorised to negotiate with Water Authority for existing improvements and call tenders for design and construction.

motions.title: Coastal Management Regional Strategy Contribution
motions.description: Approval for Town's contribution of $10,000 to co-operative local government initiative 'Fremantle to Floreat - A Regional Strategy for Coastal Management'. Funds reallocated from savings on beach protection investigation. Contribution spread over two financial years.

motions.title: Sunset Coast Tourist Drive signage approval
motions.description: Proposal by Main Roads WA to establish dedicated signage of the Sunset Coast Tourist Drive and associated attractions along Challenger Parade/West Coast Highway in City Beach.

motions.title: Tender acceptance - 37KW hydraulic mowers
motions.description: Tender for the supply and delivery of two 4 wheel drive 37 KW hydraulic mowers for golf complex. Three complying bids assessed on conformity, performance, organisation, and value for money. Victa Lawnmowers recommendation selected based on historical performance, operator knowledge, terrain suitability and reliability.

motions.title: Tender acceptance - 20KW hydraulic mowers
motions.description: Tender for the supply and delivery of two 20KW hydraulic mowers for golf complex. Four bids received with one non-complying. Three complying tenders assessed on specification conformity, historical performance, organisation profile, and value for money. Victa Lawnmowers selected based on superior performance capability at Wembley Golf Course.

motions.title: Tender acceptance - 15-18KW ride on rotary mowers
motions.description: Tender for the supply and delivery of five 4 wheel drive 15-18KW ride on rotary mowers for golf complex. Nine bids received with one non-complying. Eight complying bids assessed on specification, performance, organisation, and value. CJD Equipment selected for John Deere F1145 based on superior historical performance and lowest cost.

motions.title: Tender acceptance - triplex greens mowers
motions.description: Tender for the supply and delivery of three 12KW triplex greens mowers for golf complex. Five bids received with two non-complying. Three complying bids assessed. McIntosh & Son recommended for Jacobsen Greensking IV based on historical performance consistency with existing fleet and value for money.

motions.title: Tender acceptance - 47KW 4WD tractors
motions.description: Tender for the supply and delivery of two 4 wheel drive 47KW tractors for golf complex. Seven bids received with all complying with specification. Assessed on performance, organisation, and value. Wattleup Tractors selected for Massey Ferguson 390 based on historical performance and operator knowledge, consistent with existing fleet.

motions.title: Street tree removal and replacement - Marlow and Grantham Streets
motions.description: Request from Councillor regarding removal and replacement of street tree at corner of Marlow and Grantham Streets, Wembley. Tree fell on 12 September 1995 due to termite infestation. Report from tree surgeon details poor condition. Council Policy No. 151 requires trees planted minimum five metres from driveway crossover. Amendment moved to plant replacement tree as mature as possible with metal guard.

motions.title: National Public Libraries Conference attendance
motions.description: Council registration for 1995 National Public Libraries Conference in Sydney 12-15 November 1995. Theme 'Public Libraries - What are they Worth?'. Policy No. 49 allows max two councillors and one officer attendance at interstate conferences. Councillor K Smith and Executive Manager Corporate & Customer Services proposed. Clauses (i) and (ii) carried; Clause (iii) requiring absolute majority for unbudgeted expenditure lost.

motions.title: Disability Services Plan - consultant engagement
motions.description: Western Australian Disability Services Act (1993) requires each local government to develop and implement a disability service plan. Town must lodge plan by 1 January 1996.
