motions.title: Home Occupation at 58 Essex Street, Wembley
motions.description: Application by B M Cornille to use one room of residence (10 square metres) as office and part of garage for storage. Mail order business, sole operator. Equipment: telephone only. Operating hours: 9.00 am to 3.00 pm weekdays maximum. Occasional deliveries (estimated once every two months). One telephone response received with no objection provided no increase in traffic.

motions.title: Draft Planning Policy: Satellite Dishes and Antennae
motions.description: Draft policy for Domestic Satellite Dishes, Microwave Antennae and Tower Masts. Policy establishes criteria for approval and exemptions, addresses visual impact, includes administration requirements including fees and delegated authority provisions. One month public advertising period proposed.

motions.title: Building Licences Approved Under Delegated Authority
motions.description: Schedule of building licences approved under delegated authority for the month of July 1995.

motions.title: Building Licence for Medical Rooms at 160B Cambridge Street
motions.description: Application from Sam Butto, Architects on behalf of [private individual — name withheld] for construction of Medical Rooms (Eye Specialist). Works include one lower level undercraft carport, two procedure rooms, sterilisation room and administration areas on upper level. Project value $380,000. Development Application approved 17 January 1995. Building Licence approval required as project exceeds $175,000.

motions.title: Two Storey Residence at 10 Kavanagh Street, West Leederville
motions.description: Application for two storey residence exceeding Council Policy No 13 plot ratio for R30 area (0.462:1 proposed vs 0.4:1 required). Council previously refused similar application. New application with reduced floor area (17.54 square metres reduction) and increased rear setback (1.6 metres additional). Owners of rear property have approved subject to conditions. Absolute majority required due to non-compliance with plot ratio policy.

motions.title: Proposed Studio at 137 The Boulevard, Floreat
motions.description: Application to construct studio on western side boundary. Studio wall 6.0 metres long, 3.0 metres high, with nil setback (1.0 metre required). Adjoining neighbour objected due to loss of light and amenity. Studio would cover existing glass block panel in neighbour's boundary wall. Proposal recommended for refusal. Discussion noted valid objection from neighbour and deferred for further consideration.

motions.title: Street Parking Monitoring in West Leederville and Wembley
motions.description: Appointment of BSD Consultants to undertake monitoring tasks related to street parking in West Leederville and Wembley at cost of $12,000 (including $1,000 disbursement sum). Tasks include leaflet drop, resident survey, parking surveys during football and non-football events, and analysis report. Monitoring Group established June 1995. Bids received from BSD Consultants ($12,000) and Mitchell McCotter ($15,100).

motions.title: West Coast Highway Environmental Conditions
motions.description: Progress report on environmental conditions associated with realignment of West Coast Highway. Report received from Environmental Protection Authority recommends modified Option H alignment with reduced environmental impacts while maintaining 350 metre radius curve. 14-day appeal period follows release of report. Main Roads Western Australia advises no difficulty with compliance and construction timeframe April to June 1996 unlikely to be compromised.

motions.title: Lake Monger Management Plan
motions.description: Information report on Lake Monger Management Plan completed May 1993 and adopted by former Perth City Council. Plan comprises background and management sections covering lake, fauna, recreational use, access, landscape, maintenance, education/research, signs and reserve zoning. Rehabilitation Plan established eleven zones for priority work. Initial priorities Zones 7-11 from freeway footbridge north to Dodd Street reserve. Budget 1995/96 provision of $70,000 for rehabilitation work and $291,000 for operating/maintenance plus capital works of $55,000.

motions.title: Garden Week at Perry Lakes Reserve
motions.description: Approval for conduct of Garden Week 1996 at Perry Lakes Reserve 18-23 April 1996. Nursery Industries Association proposes establishment of permanent infrastructure including pathways and reticulation. Agreement includes $6,000 fee from Association and Town's promotional support. Proposal for shared cost master plan development estimated $6,000 total with Town's contribution $3,000. Some Member concern expressed but majority supported recommendation.

motions.title: Coastal Management - Beach Protection Investigation
motions.description: Approval to engage Department of Transport to investigate beach protection options for Town coastal strip following erosion damage in early winter 1995. Initial investigative work estimated $21,000. Department of Transport funding may be available on 3:1 basis (3 parts Department, 1 part Town). Study undertaken separately from intended study on beachfront facilities. Cr Smith indicated intention to submit Notice of Motion to next meeting.

motions.title: Cat Sterilisation Scheme
motions.description: Information report on Cat Sterilisation Scheme conducted March to June for past two years. Scheme results in reduction of cat population. Intention to continue scheme. Background includes: approximately 10,000 cats euthanased annually by Cat Welfare Society; unwanted cat population remains high; cats produce three litters per year with 2-9 kittens (mean 4.4); cats prey on native birds, mammals and reptiles. Document appears incomplete (ends mid-page).

motions.title: Works Bonds Fees and Charges 1995/96
motions.description: Adoption of the table of works bonds for 1995/96 as proposed, effective from 9 August 1995. The bonds cover residential and commercial developments.

motions.title: Subiaco Oval Events Funding
motions.description: Request from Department of Transport for contribution of $5,000 for promotional campaign to encourage football patrons to utilise public transport when attending Subiaco Oval. Council refused the request.

motions.title: Financial Statements Period Ended 30 April 1995
motions.description: Receiving of financial statements for the period ended 30 April 1995.

motions.title: Accounts for Payment
motions.description: Confirmation of schedule of accounts for payment in accordance with Local Government Accounting Directions 1994.

motions.title: 1995/96 Draft Budget Adoption
motions.description: Formal adoption of the 1995/96 budget for the financial year ending 30 June 1996, including operating, capital, reserve and cash flow budgets. Also establishes general rates, minimum rate, penalty rates, swimming pool inspection fees, and early payment incentive scheme.

motions.title: Significant Accounting Policies Adoption
motions.description: Adoption of Significant Accounting Policies for financial reporting and appointment of Executive Manager Corporate and Customer Services as Principal Accounting Officer.

motions.title: Deed - City of Perth Rate Arrears and Deferred Rates
motions.description: Council to enter into a Deed with the City of Perth regarding arrears and deferred rates levied prior to 1 July 1994, with Mayor and Chief Executive Officer authorised to sign and seal the document.

motions.title: $1 Million Capital Expenditure Reserve
motions.description: Receiving advice from Minister for Local Government on Government decision to provide $1 million for capital expenditure reserve, and transfer of funds to Capital Improvements section of Area Improvement Reserve.

motions.title: Matthews Netball Centre Redevelopment Report
motions.description: Receiving report relating to proposed redevelopment of Matthews Netball Centre, including scope of work, indicative costs and potential funding sources.

motions.title: 1995 Classic Car Rally Event
motions.description: Approval for use of Perry Lakes Drive and Reabold Hill Drive on 10 September 1995 for part of the 1995 Classic Car Rally, subject to various conditions including police and motor sports approvals, parking arrangements, public liability insurance, and a $2,000 bond.

motions.title: Review of Beach Front Facilities
motions.description: Motion to commence preparation of a report on assessment of existing beach front facilities and to invite public comment on future needs and facilities. Amendments clarified the scope to preliminary assessment and defined the geographic area of study.

motions.title: Vary Order of Business
motions.description: Procedural motion to vary the order of business to bring forward urgent business item regarding Ocean Gardens Retirement Estate.

motions.title: Confirmation of Minutes 25 July 1995
motions.description: Confirmation of minutes from Ordinary Meeting held on 25 July 1995 with addition to Item 10.1.7 regarding Metropolitan Region Scheme (Bold Park) Amendment.

motions.title: Confirmation of Minutes 1 August 1995
motions.description: Confirmation of minutes from Special Meeting held on 1 August 1995.

motions.title: Vary Order of Business - Ocean Gardens Retirement Estate
motions.description: Motion to vary order of business to deal with urgent business relating to Ocean Gardens Retirement Estate at 6.08 pm due to attendance of Council's legal representative [private individual — name withheld].

motions.title: Confidential Treatment of Ocean Gardens Matter
motions.description: Motion to treat Ocean Gardens Retirement Estate matter as confidential and conduct meeting behind closed doors due to sensitive nature of the item.

motions.title: Suspend Standing Orders Sub-Clause 3.3.4
motions.description: Motion to suspend operations of Sub-Clause 3.3.4 of the Standing Orders to conduct confidential discussion on Ocean Gardens Retirement Estate matter.

motions.title: Resume Standing Orders and Open Doors
motions.description: Motion to resume operations of Sub-Clause 3.3.4 of the Standing Orders and proceed with open doors following confidential discussion on Ocean Gardens Retirement Estate.

motions.title: Receive written update report on asset recovery
motions.description: Written update report on discussions with State Government and City of Perth regarding recovery of Council's share of Mindarie Lands, Roberts Street Depot, Ocean Gardens Retirement Estate guarantees and trust funds, Bold Regional Park Lands, and One Million Dollars Cash Establishment Grant.

motions.title: Motion that motion now be put
motions.description: Procedural motion to put the previous motion.

motions.title: Write to Premier regarding Bold Park Lands with amendment
motions.description: Council to write to The Premier of Western Australia regarding the Bold Park Lands comprising the Bold Regional Park and owned by the Town of Cambridge. Amendment adds clause requiring advice from legal representative D McLeod in preparation of the letter.

motions.title: Seek consultation on Mindarie and Roberts Street Depot asset recovery
motions.description: Council to seek urgent consultation with Towns of Vincent and Victoria Park to determine action taken regarding recovery of share of Mindarie (Tamala Park) and Roberts Street Depot assets, and submit report.

motions.title: Request Minister ensure transfer of Ocean Gardens guarantees
motions.description: Request to Hon Minister for Local Government to exercise authority to ensure guarantees of performance of lessors' covenants for Ocean Gardens Retirement Estate are transferred to Town of Cambridge and surrendered from control of City of Perth as per City of Perth Council resolution dated 2 May 1995.

motions.title: 111 Harborne Street, Wembley - Proposed Subdivision
motions.description: Application to subdivide an 860 square metre lot into two lots of 430 square metres each. The application does not comply with Town Planning Scheme lot size requirements. The existing dwelling would require demolition.

motions.title: 2 Peebles Road, Floreat - Proposed Subdivision (Amended Plan)
motions.description: Application to subdivide a 1,467 square metre lot into two lots. Amended plan proposes demolition of existing dwelling to achieve regular lot boundaries. Council previously recommended refusal but applicant revised proposal following discussions.

motions.title: 33 Oceanic Drive, Floreat - Home Occupation (Occasional Children's Art and Craft Classes)
motions.description: Application to operate occasional children's art and craft classes from a residential dwelling. Classes proposed for one hour duration on Tuesday afternoons during school terms for approximately five students aged 7-9 years.

motions.title: 343A Cambridge Street, Wembley - Illuminated Roof Sign
motions.description: Application for planning consent for an illuminated roof sign advertising LJ Hooker tenancy adjoining Commonwealth Bank, Wembley. Sign dimensions 1200mm height by 3500mm length to display LJ Hooker company logo.

motions.title: 34 Reserve Street, Wembley - Two Lot Subdivision
motions.description: Application to subdivide a 1075 square metre lot into two lots of 542 and 541 square metres. Proposal complies with Residential Planning Codes but raises concerns about narrow frontages and disruption to existing streetscape pattern.

motions.title: 32-34 Salvado Road, Wembley - Medical Centre and Five Two Storey Residential Units
motions.description: Application for a single storey specialist medical centre with five two storey town houses. Project represents infill development within Salvado Road Residential/Office Precinct following approval rejection of earlier radiological clinic proposal.

motions.title: Metropolitan Region Scheme (Bold Park) Amendment - Public Hearing of Submissions
motions.description: Information item regarding public hearing sessions for MRS Bold Park Amendment. Council previously lodged submission raising concerns about Stephenson Highway alignment, land reclassification, and road realignment. Council has secured two 15-minute timeslots on 23 August 1995 to present its case.

motions.title: Lot 1804 (Nos 48-56) Grantham Street, Wembley - Roof Signs Appeal Decision of Minister for Planning
motions.description: Information item regarding Minister's appeal decision on roof sign application. Council had refused application for McDonald's directional sign. Minister upheld appeal, allowing sign to remain based on prior display of similar sign from at least 1977 and sign's relative insignificance.

motions.title: Lot 1804 (Nos 48-56) Grantham Street, Wembley - Roof Signs Appeal Amendment Motion
motions.description: Amendment to motion regarding roof sign appeal decision to advise Minister of Council's concerns regarding decision impact on streetscape.

motions.title: Building Licences Requiring Council Approval - Catherine McAuley Family Centre
motions.description: Application for major refurbishment of Frail Aged Hostel involving replacement of 42 bedrooms with shared facilities with 40 new bedrooms each with ensuite. Development approval previously granted under delegation on 25 May 1995. Project value exceeds $175,000 requiring Council approval.

motions.title: 50 Oban Road, City Beach - Double Garage Located on Side Boundary
motions.description: Application to construct a double garage on property boundary with nil side setback. Neighbouring owner has objected due to perceived loss of light and noise concerns. Council officers discussed with neighbours who remain opposed to development not complying with R Codes.

motions.title: 50 Oban Road, City Beach - Double Carport with Supporting Piers Located on Side Boundary
motions.description: Application to construct a double carport on side boundary with 500mm eaves clearance and piers on boundary. Amended proposal following previous garage refusal. In accordance with Council Policy No. 7 for structures within setback areas.

motions.title: 97 Evandale Street, Floreat - Two Storey Residence
motions.description: Application to construct two storey split level residence with undercroft garage seeking approval for reduced front setback from 9.0m to 4.0m. Concerns raised about precedent and scale compared to adjoining properties in suburb designed with deep setbacks.

motions.title: Pest Control
motions.description: Proposal to provide free rodenticide to residents for pest control. Council officers estimate $1,500 annual expenditure for free rodent baits. Addresses concerns about service level previously provided by City of Perth involving inspection and placement of baits.

motions.title: State Road Funds to Local Government
motions.description: Information item regarding state road funding review outcome distributed May 1995. Town of Cambridge allocation for 1995/96 direct grant is $51,136. Councils expected to contribute one-third of cost for specific capital road works projects.

motions.title: Wembley Golf Complex Redevelopment
motions.description: Approval of redevelopment of 'new' course at Wembley Golf Complex. Option Two recommended - limited improvements including increased course length, minimal upgrade of tees/greens/reticulation. Project cost $911,000 with additional $45,000 required in 1996/97 budget. GHD appointed as project manager at cost of $32,270.

motions.title: Electricity Usage Audit
motions.description: Approval for appointment of WA Energy Consultants to conduct electricity usage audit of Council buildings, parks and reserves. No cost for initial investigation with payment of 25 percent of achieved savings over twelve month period. Total 1994/95 electricity cost $290,000.

motions.title: Kiosk No. 3, Challenger Parade, City Beach
motions.description: Request from lessees Michael and Eleanor Ryder for approval in principle to extend kiosk or erect free standing structure. Lessees seek to address patron requests for proper seating with weather protection. Council to prepare report on future land use for entire beachfront area before decision.

motions.title: Dog Pound
motions.description: Report on dog pound operations currently located at City of Perth Depot. Four towns share operation on monthly rotating basis. Current annual budgeted costs $7,770. Alternative proposal to relocate impounded dogs to Dogs Refuge Home at Shenton Park at cost $150/week. Council may join Western Suburbs Combined Dog Control Committee.

motions.title: Dog Pound Relocation - Deferral Motion
motions.description: Motion to defer the relocation of the Town of Cambridge Dog Pound from Roberts Street Depot, Osborne Park to the Shenton Park Dogs Refuge Home. Members had previously considered this matter and further information was provided from other municipalities utilising the facility.

motions.title: Postal Voting Election Costs
motions.description: Motion to advise the Minister for Local Government that the Council is only prepared to contribute $40,000 towards the total cost of the 1995 Postal Elections and request the State Government to pay the balance of costs incurred. The Electoral Commission estimated total costs at $700,000.

motions.title: Pat Goodridge Hockey Pavilion - Lease Renewal (Withdrawn)
motions.description: Initial motion to refuse the Western Australian Women's Hockey Association request for a lease renewal pending a review of all lease agreements for sporting clubs. This motion was withdrawn with the consent of mover and seconder.

motions.title: Pat Goodridge Hockey Pavilion - Lease Renewal (Monthly Basis)
motions.description: Motion to approve the Western Australian Women's Hockey Association to enter into a lease agreement on a monthly renewal basis pending a review of all lease agreements for sporting clubs.

motions.title: City Beach Shopping Centre - Parking Licence Extension
motions.description: Motion to retrospectively approve the extension of the licence between the Town of Cambridge, Trickey Investments Pty Ltd and G J & M L Pethwick for Council owned land adjacent to the City Beach Shopping Centre for a further five year period effective from 1 August 1994, with an increased licence fee.

motions.title: Floreat Surf Life Saving Club - Lease Deferral
motions.description: Motion to defer the lease agreement for the Floreat Surf Life Saving Club pending a review of all lease agreements for sporting clubs associated with recreation facilities.

motions.title: Building Licence Fees - Minimum Fee Increase
motions.description: Motion to increase the minimum building licence fee in accordance with amended Building Regulations from $25.00 to $40.00 effective from 1 July 1995.

motions.title: Wembley Golf Complex - Driving Range Fees and Concessions
motions.description: Motion to increase the fee for the large bucket at the driving range from $8.50 to $9.00 per bucket and to restrict pensioner and senior concessions on public holidays and weekends.

motions.title: Wembley Golf Complex - Motorised Golf Buggies Policy Amendment
motions.description: Motion to amend Policy Number 38 regarding motorised golf buggies to phase out private use by 2000, restrict new licences, and investigate provision of buggy hire service.

motions.title: Establishment of Particular Reserves
motions.description: Motion to reaffirm establishment of existing particular reserves and establish three new reserves: Plant and Equipment Reserve, Waste Management Reserve, and Area Improvement Reserve (amended to exclude recreation facilities).

motions.title: Rolling Stones Concert Fee Transfer to Reserve
motions.description: Motion to transfer the $100,000 fee received for the hire of Perry Lakes Stadium for the Rolling Stones Concert to the Area Improvement Reserve.

motions.title: 1995/96 Draft Budget - Referral for Adoption
motions.description: Motion to refer the Draft 1995/96 Budget, as amended, to the next Council meeting for formal adoption. The budget includes a 5% rate increase representing approximately $300,000 in additional revenue.

motions.title: Confidential Session - Fairway Tavern Rent Submission
motions.description: Confidential motion regarding Fairway Tavern rent arrears. Motion to amend previous Council resolution to permit the lessee extension to pay outstanding rent arrears and interest by 5 December 1995, with immediate invocation of default clause if rent falls into arrears in future.

motions.title: Rate Notice Information - Motion of Notice Lapsed
motions.description: Motion of which due notice was given by Cr Johnston to include on rate notices information about State Government failures in setting up the Town debt free and non-provision of funds. The motion lapsed for want of a seconder.

motions.title: Rates Increase - Note on Rates Notice
motions.description: Motion of which due notice has been given by Cr D Johnston regarding inclusion of note about rates increase on rates notices.

motions.title: Bold Park Senior Citizens' Centre and Homes (Inc) Known as Ocean Gardens Retirement Village
motions.description: Urgent business item regarding Bold Park Senior Citizens' Centre and Homes (Inc) known as Ocean Gardens Retirement Village.

motions.title: Ocean Gardens Retirement Estate - Urgent Business Motion
motions.description: Motion expressing concern regarding the Ocean Gardens Retirement Estate and authorising the Mayor to write to residents assuring them that the Council will hold surplus funds in trust for the benefit and creation of facilities and services for elderly persons within the Town.

motions.title: Leave of Absence - Cr A M Moore
motions.description: Request for approval of leave of absence for Cr A M Moore from 3 August to 21 August 1995 inclusive.

motions.title: Confirmation of Minutes - 11 July 1995
motions.description: Confirmation of minutes from the Ordinary Meeting held on 11 July 1995, subject to amendments regarding item 10.1.2 (290 Railway Parade, Leederville).

exceptions.finding: 9 application(s) decided this meeting, 4 refused, 2 drew at least one objection
exceptions.verdict: 9 application(s) decided this meeting: 4 refused, 2 drew at least one community objection.

exceptions.finding: 1 of 18 items closed to the public this meeting (5.6%)
exceptions.verdict: 1 of 18 items were taken confidential this meeting, vs a 3.8% rate across 460 comparable meetings.

exceptions.finding: 1 item(s) closed to the public this meeting
exceptions.verdict: 1 item(s) closed to the public this meeting: Fairway Tavern - Rent Submission (Confidential Item)

motions.title: Cr O'Connor attendance at National Assembly
motions.description: Authorization for Councillor O'Connor to accompany the Mayor to the 1995 National General Assembly of Australian Local Government in Canberra, with approved expenditure for airfares, accommodation, and conference registration.

motions.title: 2 Keaney Place, City Beach - Holy Spirit Catholic Primary School Alterations and Additions
motions.description: Application for single storey alterations and additions to Holy Spirit Catholic Primary School in City Beach, comprising construction of 2 additional classrooms, refurbishment of existing classrooms, new administration, storage, and facilities.

motions.title: 290 Railway Parade, Leederville - Conversion of Residence to Consulting Rooms
motions.description: Application for conversion of existing residence to consulting rooms comprising two consulting rooms, waiting room, office, staff room and reception.

motions.title: 19 Brighton Street and 34 Coldstream Street, Leederville - Removal of Age Restriction on Aged Persons' Units
motions.description: Application by Homeswest to remove the age restriction (55 & over) on five units at No. 19 Brighton Street and four units at No. 34 Coldstream Street to permit sale on the open market.

motions.title: Delegated Decisions and Notifications - Information Received
motions.description: Information received regarding delegated development approvals, subdivisions/amalgamations, and notifications for month ending 30 June 1995.

motions.title: State Print, Station Street, Wembley - Demolition of Office and Factory Buildings
motions.description: Application for planning consent for demolition of office and factory buildings at State Print facility to provide storage space during railway tunnel construction for Subiaco Redevelopment Project.

motions.title: Subiaco Redevelopment Project Local Authority Boundary Change
motions.description: Response to Minister for Planning regarding municipal boundary adjustment and financial contribution to Subiaco Redevelopment Project.

motions.title: 50 Oban Road, City Beach - Double Garage on Side Boundary
motions.description: Application for construction of double garage on side boundary with nil setback. Motion withdrawn following agreement that further negotiations between owners should occur.

motions.title: 12 Tate Street, Leederville - Garage on Side Boundary
motions.description: Application for construction of garage on dividing side boundary with nil setback. Adjoining neighbour objected due to overshadowing and scale concerns.

motions.title: Lot 153 Kavanagh Street, West Leederville - Two Storey Residence
motions.description: Application for construction of two storey dwelling with plot ratio non-compliance. First motion by Cr Anderton lapsed for want of seconder. Second motion by Cr McConnell carried refusing the application.

motions.title: Building Licences Approved Under Delegated Authority - Schedule Endorsed
motions.description: Schedule of building licences approved under delegated authority for month of June 1995, totalling in excess of $5.7 million.

motions.title: After Hours Emergency Services - Noise Control and Ranger Services
motions.description: Proposal to establish after hours noise control and ranger services with procedure adoption and budget allocation of $9,500 for 1995/96.

motions.title: City Beach Civic Centre - West Coast Bridge Club Lease Renewal
motions.description: Proposal to renew lease with West Coast Bridge Club for City Beach Civic Centre. Motion deferred for negotiations to occur. Councillors Anderton and McConnell nominated to negotiate with Bridge Club representatives and appropriate officers.

motions.title: Dog Pound - Relocation Deferred
motions.description: Proposal to relocate dog pound from Roberts Street Depot to Shenton Park Dogs Refuge Home. Motion deferred following concerns about past experiences with the Refuge Home.

motions.title: Review of fees and charges - halls and community centres
motions.description: Adoption of proposed fees and charges for halls and community centres for 1995/96, reflecting efficiency measures and simplified charging rates, effective 31 July 1995.

motions.title: Review of fees and charges - sportsgrounds and reserves
motions.description: Adoption of proposed fees and charges for sportsgrounds and reserves for 1995/96, with increases applied at CPI rate of 5%, effective 31 July 1995.

motions.title: Review of fees and charges - Bold Park Swimming Pool
motions.description: Adoption of proposed fees and charges for Bold Park Swimming Pool for 1995/96, maintaining consistent charges with neighbouring councils, effective 31 July 1995.

motions.title: Review of fees and charges - planning fees
motions.description: Adoption of proposed planning fees for 1995/96, based on comparisons with other metropolitan local authorities and recommendations by the Local Approvals Review Programme (LARP), effective 31 July 1995.

motions.title: Review of fees and charges - other miscellaneous
motions.description: Adoption of proposed miscellaneous fees and charges for 1995/96 covering dog pound, rubbish, health services, and administration, effective 31 July 1995.

motions.title: City Beach High School - Chaplaincy Service
motions.description: Financial support for Chaplaincy service at City Beach High School, with annual donation of $2,000 for three-year contract term, addressing community needs for counselling and social services.

motions.title: Quarry Amphitheatre lease request
motions.description: Request for Perth Theatre Trust to surrender lease of Quarry Amphitheatre to enable Town of Cambridge to manage the facility, and seek assistance from government representatives to facilitate lease termination.

motions.title: Confidential - Fairway Tavern rent submission
motions.description: Confidential matter regarding rental arrears and payment terms for the Fairway Tavern lease, dealt with in closed session.

motions.title: Basketball practice pads - investigation motion
motions.description: Council to investigate and report on recommended locations for installation of basketball/netball practice pads in suitable parks throughout the Town for the youth of Cambridge.

motions.title: Basketball practice pads - installation with reduced funding
motions.description: Council to proceed with installation of basketball/netball practice pads over two years with amended funding of $15,000 in 1995/96 only, following amendment to original motion for higher funding.

motions.title: Confirmation of Special Meeting Minutes 21 June 1995
motions.description: Confirmation of minutes of the Special Meeting held on 21 June 1995 with amendment to Item 4 regarding Bold Regional Park Boundaries.

motions.title: Confirmation of Ordinary Meeting Minutes 27 June 1995
motions.description: Confirmation of minutes of the Ordinary Meeting held on 27 June 1995 with three amendments relating to 1995 National General Assembly, Assignment of Lease - City Beach Kiosk, and Insurance Renewal.

motions.title: WAMA Self Insurance Schemes and Insurance Broking
motions.description: Council to participate in WAMA Self Insurance Schemes for Public Liability and Workers Compensation, renew other insurance classes with SGIO, appoint Sedgwicks as Insurance Brokers, and invite tenders for broking services.

motions.title: 438 Cambridge Street, Floreat - Additions to Veterinary Clinic
motions.description: Application to extend existing veterinary clinic to accommodate cat boarding, grooming and caretaker's quarters. 140 square metre extension at rear with caretaker's residence, cattery, store room and grooming/display area. No objections received from adjoining residents.

motions.title: 63 Alexander Street, Wembley - Dental Surgery Use - Refusal
motions.description: Application to use part of existing residence as consulting rooms (dental surgery) in residential R20 zone. Advertising procedure completed with 11 submissions and one petition (31 signatures) received, all objecting. Concerns raised regarding traffic, parking, security, property values and amenity impact.

motions.title: Draft Residential Planning Codes (R Codes) - Submission Response
motions.description: Western Australian Planning Commission has released Draft Residential Planning Codes (R Codes) 1995 for public comment until 30 June 1995. Council to advise Ministry for Planning of detailed concerns regarding draft codes.

motions.title: 95-99 Cambridge Street, Leederville - J.B O'Reilly's Tavern - Internal Alterations - Lost
motions.description: Application for internal alterations to tavern including use of snug area for entertainment and conversion of internal decked area to mezzanine floor for games area. Existing parking shortfall of 30 bays, would increase to 42 with mezzanine. History of complaints regarding noise and parking. Motion to approve relocation of entertainment to snug area only (excluding mezzanine floor) subject to acoustic engineer report.

motions.title: 20 Oxford Close, Leederville - Office/Remedial Training Centre Conversion - Approved
motions.description: Application to convert existing office/warehouse to office/remedial training centre for paramedical professionals (psychologist, optician, occupational therapist, speech pathologist). No on-site parking provided but applicant secured adjacent parking and area has adequate street parking.

motions.title: 20 Oxford Close, Leederville - Motion Amendment
motions.description: Amendment to add requirement for applicants to provide evidence that additional parking has been secured

motions.title: Subiaco Redevelopment - Proposed Extension to Boundary Area - Opposition
motions.description: Subiaco Redevelopment Authority seeks Council support to extend redevelopment scheme area into Town of Cambridge, including land along Salvado Road at corner of Jersey Street, Wembley. Land is owned freehold by Town and currently zoned Commercial C1.

motions.title: Building Licences - St John of God Hospital - Approval
motions.description: Three building licence applications from St John of God Hospital for refurbishment works exceeding $175,000. Projects include temporary consultation rooms and pathology facilities, plus permanent high voltage switch room.

motions.title: 24 Caddy Avenue, Leederville - Two Storey Residence - Approved
motions.description: Application for two storey residence with variations to setbacks, plot ratio and car parking requirements on small R40 zoned lot. Proposal fits with existing streetscape. Adjoining owner agrees to variations.

motions.title: 24 Caddy Avenue - Motion Amendment - Deletion of Condition
motions.description: Amendment to delete condition regarding upstairs deck setback from side boundary

motions.title: 42 Connolly Street, Wembley - Two Storey Duplex - Refused
motions.description: Application for two storey duplex development with plot ratio exceeding Council policy (0.55:1.0 versus 0.4:1.0 required). Cr McConnell moved refusal on grounds of excessive plot ratio, being out of character with streetscape and creating additional double width crossover.

motions.title: Immunisation Service Expansion
motions.description: Review of immunisation service options and recommendation to expand service with second clinic at Boronia Crescent, City Beach.

motions.title: Wembley Lodge Liquor Licence Opposition
motions.description: Application by Wembley Lodge for Special Facility Liquor Licence; Council considers history of noise complaints and potential intensification of use.

motions.title: Lake Monger Drive/Kimberley Street Intersection Traffic Management
motions.description: Upgrade of intersection traffic management with seagull island in Lake Monger Drive median and street lighting improvements.

motions.title: Depot Facilities Arrangements
motions.description: Approval of depot facility arrangements with City of Subiaco for interim period and permanent facility at Lemnos Street; claim for Roberts Street Depot asset recovery.

motions.title: 1995 National General Assembly Attendance
motions.description: Authorization for Mayor to attend 1995 National General Assembly of Australian Local Government in Canberra.

motions.title: Local Government Week Conference Attendance (Original Motion)
motions.description: Registration of Mayor and delegates to attend Local Government Week Conference at Burswood Convention Centre.

motions.title: Local Government Week Conference Attendance (Amendment Motion)
motions.description: Amendment to reflect Deputy Mayor attending instead of Mayor and unavailability of Cr McConnell.

motions.title: Tender for Photocopier Supply and Installation

motions.title: Suspension of Standing Orders Subclause 3.3.4
motions.description: That the operation of Subclause 3.3.4 of the Standing Orders be suspended.

motions.title: Resumption of Standing Orders Subclause 3.3.4
motions.description: That the operation of Subclause 3.3.4 of the Standing Orders be resumed.

motions.title: A Class Reserve Status for Land North of Oceanic Drive
motions.description: That as the owner of the land located between Oceanic Drive and The Boulevard and in recognition of the System 6 and other environmental recommendations, the Town of Cambridge shall apply for A Class Reserve status for the area, as surveyed to the Town's satisfaction, vested in the Town, and that all remaining bushland in that area shall be maintained as natural and indigenous bushland in perpetuity, compatible with the environmental management of the Bold Regional Park and associated bushland.

motions.title: Environmental Management Programme for Degraded Areas
motions.description: That the Town of Cambridge:- (i) affirms its obligation to prepare an Environmental Management Programme for the degraded areas as outlined in the Land Use Strategy for Bold Park and Environs (635) Statement issued by the Minister for the Environment in February 1995; (ii) will rehabilitate those degraded areas to their natural and indigenous bushland setting to be maintained in perpetuity, compatible with the environmental management of the Bold Regional Park and associated bushland.

motions.title: Incorporation of Area H into Bold Regional Park
motions.description: That the Town of Cambridge is of the view that the area of land designated as Area H as described on Plan 1 attached to the Deed of Agreement, be incorporated into the Bold Regional Park area.

motions.title: Incorporation of Area F into Bold Regional Park
motions.description: That the Town of Cambridge is of the view that the area of land between the Cottesloe Golf Course and Fortview Street in Mount Claremont, described as Area F on Plan 1 attached to the Deed of Agreement, be incorporated into the Bold Regional Park area.

motions.title: Area F to Remain as Bushland Buffer Zone
motions.description: That the Town of Cambridge is of the view that the area of land between the Cottesloe Golf Course and Fortview Street in Mount Claremont, described as Area F on Plan 1 attached to the Deed of Agreement, remain as bushland to act as a buffer zone between the Cottesloe Golf Course, the Christ Church Grammar School playing fields and the Bold Regional Park.

motions.title: Support for Creation of Bold Regional Park with Amended Boundaries
motions.description: That the Council supports the initiative to create the Bold Regional Park as proposed by the Government of Western Australia, with the following amendments to the prescribed boundaries:- (i) to exclude the area of land designated as Alderbury Reserve and Perry Lakes Reserve as described on Plan No. 1 attached to the Deed of Agreement; (ii) to include the area of land designated as Area H and described as the land located between the Christ Church Grammar School playing fields and Rochdale Road as described on Plan No. 1 attached to the Deed of Agreement.

motions.title: Opposition to Realignment and Widening of Stephenson Avenue and Rochdale Road (North)
motions.description: That the proposed realignment and widening of Stephenson Avenue and Rochdale Road (north) not be supported.

motions.title: Adoption of Town of Cambridge Submission on MRS Amendment No. 967/33
motions.description: That the Town of Cambridge submission on the Metropolitan Region Scheme Amendment No. 967/33 - Bold Park, incorporating all changes as previously agreed to and including the recommendations of the Special Meeting of the Council held on 21 June 1995, be adopted.

motions.title: 78 Kimberley Street - Nursing Home Additions
motions.description: Single storey additions to Kimberley Street Nursing Home involving relocation of two 2 bed wards and additional kitchen storage space. Application complies with Town Planning Scheme except for plot ratio (0.53:1.0 vs required 0.5:1.0) and side setback (0.8m vs required 1.0m). Applicant is Milcon Properties Pty Ltd.

motions.title: 438 Cambridge Street, Floreat - Veterinary Clinic Extension
motions.description: Application to extend existing veterinary clinic at Lot 239 (No. 438) Cambridge Street, Floreat with 140 square metre extension for caretaker quarters, cattery, store room and grooming/display area. Deferred for further consideration.

motions.title: 19 Norbury Crescent, City Beach - Residential Respite Care Centre
motions.description: Application for redevelopment of existing residence for use as residential respite care centre. New single storey 5 bedroom brick and tile dwelling with facilities for disabled persons. Secondary street setback varies from policy (3.0m vs 3.75m required) but adjoining owners have not objected. No objections received; four letters in support from nearby residents and shopkeepers.

motions.title: 438 Vincent Street West, Leederville - Office Building Extensions
motions.description: Application for extensions to existing two storey office building. Extension includes basement car park for 15 vehicles and two levels of office space (approximately 342 square metres GFA). Non-compliance with rear setback requirement (3m provided vs 5.2m required). Main considerations regarding overlooking and overshadowing of adjoining residential properties.

motions.title: 40 Alderbury Street, Floreat - Home Occupation Office
motions.description: Application to operate home occupation office for electrical and security service from single room (16 square metres) in residential dwelling. Sole operator. Operating hours 8am-5pm weekdays. One written submission received expressing no objection subject to no two-way radio use. One telephone response received with no objection.

motions.title: 2 Peebles Road, Floreat - Proposed Subdivision
motions.description: Application for subdivision of Lot 796 (1467 square metres) into two lots (702 and 765 square metres). Does not comply with R Code requirements for average lot size (733.5m² proposed vs 800m² required) and Council Policy 4 for Endowment Lands minimum lot size. WA Planning Commission referred application for comment. Council recommends refusal due to non-compliance and irregular boundary configuration.

motions.title: 107 Grovedale Road, Floreat - Home Occupation Settlement Agent Office
motions.description: Application to operate home occupation settlement agent office from single room (9.25 square metres) in residential dwelling. Sole operator. Operating hours 9am-5pm weekdays with work mostly conducted in the city. Clients visit only on rare occasions. One telephone response received with no objection.

motions.title: Delegated Decisions and Notifications
motions.description: Information item regarding delegated development approvals, subdivisions/amalgamations, and notifications of appeals and decisions by other authorities.

motions.title: Metropolitan Regional Scheme - Bold Park Amendment No 967/33
motions.description: MRS Amendment relating to Bold Park and Environs currently released for public comment. Submissions close 23 June 1995. Amendment involves land classification changes and realignment/reclassification of regional roads. Key issues include Bold Park creation, Stephenson Avenue alignment, and West Coast Highway realignment.

motions.title: Building Licences Approved Under Delegated Authority
motions.description: Schedule of building licences approved under delegated authority during period 19 April 1995 to 31 May 1995.

motions.title: Procedure for Building Application Approval/Refusal
motions.description: Establishment of procedure for approval/refusal of building applications by delegating authority to appointed Building Surveyor. Authority limited by building class and value. Class 1 and 10 buildings delegated fully; Class 2-9 buildings over $175,000 to be submitted to Council. Also seeks approval to appoint Manager of Building Services to office of Building Surveyor.

motions.title: Building Licences Requiring Council Approval
motions.description: Two building licence applications exceeding $175,000 in value requiring Council approval: (1) Woolworths WA refurbishment at Floreat Forum Shopping Centre ($650,000); (2) Cambridge Private Hospital additions and alterations ($650,000).

motions.title: 9 Arbordale Street, Floreat - Single Storey Residence
motions.description: Application for new four bedroom, two bathroom home. Does not comply with Council Bylaw 43 and Policy 20 regarding front setback. Garage extends into 9.0 metre setback to 6.5 metres. Remainder of residence set back 13.0 metres. Variation from 'Garden Suburb' design principle supported due to changing area character.

motions.title: Subiaco Oval - Aircraft Noise and Safety
motions.description: Report on progress in restricting aircraft flying over and around Subiaco Oval during AFL games. Residents have expressed concerns regarding noise and safety. Discussions held with Civil Aviation Authority, Melbourne Cricket Club, and WA Football Commission. New aviation regulations to come into force 1 July 1995 with expanded powers to control environmental issues such as aircraft noise.

motions.title: Wembley Golf Complex Design Project
motions.description: Tender assessment for design and construction phases of new course layout at Wembley Golf Complex. Three tenders received. Project Team assessment based on organisation profile, design capability, construction capability, and value for money. GHD achieved high grading on each criterion. Contract to be let for execution of work by 4 July 1995.

motions.title: Waste Management - Contract for Service
motions.description: Tender process for waste management services previously provided by City of Perth. Service no longer available after 30 June 1995. Five responses received including four tenders and one alternative offer. Assessment conducted by panel including Executive Manager Technical Services, Co-ordinator Works, Purchasing Officer, and Waste Management Consultant. Recommended contractors: Cleanaway for majority of services, Green Recycling for community recycle bins. Six month contract period recommended.

motions.title: Green Recycling Contract Acceptance
motions.description: Acceptance of Green Recycling contract with WA Recycling for residential household recycle crates and community recycle bins at a cost of $39,000 for six months from 1 July 1995.

motions.title: Council Meeting Schedule 1995/96
motions.description: Adoption of the schedule of meeting dates for ordinary meetings of Council for the 1995/96 year, providing for two meetings per month generally on the second and fourth Tuesdays commencing at 5.30 pm, with one meeting each in December and January 1996.

motions.title: Documents Sealed
motions.description: Noting that the Common Seal of the Town of Cambridge has been affixed to documents listed in the attached schedule since 6 May 1995.

motions.title: Town Logo Design Competition
motions.description: Approval for a logo competition open to individuals who live, work, recreate or are educated in the municipality, with a selection panel to be formed comprising the Mayor, Deputy Mayor, CEO and Executive Manager Corporate & Customer Services.

motions.title: National General Assembly Attendance - Initial Motion
motions.description: Initial motion to authorize the Mayor to attend the 1995 National General Assembly of Australian Local Government in Canberra from 12-15 November 1995 and charge expenditure to Budget Item Members - Course/Conference Expenses.

motions.title: National General Assembly Attendance - Deferral
motions.description: Motion to defer further consideration of nomination of Council representatives to attend the 1995 National General Assembly of Australian Local Government until further information on costs is available.

motions.title: Wembley Golf Complex Fees Review - Initial Motion
motions.description: Initial motion to approve new fee schedule for Wembley Golf Complex effective 1 July 1995, including green fees and driving range fees, and to discontinue time restrictions for Senior concession rates.

motions.title: Wembley Golf Complex Fees Review - Deferral
motions.description: Motion to defer further consideration of the Wembley Golf Complex fees review to the next Ordinary Meeting of Council to enable provision of additional financial information.

motions.title: Insurance Renewal 1995/96 - Initial Motion
motions.description: Motion to note the insurance renewal report and adopt in principle the Self Insurance Scheme proposed by the Western Australian Municipal Association.

motions.title: Insurance Renewal 1995/96 - Amended Motion
motions.description: Motion to amend the insurance renewal recommendation to request an independent assessment of the proposed Self Insurance Scheme from H R Manners, former Managing Director of Sedgwicks, prior to 20 June 1995.

motions.title: Assignment of Lease - City Beach Kiosk No 2
motions.description: Motion to assign the existing lease of City Beach Kiosk No 2, Challenger Parade, City Beach from Andrea Simonelli to MacDuff Pty Ltd, subject to Minister approval, with conditions regarding endorsement and lease renegotiation.

motions.title: Joan Watters Community Centre - Consultative Committee Setup
motions.description: Establishment of an Advisory/Consultative Committee for the Joan Watters Community Centre comprising a Councillor Chairperson and four members from the Centre.

motions.title: Joan Watters Community Centre - Amend Terms of Reference
motions.description: Amendment to the Consultative Committee terms of reference to change 'undertake' to 'assist' in relation to research and investigation into uses of the Centre.

motions.title: Joan Watters Community Centre - Mayor as Chairperson
motions.description: Nomination of the Mayor as Chairperson of the Joan Watters Community Centre Consultative Committee.

motions.title: Fairway Tavern - Valuation Authority
motions.description: Authorization for the Chief Executive Officer to engage a Valuer to determine a fair market rent for the Fairway Tavern at the Wembley Golf Complex, with the note that the valuation will not be binding on the Council or Lessee.

motions.title: Conversion of Residence to Consulting Rooms - 368 Cambridge Street
motions.description: Application by Stanton Partners for conversion of existing residence to consulting rooms (five surgeries, laboratory, sterilisation room, etc.) in residential zone. Advertising procedure completed with 9 letters and 1 petition (27 signatories) objecting, plus subsequent petition in support (95 signatories). Main concerns: increased traffic, parking problems, security, property values, impact on residential amenity.

motions.title: Subdivision Application Refusal - 50 Marapana Road
motions.description: Motion to refer subdivision application to Western Australian Planning Commission with recommendation for refusal. Applicant proposes to subdivide 1406m² lot into two lots of 771m² and 635m². Proposal does not comply with R Code minimum and average lot size requirements and conflicts with Council policy on Endowment Land subdivision.

motions.title: Boundary Realignment of Two Lots - 50 and 52 Keane Street
motions.description: Application by J E Hawkins and Anida Holdings Pty Ltd for boundary realignment of two lots to facilitate development of second residence at rear. WAPC previously refused subdivision into three equal lots. Applicant proposes realignment to create one lot of 514.7m² and one lot of 927.3m² with setbacks of 1 metre and 2.9 metres.

motions.title: Rezoning Request - 42 Kimberley Street West Leederville
motions.description: Application by BSD Planning Consultants to rezone land from Residential (R40) to General Commercial (C2) for professional offices use. Site is 374m² with dilapidated weatherboard dwelling. Previous rezoning requests in 1986 and 1987 were not supported. Applicant proposes restoration and conversion of existing dwelling for 1-2 professional consultants.

motions.title: Proposed Subdivision - 1 Lesser Street and Glen Street
motions.description: Application by MJ O'Donohoe on behalf of Brown McAllister Pty Ltd for subdivision of rear lot containing outbuildings to create two lots of 225m² and 262m² to facilitate second residence. Referral from WAPC. Site does not comply with R40 Code parking requirements.

motions.title: Addition to Medical Surgery - 1 Oban Road
motions.description: Application by [private individual — name withheld] to extend existing surgery by 71 square metres, providing two consulting rooms, sterilising room, laboratory and staff room. Surgery has operated since 1976 with no complaints. Advertising procedure completed with six letters all in support.

motions.title: Suspension of Standing Orders for Bold Regional Park Discussion
motions.description: Motion to suspend Standing Orders Subclause 3.3.4 to enable full discussion on Bold Regional Park matters, Alderbury Reserve and Perry Lakes Reserve land.

motions.title: Resumption of Standing Orders
motions.description: Motion to resume Standing Orders Subclause 3.3.4 after full discussion on Bold Regional Park matters.

motions.title: Seek Legal Advice on Bold Regional Park Deed
motions.description: Motion to seek legal advice regarding the Deed of Transfer from Town of Cambridge to State Government for Bold Regional Park land, with authority to appoint legal counsel.

motions.title: Special Meeting on Bold Regional Park
motions.description: Motion to hold a Special Meeting on 30 May 1995 at 5.45pm to establish preferred position regarding Bold Regional Park and environs.

motions.title: Subiaco Redevelopment Project Briefing
motions.description: Motion to accept invitation from Subiaco Redevelopment Authority to attend briefing on project at 5.00pm Tuesday 30 May 1995. Briefing to include detailed information on projected traffic volumes.

motions.title: Planning Scheme Review Approach and Work Programme
motions.description: Confirmation of approach and work programme for completion of Town of Cambridge Town Planning Scheme Review. Includes summary of public consultation, cooperative approach with City of Perth and three Towns, and revised timetable for scheme completion.

motions.title: Defer Transfer of Undeveloped Parkland to Crown
motions.description: Motion to defer proposal to transfer undeveloped parkland (remnant coastal bushland, Parks and Recreation Reserve) located along West Coast Highway and The Boulevard to Crown, pending more detailed assessment of future use and management.

motions.title: Two Storey Residence Refusal - 16 Connolly Street
motions.description: Application by Lindsay Waller Architect on behalf of St John of God Health Care Systems Inc to construct two storey dwelling at 16 Connolly Street, Leederville. Building to house five sisters on rotational two-year basis with common areas. Proposal exceeds Council Policy 13 plot ratio requirement (0.57:1 vs 0.4:1 maximum).

motions.title: Appointment of Authorised Persons under Various Statutes
motions.description: Appointment of three staff members as authorised officers under various Acts and By-laws. [private individual — name withheld] (Pool Supervisor at Bold Park Aquatic Centre being trained as Ranger), [private individual — name withheld] (Manager Customer Services), and [private individual — name withheld] (Technical Officer in Works) to be authorised under Litter Act, Dog Act, Local Government Act, Off Road Vehicles Act, Parking By-laws, and Bush Fires Act.

motions.title: Assignment of Lease - City Beach Kiosk No. 2
motions.description: Assignment of lease for City Beach Kiosk No. 2 at Challenger Parade from Andrea Simonelli (retiring after approximately 20 years) to Anthony Richard Alexander Hilton. Granting of two consecutive four-year options of renewal to provide ten-year term for lessee to amortise improvements.

motions.description: Confirmation of schedule of accounts for periods ending 31 March 1995 and 30 April 1995, with approval of payments from Municipal Fund and Reimbursement to City of Perth Advance Account.

motions.title: Incorporate bushland north of Oceanic Drive into Bold Regional Park
motions.description: That this meeting calls on the Town of Cambridge to incorporate the bushland area north of Oceanic Drive and south of The Boulevard, City Beach, into the proposed Bold Regional Park as recommended by the System Six Report 1983, the National Trust in December 1992, the Mitchell McCotter Public Environmental Review January 1993, the former Perth City Council also in 1993, and the Environmental Protection Authority (Bulletin 744) in June 1994.

motions.title: Incorporate bushland north of Christ Church playing fields into Bold Regional Park
motions.description: That this meeting calls on the Town of Cambridge to incorporate the bushland area north of the Christ Church playing fields into the proposed Bold Regional Park as recommended by the System Six Report 1983, the National Trust in December 1992, the Mitchell McCotter Public Environmental Review of January 1993, the former Perth City Council also in 1993, and the Environmental Protection Authority (Bulletin 744) in June 1994.

motions.title: Zone Mt Claremont Christ Church playing fields as Parks and Recreation
motions.description: That this meeting calls on the Town of Cambridge to zone the Mt Claremont Christ Church playing fields located to the east of the boundary of the proposed Bold Regional Park, as 'Parks and Recreation', as contained in its Draft Town Planning Scheme No. 1, and that the Town of Cambridge request the Western Australian Planning Commission to amend the Metropolitan Region Scheme accordingly.

motions.title: Exclude land east of Perry Lakes Drive from Bold Regional Park
motions.description: That subject to investigation of the costs involved in the land being maintained by the Town of Cambridge, all that land east of Perry Lakes Drive, be excluded from the Bold Regional Park.
